items.overview: A group of young people conquer the heavens and return to earth as angels. But they are invisible to mortals. Only an old camcorder, forgotten in a family drawer, is capable of capturing a faint trace of their presence.

items.title: So, my daughter says you’re a film critic?
items.overview: A young man visits his girlfriend’s father for the first time. When the father asks whether he’s a film critic, he confidently replies, “I write on Letterboxd.” The answer doesn’t go down quite as expected, and the father tells him to get the fuck out of his house.

items.title: Monsieur Mercedes - Im Schatten des Sterns
Cat Cabaret
items.overview: Three kick ass strippers suspect their no good manager is up to something sinister. Will their combined skills of brain, brawn and heart be enough to save their club and each other before it’s too late?

items.title: 無題のスーパー8フィルム
Little Things
items.overview: Through the changing reflection of her mother, Sara contemplates how reflections reveal our experiences, the passage of time, and the beliefs we carry about ourselves.

items.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments — The Mummy Theme Park
items.overview: Mike and the bots riff on this Italian film about an American photographer and his assistant/possible girlfriend being sent to Egypt to take pictures of the brand new Mummy Theme Park.

items.title: Flhorrida 2: Even Flhorrider
items.overview: In 2017, a horrid holiday happened... Now, in 2025, a holiday happened horridly... again! SmellBad Films present, a rubbish sequel no one in the universe asked for. But this time, it will be... EPIC!

items.title: The Wetland
items.overview: An environmentalist farmer and his biologist daughter lead efforts to save their 1,000 year old wetland community from being destroyed by Mexico City.

items.title: Raíces
items.overview: After being rescued by a remote community, two siblings discover that the place that saved them will stop at nothing to keep them from leaving.

items.title: Get Stuffed
items.overview: The year is 1986, and a group camping trip goes awry when five students find themselves hunted by a masked killer. The killer's aim? To start a human taxidermy collection.

items.title: Shisei
items.overview: New adaptation of Junichiro Tanizaki short story. Seiji, a tattoo artist who returned to Japan following his father’s death, encounters Chisato—a woman who wanders the city streets barefoot. Captivated by Chisato, who lives desperately for the sake of her younger brother and her lover, Seiji becomes consumed by a burning desire to tattoo her back—an act that feels like a defiance against his own failing, illness-ridden body. Meanwhile, Seiji reconnects with his childhood friend, Takashi, who has been living a dissolute life. Together, Seiji, Takashi, and Chisato—who longs to shed her timid self and be reborn—embark on a journey, leaving everything else behind.

items.title: You've Got Me
items.overview: When Henley, an insecure 10-year-old learns his best friend Rory is leaving for private school, he agrees to an outrageous plan to rob a bank, so he can join Rory at private school and keep their friendship alive.

items.title: I was in Cologne all summer
items.overview: A film made as a farewell brings memories back to life. As a camera stitches the edges of a city together, the summer stretches into forever. Remembering turns into forgetting; forgetting, into remembering. As time folds in on itself, the Rhine keeps flowing.

items.title: Ark Park
items.overview: An observational study of Kentucky's "Ark Encounter", a Christian fundamentalist theme park that approaches the biblical story of Noah's unique vessel as historical fact.

items.title: Jardín Escondido
items.overview: Isolated on a cliff, enclosed between waterpools and sloping paths sits an uncanny meadow, where a thousand forms of life collide with each other. Recorded in San José de Suaita, Santander.

items.title: Persistence
items.overview: A bored young boy visits a science park and embarks on an adventure in science.

items.title: Nchuwejh
items.overview: A dance film set in the heart of the Chaco Impenetrable, where the Wichí movement intertwines with the four elements and ancestral memory to celebrate the sacred bond between culture and nature.

items.title: The Stag
items.overview: Following a heist that gifts them more money than expected, a dysfunctional group of thieves find their hopes and dreams shattered when they are forced to confront a serial killer, as well as the vengeful crime lord they’ve stolen from.

items.title: KIDKILLER
items.overview: FBI Special Agent Collins is dispatched to investigate a missing child at an abandoned residence. But when the case turns out to be nonexistent, a ransom note reveals that she was the intended target all along.

items.title: The Dead House
items.overview: At his grandfather’s wake, Patrick is forced into a long-avoided confrontation with his father, unearthing buried shame, family secrets and the Traveller heritage that continues to shape their lives.

items.title: See It Loud! The Globe Poster Story
items.overview: See It Loud documents the legacy and rebirth of Globe Poster, the legendary, Baltimore-based poster company.

items.title: Spider-Man : Wings of Hell
items.overview: Tormented by a troubled childhood and the burden of his powers, Spider-Man reaches a breaking point the day he commits an irreparable act. Caught between the lies of those around him and his own demons, Peter spirals into a spiral of uncontrollable violence until he reaches the point of no return...  Independent, non-profit fan film. Not affiliated with Marvel, Sony, or Disney.

items.title: Alfetashim
items.overview: A Film by Redi Bereka

items.title: River's Dawn
items.overview: Struck down by grief and trapped in her own depression, a young woman is drawn outside by a mysterious sound beneath her window, embarking on a journey through nature and memories to find peace within her mind.

items.title: SALUS ANIMARUM
items.overview: On July 1, 2026, thirty-eight years after the episcopal consecrations performed by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre, four new bishops are consecrated in Écône for the Society of Saint Pius X.  Through exclusive testimonies and previously unseen footage, the documentary SALUS ANIMARUM explores the circumstances and reasons behind this decision, the preparations for the consecrations, the ceremony itself, and the reactions it provoked within the Church.  Beyond this historic event, the film highlights what is at stake in the transmission of Catholic Tradition, fidelity to the priesthood, and the mission of the Church, whose supreme law remains the salvation of souls.

items.title: Between Sky and Sea
items.overview: A largely wordless portrait of life in displacement from Gaza City filmmaker Ismail Abu Hatab (1993-2025), Between Sky and Sea artfully documents scenes of resilience, survival, and ordinary life of Palestinians in Gaza’s largest displacement site during the summer of 2024, concluding in a mass march home to northern Gaza.

items.title: Moondog Equestria
items.overview: A ritual situated between (post)modern staging and the authentic representation of indigenous customs, featuring Mexican art, horseback riding and the music of Moondog.

items.title: Vamped
items.overview: After attending a vampire-themed party with her best friend, Joaquin, Mina is bitten by a mysterious stranger (Keiran). She begins undergoing unsettling changes. As her senses sharpen and her confidence grows, she starts to realize that the life she feared losing may have been holding her back all along.

items.title: Lapidaria
items.overview: Rosa danced to exhaustion. Now, in her sixties, with an impressive career as a dancer and contemporary dance teacher, she has lost her job and, with it, the will to live... At least not as a human being. Deep and dark thoughts arise as an invocation to a supernatural being that frees her from her carnal wrapping, seeking to sublimate her existence towards immortality. But first, he will have to say goodbye to all the primal pleasure and sensation. And then, he will come.

items.title: Kinomania: The Beginning
items.overview: The beginning of the World Film Panorama in Sofia was in November 1987, and since 1993 the event has taken the name "Kinomania". For four decades now, the capital's oldest film festival has been bringing audiences together with the best of world cinema from the past year. Through the stories of the real participants in the events and intriguing archival footage, the short documentary film by Boris Missirkov and Georgi Bogdanov tells the story of the festival's creation – from the World Film Panorama and the birth of "Kinomania" to the present day.

items.title: Der Fall Fabian - Hinter der Akte
Animal
items.overview: One night. Two boys. A truth they can't escape.

items.title: After Dive
items.overview: After Dive tells a story of passion, perseverance, discipline, and companionship. The athletic preparation required in springboard diving demands constant training, a ritual that perfects technique, coordination, and concentration. The film unfolds at the Karl Dibiasi pool in Bolzano, where Tania Cagnotto and Francesca Dallapè, Europe’s most successful synchronized diving pair, have trained since 2008. Two years after initially saying farewell to the boards, they return to train together for the next Olympic Games. In the meantime, both have become mothers: Tania to Maya and Francesca to Ludovica.

items.title: Peter
items.overview: Peter, an intoxicated trans man, leaves the bar late at night. On his way to meet a love interest, he gets followed by a mysterious man. Peter questions whether this man is just a pedestrian or if he has sinister intentions, specifically a hate crime.

items.title: the door is open
items.overview: In this political moment, when creating feels futile, I choose instead to craft a spell.  Four tracks make up my film: two you can see and hear, and two that remain invisible and inaudible, yet are fully present.  The Door Is Open is a spell by and for trans and non-binary people. It is an offering—crafted with intention, grief, joy, and magic. This short film is not meant for consumption or voyeuristic curiosity.  The Door Is Open is an act of care: a portal, a whisper, a protection spell woven in light and shadow.  If you are trans and or non-binary, this film is for you.  You are invited.  You are necessary.  You are seen.  The spell waits patiently for you.﻿﻿

items.title: attempting to escape death by dancing
items.overview: di come i vivi tentarono, danzando, di sottrarsi alla morte is an experimental documentary exploring traditional dances of Southern Italy as collective acts of resistance against death. Through the manipulation and progressive digital degradation of archival footage, accompanied by a grotesque and unsettling soundscape, the film brings Elias Canetti's reflections on the refusal to accept death into dialogue with Ernesto de Martino's studies on magic and the crisis of presence. The movement of bodies becomes a ritual attempt to suspend the irreversibility of time, an obstinate and ultimately futile revolt against the dissolution of existence.

items.title: COOKED FLESH
items.overview: When an arrogant young sous chef named Danny receives a final warning at the restaurant “Bruce and CO”. He makes a reckless decision to get back at his over-bearing manager, turning him into an uncontrollable zombie. What begins as a petty revenge prank quickly spirals into complete chaos. Forcing Danny and the staff to survive an increasingly bizarre shift, while trying to save both their jobs and their lives.

items.title: A Life with Peregrines
items.overview: For forty years, George has been protecting the peregrine falcons of the Scottish Borders. Now that his retirement is approaching, he is passing on his knowledge to his protégé Rebecca. An intimate portrait about nature conservation, dedication, and passing on a lifelong mission.

items.title: The Moon Comes Again
items.overview: As an elderly couple reflects on their shared life, their memories challenge the promise of "happily ever after".

items.title: Selamat Hari Jadi
items.overview: Tuck feels the growing cracks in his family as his parents drift apart. At his birthday party, he meets Oak, a spirited Malay girl. Through their friendship, he learns to face fear, loneliness, and the imperfect reality of growing up.

items.title: Holy Moly!
items.overview: Prasin, Voplatek, and Filip. three friends from Polevsko in the Šluknov salient, want to mark their final evening together with something special: stealing a crucifix and adding it to the collection of "trophies" in their hangout spot. But while two of them are preparing to head off to Prague, the third refuses to come to terms with the changes on the horizon. A satirical coming-of-age comedy about friendship, growing up, and the difficulty of letting others go.

items.title: Full Moon
items.overview: Raimunda is an elderly woman from rural Minas Gerais whose routine as a market vendor is disturbed by marital woes. When her husband vanishes, she sets out on his trail fueled by a thirst for revenge.

items.title: The Dream As Resistance
items.overview: A look into the mind of Belgian surfboard shaper Angelo De Meulenaere.

items.title: Cold Streak
items.overview: After a career-ending injury takes away the one thing this former D1 basketball player has ever known, he returns to the court for one final shot, hoping to recapture the feeling of who he once was.

items.title: GANTARI
items.overview: A highschool girl learns that her life have more to offer when she discovers the art of dancing.

items.title: Your Worst Nightmare
items.overview: A group of unassuming Halloween partygoers fall victim to the plot of two murderers among them. Chaos ensues as the group hunt for clues that will lead them to the killers.

items.title: Sidestep
items.overview: After obtaining a valuable briefcase, a spy must make a quick and stealthy exit as counterintelligence searches for him. When things go awry, he must rely on his handler and his wits to outsmart counterintelligence agents.

items.title: Familial
items.overview: After discovering his parents are serial killers, a teenage boy must choose whether to turn them in - or join them.

items.title: Entropy
items.overview: A man finds a mysterious object that appears to follow him wherever he goes. When he finally brings it home, curiosity curdles into obsession.

items.title: 13-Novembre : La France face au terrorisme islamiste
Jarlath Regan - Make America Laugh Again
items.overview: A brand new stand-up comedy special from Irish comedian Jarlath Regan. Breaking America is one thing. Getting into America, is quite another.

items.title: A Proud Family Wizmas
items.overview: When Penny Proud’s rant about Wizmas and the commercialization of Christmas causes Santa to quit on Christmas eve, Penny finds herself guilted into putting on the red suit and replacing him. And in the process of delivering Yuletide cheer with the help of Santa’s irreverent elves, she discovers that indeed the Christmas spirit is still alive.

items.title: Festive Fun with Peppa
items.overview: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

items.title: The Christmas Yes List
items.overview: Chloe Hollis, an ambitious New York professional whose habit of putting everyone else first has left her overlooked for the promotion she desperately wants, returns home to Maple Hills, West Virginia, for Christmas. Determined to change her people-pleasing ways, Chloe embarks on an unconventional holiday challenge to overcome her fear of rejection. But when she meets James Stone, a successful executive spending Christmas with family in town, Chloe discovers some of life’s greatest gifts arrive when we stop fearing the answer and start embracing the journey.
stream: Great American Pure Flix Amazon Channel

items.title: Push The Machine
items.overview: A young stuntman embarks on the most perilous, and illegal, project of his life. With the police hot on his trail, and an arduous mission to reach the takeoff, the jump itself is only half the challenge.

items.title: L'Autre
items.overview: Bedridden following a severe cancer, a man sees his recovery falter when his young roommate begins to stir up his deepest fears.

items.title: And Love Knocked
items.overview: When a driven Wall Street executive and a down-to-earth Christmas-tree salesman cross paths, their lives collide. Four years later, fate knocks on her door. Amid city lights and second chances, the two strangers discover love finds its way home in this holiday romantic drama.

items.title: The River Train
items.overview: Nine-year-old Milo lives in a remote Argentinian village where he studies the Malambo, a folk dance full of bravura. He is an excellent dancer, but Milo’s only desire is to escape the countryside on a train for the Buenos Aires of his dreams.

items.title: The Nights Before Christmas
items.overview: When a magical wish traps him in an endless Christmas Eve, a man makes the most of his extra time while trying to win the heart of a woman who forgets him each morning.

items.title: Primetime Preacher$
items.overview: Chronicles the 1980s golden age of Christian broadcasting, detailing how three of America's most prominent televangelists shifted evangelical Christianity into a massive political force.

items.title: The Chosen: Season 6 Premiere
items.overview: The sixth season premiere of the popular Biblical television series, following Jesus' arrest and trial leading up to His crucifixion.

items.title: The Gleaner
items.overview: On Christmas Eve, on a small snow-covered Aegean island in the late 19th century, Ahtitsa, a poor elderly woman, struggles to raise her two orphaned grandchildren, with the help of her kind neighbor Gerbinho. Just as despair is about to consume her, a check from her long-lost son in America brings hope. When the village grocer attempts to exploit her ignorance of its true value, a chance intervention by a stranded merchant from Syros gifts Ahtitsa a brighter future.

items.title: Five by Five
items.overview: Set three decades prior to 'Echo 8,' the prequel 'Five By Five' unveils the enigmatic Agent 5's grief-stricken existence and his gradual spiral into chaos white climbing Zodiac's hierarchy.

items.title: Alice Júnior Summer Break
items.overview: Alice Júnior, a famous young influencer, gets canceled after a fight with besties Lino and Vivi. Seeking refuge, she heads to remote Ilha do Mel, where her father Jean Genet is set to marry neo-hippie Marisa. Under enigmatic trans matriarch Mama Gaia, rituals and secrets begin to surface. Offline, amid past conflicts and new desires, Alice rides a wave of self-discovery where, reconnecting with her true self, she will transform.

items.title: Daredevil: Man Without Fear
items.overview: Based upon the early Man Without Fear comics, explore Matt Murdocks world in Hell’s Kitchen seeing his beginnings with his best friend Foggy Nelson, falling in love for the first time with Elektra Natchios, and even beginning a law firm with his best friend. Then see the present day and how Matt handles life as a lawyer and as a vigilante of the night, going against foes such as the Kingpin and Bullseye! Will Matt survive these horrible encounters? Find out!

items.title: Beril_XXX
items.overview: Beril wanders the streets of Istanbul. A budding actress, she heads to meet a producer to pitch an ambitious, deeply personal film project. Friends, lovers, and other figures cross her path as we discover what lies behind the city's facades and the people within it.

items.title: Echo 8 Beyond
items.overview: After the occurrences of 'Echo 8,' Anna finds herself pursued by lethal Zodiac operatives tasked with her termination. Living off-grid, she shields her mother from a distance. However, her identity is exposed when she crosses paths with a group of misfits.

items.title: We Had a Plan
items.overview: Paul and Daniel, a gay couple who spent ten years working illegally as cleaners in the Netherlands, return to the Philippines as a success story. But before long their plans begin to unravel, and they face a difficult choice. A love story.

items.title: Hazara Town
items.overview: Twenty years after fleeing Afghanistan, a Hazara family in Pakistan must decide whether to stay together amid growing persecution or leave, separate from each other, knowing they may never meet again.

items.title: Beyond the Treeline
items.overview: When A series of strange killings draws a hardened bounty hunter towards a forbidden stretch of Indian reservation known as the treeline, he encounters a world shaped by violence. As his hunt brings him face to face with the darkest parts of human nature, he must confront consequences of a life spent taking others.

items.title: Angel Downtown
items.overview: The path to performance runs through life. Aggelos shares stories, encounters, and small adventures on his way to the theater. As he wanders through downtown Athens, everyday life becomes a stage, and the people he meets illuminate the delicate relationship between art, care, and life itself.

items.title: Known Strangers
items.overview: Three former classmates unexpectedly run into each other during a diner robbery. An awkward reunion between a criminal, a police officer, and a diner employee, as they are faced with the different life paths that have led them there.

items.title: Until Dawn
items.overview: Sixteen-year-old Hamid sits alone on a small boat in the port of Kenitra, surrounded by ships, sirens and screaming seagulls. "Why does everything feel so fake? Am I cursed?" From this haunting opening, the film unfolds in flashbacks, revealing the weeks that brought him to this moment.

items.title: G.O.A.T.
items.overview: A tragicomic road trip set in rural Netherlands about unprocessed trauma, miscommunication, and... a goat.

items.title: A Man's Best Friend
items.overview: Ken’s girlfriend has a new sex toy, a life-size fully-automated (very sexy) manbot. Is he here to replace Ken? Or might he just be his new best friend...

items.title: AMPARO
items.overview: A short film about rupture — about someone who defies the system and reclaims her life. The narrative portrays the everyday oppression of late capitalism, exploring the emotional and physical exhaustion of Alana, who finds refuge and the courage to change in Carol, her girlfriend.

items.title: The Last Pancake
items.overview: A magical-realist drama about Amanda, who ventures to The Last Pancake cafe where she awakens her suppressed appetite, leading to an unexpected reunion with her nine-year-old-self.

items.title: Night Vision
items.overview: Jenny is a young filmmaker searching for inspiration. She falls in love and tells her crush she cannot remember her dreams. Jenny enjoys browsing markets and buys an old video camera at a flea market. She explores the footage on the camera's tape, revealing strange artifacts and surprising presences. What was that appearing on the screen?

items.title: Romance
items.overview: On a strange night, Sarah falls in love with Letícia. This love transports her through a nocturnal city, full of violence, mysteries and desire.

items.title: Ashland
items.overview: Shot on S16mm over the course of 8 years, ASHLAND examines the hopes and dreams of young people, horse whisperers, Indigenous elders, and mystics, all living today in the sacred lands of Eastern Montana.

items.title: Wallander - Steget efter
items.overview: When the Ystad police force is shaken to its core by the discovery of a colleague brutally murdered—making the case deeply personal for Wallander, even as he struggles with a painful separation and his own inner demons.

items.title: Sooriyan Maraindha Maalai
items.overview: In a normal evening during a power cut in Chennai, a freelance Illustrator and a struggling Music Director bump into each other on a terrace. What starts out as silence between two strangers gradually turns into something the two needed to hear.....

items.title: Across the Distance, A Master's Journey
items.overview: Recollection of talking-heads in sharing their memoirs on the remarkable art connoisseur, whom best recognized as a  veteran movie critic, under best reknown among many others psudonyme, 'Tulib', (pronounced 'tew-lib', distancing landscape, loosely literary) as one of the various more other careers as  advertising creative, dramaturge, music appretiator, that garners him as 'walking encyclopedia', with the most exceptional as lecturerer on cinema studies for more than five decades until he had passed away on Oct. 18, 2025.

items.title: Tender Boy
items.overview: Noah and Cody, two young men searching for direction in their lives, form a quiet but powerful bond as their friendship gradually turns into romance. While navigating the pressures of family expectations, social environments, and their own uncertainties about the future, they begin to confront what it means to love openly and honestly. Moments of tenderness and vulnerability shape their relationship, forcing both to face fears about identity, commitment, and belonging. As their connection deepens, each must decide how much they are willing to risk to live authentically and protect the fragile yet transformative love growing between them.

items.title: Walk In The Park
items.overview: Mark and Evelien are the young parents of a very healthy son. Ten fingers, ten toes, all the trimmings, but the sunny outlook is missing. In a world where appearances rule, they have forgotten reality. Life and love are not always fun and the grind lurks like a predator. During eight uncomfortable walks, they try to find out where they took the wrong turn and whether it is even possible to end up on the right path next to each other.

items.title: A Job Well Done
items.overview: In a gritty neighborhood of Geneva, a double-decker bus becomes a refuge where social workers guide refugees through the labyrinth of Swiss asylum laws. On the frontlines of a Kafkaesque struggle, they face ethical dilemmas where compassion clashes with rigid regulations. As frustration turns into determination, solidarity edges closer to illegality, raising a crucial question: when does empathy become a "crime of compassion"?

items.title: Maca and Roni the Movie: The Great Memory Exploration Adventure!
Performance
items.overview: After countless auditions and endless rejections, Franco and Vargas, two aspiring actors and lifelong best friends, decide they've had enough and give up on acting. But what begins as an ordinary night soon takes an unexpected turn when a case of mistaken identity pulls them into a world of crime, danger, and chaos they never saw coming.

items.title: Regarding Memory and Neglect
items.overview: In Brazil, bereaved families from different eras search for the remains of their loved ones and the truth about how they died. In old home movies, the dead come back to life. But even decades later, the authorities would rather keep the facts hidden.

items.title: Ragazzi al fiume
items.overview: Three young Afghan refugees spend a hot summer day by a Swiss river. Against a backdrop of lyrical landscapes and wild waters, a new law on migrant returns threatens their longing for a peaceful and secure existence.

items.title: The Perfect Film
items.overview: Twin film students race against a looming deadline to submit an idea for their short film. But as they chase the idea of creating something “perfect,” every possibility becomes another reason to hesitate.

items.title: La Muerte te Vio Volver
items.overview: After thirty years, Silvia returns to Chiloé to claim an inheritance from her dying mother. There, she reconnects with her sister and a past marked by abandonment and violence. Her mother’s final wishes lead them to embark together on a journey back to the land where she was born.

items.title: Where To?
items.overview: In Berlin's lively nights, Hassan, a Palestinian Uber driver, carries partygoers across the city's endless streets. When Amir, a young Israeli discovering himself far from home, keeps reappearing in his back seat, their late-night rides grow into an unexpected friendship.

items.title: Love Is
items.overview: “An emotion that gives you energy,” “a desperate desire to be with another person,” or perhaps “care, compromise, and awillingness not to put yourself first”? Through observations of urban life, street interviews, and filmed conversations, the film “Love Is” explores the experiencesand attitudes of young people living in Riga towards intimacy, relationships, and love in the age of the internet. The film captures the challenges and peculiarities of forming romantic relationships in today's world, asking young people a simple yet timeless question: What is love?

items.title: A Little Learning Is A Dangerous thing
items.overview: After a series of misfortunes, Michael rents a cheap bedroom and comes to terms with the state of the world, via online encyclopedias and edutainment videos. He becomes fixated on an English businessman who is mismanaging a local lough.

items.title: Crack in the Head, Crack in the Sky
items.overview: A psychiatric ward in a Paris suburb is threatened with closure. Director Mehran Tamadon persuades the medical staff to experiment. Can the patients take over some of the staff's tasks? And is all that sedation really necessary?

items.title: Memotest
items.overview: María, a young musical theatre student, is convinced she’s losing her memory. As she delves deeper into the rehearsals for a new play, her concern grows—along with an unexpected attraction to Mariángeles, the lead actress. Together, they embark on a quest to find a magical solution to María’s problem.

items.title: Palace of Gold
items.overview: The story of New Vrindaban, a Hare Krishna commune in West Virginia that grew into one of America’s largest cults.

items.title: How Much Longer
items.overview: How do you approach life when death is drawing closer and you don't know how much time you have left? Five people with incurable cancer speak directly to the camera, sharing their concerns and questions with their oncologist.

items.title: Somewhere Between Here and There
items.overview: When Mia finds herself at her own wake, dead but not quite gone, she must uncover what’s keeping her tethered and what it truly means to let go.

items.title: Yr Wyddfa
items.overview: An estranged father and daughter climb Yr Wyddfa together. Along the way, it becomes clear why they haven't talked to each other for so long and what occasion brings them together today.

items.title: Collage
items.overview: A girl working in a museum tries to convince a colleague that two visitors are flirting. And how does she know? Scientific studies say six signs show one person's attraction to another.

items.title: The Fountain
items.overview: After losing her parents, 11-year-old Mila moves in with her grandparents. As she adjusts to her new life, a walk in the forest with her grandfather leads to a mystical fountain, which sets her on a journey of healing and belief.

items.title: Memories
items.overview: A location scout searches for a castle and a dilapidated farmhouse, traveling through the French countryside and back in time to her own past.

items.title: Contrition
items.overview: Based on a true story. Damien, a man in his 40s, is haunted by a traumatic childhood event—A violent IRA hostage situation he can't shake. After years of searching, he finally tracks down Brendan, one of the masked men responsible, who is now masquerading as a priest.  Driven by a mix of anger and a desperate need for closure, Damien arrives at Brendan's church, filled with unresolved pain. As the two confront their shared past, the tension escalates, revealing the complex web of guilt, remorse, and the possibility of forgiveness.

items.title: Free Fish
items.overview: Free Fish is a short documentary filmed over the course of a year in Gaza, following two brothers — Abu Nagham and Ahmad — separated by war yet connected by the sea. Displaced from their home, Abu Nagham now lives in a tent in the south, fishing with his young nephew Rami, who lost his twin brother. Ahmad remains in the north, fishing amid ruins and occupation.  Once a source of livelihood and freedom, the sea has become a battleground — heavily restricted, constantly watched, and always dangerous.

items.title: Cyclus
items.overview: Lisa and Marit communicate through a tape. Cyclus explores the subtle red flags of partner abuse (in teenage lives), based on the glorification of romantic ups & downs in modern media.

items.title: Summer
items.overview: Every summer, Francesca (12, Italian) spends time with her Dutch friend Alice (14) in her small Italian village. However, this year something seems to have changed. Alice is different. Older. She is more interested in making friends with the older and seemingly cooler kids in the village, and Francesca feels that they are drifting apart. Whilst Francesca still embraces her childhood, Alice is on the verge of becoming a teenager.

items.title: Kapan Punya Anak?
items.overview: The marriage of Alma and Pandu is constantly haunted by the question of when they will have children—a question that, as we all know, has no answer.

items.title: It's Gonna Rain
items.overview: A meditative reflection on the quiet absurdity of everyday life, exploring the fragile, fleeting connections that bind us within suburban spaces. Drifting through a series of surreal yet human moments, the film follows an ensemble of characters: two aging philosophers debating aliens from the depths of a kiddie pool, two pirates inexplicably destined for friendship, lovers attempting to reignite their spark through backyard karate, and a solitary dancer who dons a feline disguise to embrace his truest self.

items.title: SOS Mother
items.overview: How emotionally and practically challenging is it to be a professional mother? Is it possible to form a maternal bond with children who hope to return to their own families? “SOS Mother” takes a look inside the SOS Children’s Village in Valmiera, following the relationships between the SOS moms and the children—the stern scoldings, the warm hugs, and the caring glances.

items.title: Up in the Air
items.overview: Nine-year-old Sasha is put through rigorous training in aerial acrobatics at a circus in Ukraine. When the company flees the war and relocates to Budapest, not only are his surroundings changed, but also his motivation to perform.

items.title: One of Those Nights
items.overview: Damien returns home after being away, only to discover that his neighbor is hosting a party in the apartment across the hall. Unable to sleep because of the noise, he finds himself facing an unusual night—one heavy with regrets…

items.title: Hij komt, hij komt, ... intrede van de Sint
Nininbaori
items.overview: Follows three para-climbers through fragments of their daily lives, where ordinary domestic gestures intertwine with the quiet precision of athletic practice. Moving seamlessly from one to the next, the film refuses hierarchy, unfolding instead like the pages of a single book written by multiple hands.

items.title: Printed in Gray
items.overview: During the immediate aftermath of a local school shooting, three journalists decide what must be done with the photos.

items.title: The Voicenote
items.overview: A woman sends a voicenote to a friend she has been meaning to reach out to. As we follow the journey of the message, we see her friend descending into crisis. We can only hope that she gets the message before it's too late, be it this world or the next.

items.title: Rahma
items.overview: For nine years, İbrahim and Meryem have longed to become parents. After five unsuccessful IVF attempts, İbrahim turns to traditional remedies, while Meryem considers surrogacy in Georgia. Adoption is unthinkable for her.

items.title: Izolyatsia
items.overview: «Izolyatsia» was a major art center in Eastern Europe, was transformed into a prison and torture camp after Russia's 2014 occupation of Donetsk. This film examines survivor testimonies, revealing the tragic dehumanization of a place once dedicated to art.

items.title: Honk
items.overview: When a very serious man is born in the body of a clown, he must work to overcome other’s preconceived notions about him and show the world who he really is.

items.title: Disturbia
items.overview: Before our very eyes a strange human-bird hybrid undergoes constant transformation to cope with the omnipresent tensions of economical, ideological, military, and climatic threats.

items.title: Talking Stocks
items.overview: Two amateur podcasters must decide how far they will go for content when a Trump-loving Singaporean guest derails their show. Meanwhile, the Liberation Day tariffs inch closer.

items.title: Beauty Is The Terror We Can Bear
items.overview: A controversial performance at a DIY art space divides a close-knit community.

items.title: Circling Worlds, Circling Words
items.overview: Marking the centenary of the Japan Writers' Association, this documentary follows writers of different generations through everyday life and creative work, asking what sustains their commitment to writing.

items.title: Ode (An Acknowledgement of Sea Country)
items.overview: Ode is a cameraless animation made from handmade macroalgae celluloid. Developed with CSIRO and marine scientists, it uses contact printing, botanicollage, and seaweed bio-sonification to explore post-petrochemical cinema. Lasting 365 seconds, the film offers an ocean-responsive meditation on deep time, material intelligence, and more-than-human collaboration.

items.title: The Big Boom!
items.overview: In Kazanlak, Bulgaria’s “Valley of Roses,” a town not far from Ukraine is home to a weapons factory supplying the frontlines, where residents, torn between economic survival and personal loyalties, live with the uneasy contradiction of a war that challenges their beliefs, while still longing for peace.

items.title: Spectators
items.overview: In the summer of 1941, German troops began a series of mass executions in the Latvian coastal city of Liepāja. Over the course of several months, firing squads killed over 5,000 Jews there. A German soldier filmed one of these executions.  The footage surfaced after the War. These roughly 90 seconds of found footage, believed to be the only surviving film record of mass executions of Jews by the Einsatzgruppen, form the source material for this chilling film.

items.title: Toomas Leius. Life On The Line
items.overview: The contrasting extremes in the life of Toomas Leius, Estonia’s greatest male tennis player of all time.  On the one hand, a successful sporting career, including victories on Wimbledon’s famous all-white tennis courts. On the other, a dark personal tragedy involving the murder of his wife and years spent in a harsh and unforgiving Soviet prison. Tomas Leius’ subsequent life became a stark fusion of the Wimbledon white and the repressive black of fate – floating between two worlds, both in exile and at home, both integrated into society and marginalised, a legend to some, a murderer to others.  A white line ran through Toomas Leius’ entire life and career, defining and determining his highs and lows. On which side of the line does his legacy lie? In the annals of sporting history, or rather in the crime columns? And is it at all possible to reconcile these opposing sides?

items.title: The Last Rehearsal
items.overview: A beloved acting teacher rallies his favourite students one last time to stage his final play.

items.title: Bystander
items.overview: Across a series of everyday settings - a bus stop late at night, a locker room after a match, an online gaming session, an open-plan office - we witness subtle but recognisable moments of harassment and boundary-crossing behaviour directed towards women. Nothing heightened. Nothing dramatised beyond reality. Just the familiar discomfort of something not quite right.

items.title: Veil of Silence
items.overview: A crumbling relationship where two people are too afraid to face their problems. Gemma silently drifts through her inner world, where her ego confronts her.

items.title: Your Daughter
items.overview: Born in Cairo into a family of filmmakers, the director grew up between a mother absorbed by her work and nannies who provided her with emotional care. Her mother, the niece of Egyptian filmmaker Youssef Chahine, devoted her life to cinema, leaving behind a sense of absence throughout her childhood. As she prepares to become a mother herself, she questions her mother’s life choices and the price of her emancipation.

items.title: Hold Your Breath
items.overview: Mentally exhausted Ukrainian soldiers spend a few weeks away from the frontline before returning to war. In this psychological limbo, their reflections reveal how deeply the war has changed them, leaving scars they will carry for life.

items.title: Light Falling Down
items.overview: Set near the Treblinka death camp in Nazi-occupied Poland, a reclusive farmwoman risks everything to shelter a young Jewish girl in hiding.

items.title: Lost Dog
items.overview: Two hapless weirdos join forces to search for their respective lost dogs, but all is not as it seems.

items.title: Love & Loss
items.overview: After crossing the English Channel illegally with his family, asylum seeker Abdel Hassan is brought to an interrogation room to be interviewed by case worker Oliver.

items.title: Human.ID
items.overview: Human Identity is a 5-minute extended reality (XR) project that plunges viewers into a near-future digital ecosystem question, and redefine the boundaries of human identity and consciousness.

items.title: Water Valley
items.overview: A man leaves the city to seek isolation after a bad fight with his partner. He decides to spend the night at his family's cabin, upon waking up he finds himself in the middle of the forest.

items.title: ALMA
items.overview: A fictionalised retelling of the real life escape stories of three generations of women, beginning with a young girl who fled Poland at the breakout of the second world war.

items.title: Stream
items.overview: An 1860 inquiry into 100 ancient stone mounds found along the northeastern shores of Lake Ontario is inconclusive. A collection of insecure IP camera feeds from around the globe, sprawling and invasive, may broadcast forever. Human history is collapsed and compressed with the end signalled by a catgirl VTuber. A video of unknowable insides projected alongside auto-translated tweets and soundtracked by buffering twitch streams.

items.title: Kus tēg ūotõ? Kur jūs esat?
items.overview: Sofija is a 17-year-old Livonian - a speaker of a language that's spoken by only about 30 others in the world these days, and none of them - natively. She travels around the ancient Livonian shore on her bike, looking for other language-speakers, wondering about how nice it would have been to be born earlier, to meet more of them. Sofija documents her trip in a video diary that captures the people she meets and has a chat in Livonian with, and questions her identity - what is it that she's finding in the language of her ancestors.

items.title: The Border Czar
items.overview: After delivering a rousing speech on immigration, Rep. Jim Coolidge goes to sleep - only to wake up on the wrong side of the border.

items.title: Hello, I'm Amy
items.overview: When Amy struggles with an online job interview, she must decide whether to persevere or quit

items.title: The Market
items.overview: In a rural Philippine market, a street dog scavenges for scraps while a mother and son, fleeing Canada, search for a fresh start. All are torn apart by their own kind, one for stolen meat, the others for a debt that can never be paid.

items.title: Extra-Terrestrial Haunting
items.overview: A group of dedicated ghost hunters are dismayed when their desperate attempt to summon ghosts goes wrong, and all they encounter are aliens.

items.title: Songs of the Quickdraw Animation Society
items.overview: The Quickdraw Animation Society stands tenaciously and single-mindedly for the notion that animation is an art form and that animation should be practised and taught as an art. It continues to act as an irresistible magnet for people with passion and it continues to craft an atmosphere that converts that passion into getting good stuff done. This feature-length documentary marks the 40th anniversary of the place where that good stuff gets done, investigating how the society kept going making and celebrating the art of animation. The story is told through archive footage, film and video clips, and old and new interviews of QAS members.

items.title: From State Lines
items.overview: After receiving a call about her father’s health, Kat, a small-town Arkansan work-staying at a hostel in Northern California, is forced to finally ask herself if this is where she’s meant to be.

items.title: Palingon
items.overview: In Barangay Palingon, a paralyzed father and his community live with floodwaters that have become part of daily life. Through their wooden walkways, fragile routines, and calls for lasting solutions, the documentary reveals how survival becomes ordinary when neglect becomes permanent.

items.title: PLAY DEAD
items.overview: He agrees to play an unusual game for his girlfriend, but disturbing recordings and unsettling messages reveal something far more sinister beneath the surface.  Some games should never be played.

items.title: Carrie the Cavity
items.overview: Ripped from Marine's mouth by a shady dentist, Carrie the Cavity dives into her victim's body, and proceeds to wreak havoc down in the "stomach-city".

items.title: In Transit
items.overview: Late one night, rideshare driver Ayaan Malik accepts what appears to be an ordinary request. But when his mysterious passenger refuses to provide a destination, a routine ride descends into an unsettling journey through empty streets, repeating roads, and a reality that no longer makes sense.  As the night unfolds, Ayaan begins to question everything around him—including the passenger in his back seat, the city outside his window, and whether some rides are meant to end at all.  IN TRANSIT is a psychological thriller exploring isolation, choice, and the terrifying possibility that some paths cannot be escaped once they're taken.

items.title: Peeple
items.overview: In 2004, a mishap in a South Korean kindergarten is rebranded as a "collective urination incident". This mixed-media satire reveals how media manipulation weaponizes trivial everyday occurrences.

items.title: To You in the Future
items.overview: This film documents the lives of people in some of Taiwan’s areas worst affected by air pollution—Taichung, Taixi Village in Dacheng Township, Changhua County, and Dalinpu in Kaohsiung. It also gives voice to farmers and fishers forced to bear the costs of hastily implemented policies in the transition to cleaner energy. The film asks: What does energy transition truly mean? As the world confronts intensifying global warming and climate disasters, what future awaits us and the generations to come?

items.title: Cállese el Hocico
items.overview: A young girl watches as the adults who lecture her about morality justify everyday bribery, theft, and abuse through silence. In a world where staying quiet is the rule, corruption isn’t questioned — it’s learned.

items.title: One Year
items.overview: Nick and Lottie escape to a secluded cabin to celebrate their first wedding anniversary. As they begin dreaming about the future, their lives change in an instant.

items.title: Lollipop
items.overview: Lollipop is a stylistic 2d animated Drama which deals with childhood Trauma. It is the story of G, a balloon seller in a carnival who was a victim of child abuse. One day he gets a chance to repeat this abuse. The question is, will G continue the cycle of abuse or chose to break it.

items.title: Happening and H...
items.overview: After her parents’ divorce, Choi has not seen her biological mother. Learning her family’s history from her father, she wonders if her mother had unavoidable circumstances, and sets out to reclaim her own history.

items.title: Lotus
items.overview: A breast cancer survivor is being manipulated by male doctors into undergoing breast implant surgery. Confused by these manipulations, she decides to have breast surgery. In the waiting room of the plastic surgeon's office, she visits with her husband, and the universe will send her a message.

items.title: Project Utopia
items.overview: Maverick inventor Joaquín Fargas creates a robotic caterpillar which harvests water from the air to help communities impacted by lithium mining in Argentina – breaking boundaries between art and science along the way.

items.title: Ensmoothening
items.overview: Visualize an Earth of such tranquility and peace in nature that it must be the true marvel of all the ages. A land for forever, smoothened and sterilized. That's the Dream! Yes! A smooth plastic-coated marble world!

items.title: Deaflympics Stories
items.overview: Japan's women's deaf football team and men's deaf handball team prepare for the Tokyo 2025 Deaflympics. Their different ambitions-winning a title and securing a first victory-frame a documentary about competition and communication among athletes with varied hearing experiences.

items.title: Almi Jhon
items.overview: When you feel the weight of the system upon your shoulders and the hand of death grasping your neck, Almi Jhon is there so you can keep producing! Remember, if you want to be someone, first you have to be Almi Jhon!

items.title: Manual Para Sobrevivir Siendo Callejero
items.overview: Follows brothers Ulises and Octavio as they infiltrate their former high school now a stronghold for organized crime, in a desperate search for their missing father. After being captured by a hitman, their only hope emerges from the most unexpected source: two stray dogs enhanced with biotechnological implants that become their refuge, their mirror, and their allies. With their family’s life on the line, Octavio must confront the traumas of his past and make a decision that will transform his destiny forever.

items.title: I Love You Too
items.overview: Ryan and Haven are a newly together couple and after Haven tells Ryan she is in love with him he must figure what love means and if he feels that way for her while she must try not to succumb to the pressure of not knowing his answer.

items.title: Chewing Gum
items.overview: Short animated film about a chewing gum terrified of the moment someone finally chews it. But once it happens, the unpleasant experience unexpectedly turns into pleasure, gradually becoming an obsession with being chewed again and again.

items.title: Paperlight
items.overview: An accident in the classroom turns disaster into two children at the beginning of a creative game, where their differences lead them to transform mistakes in a shared universe full of imagination.

items.title: Faceless People - The Journey of Sri Lankan Tamil Refugees in India
items.overview: Six Sri Lankan Tamil refugees living in India, from different age groups, speak about their life in camps, and their hopes and aspirations. For over three decades, Sri Lankan Tamil refugees have lived in Tamil Nadu in a protracted situation—without certainty about their future and without viable policy solutions. Three generations have grown up with aspirations they cannot fulfil, surviving through sheer resilience while quietly contributing to the economy of their host communities.

items.title: Primitive
items.overview: The story is about a cow painted on a cave rock that escapes from humans but encounters another tribe, and eventually the two tribes destroy each other and the cow is saved.

items.title: Sally and The Girls Next Door
items.overview: Sally, a highschooler trapped in her home life goes on a short but meaningful adventure with her friends where her life starts to change.

items.title: Buskers of Porto
items.overview: "Buskers of Porto" shows how the city and its musicians are intertwined. The documentary is a journey through the streets of Porto and along the many street musicians that enrich this city with their music. They share intimate stories about their work on the streets and the freedom they experience, but also about the challenges that it brings along with it. "Buskers of Porto" is a connecting film about music, dreams, and survival.

items.title: Vuelo en Pausa
items.overview: A bird whose wing suddenly begins to deform into cardboard until he can no longer fly, struggles to adapt to his new life.

items.title: Puma Matriarchs of Torres Del Paine
items.overview: The film chronicles the lives of three mother Pumas (aka Mountain Lions, Cougars) as they survive and thrive in the rugged terrain of Chilean Patagonia. These three matriarchs, Sarmiento, Rupestra and Petaca, drive the dynamics of living and dominating their respective territories. Raising their kits, teaching them how to catch prey and hunting that prey increase these cats’ chances of surviving in this beautiful but challenging habitat.

items.title: The Boy With The Balloon Heart
items.overview: Born with a balloon heart, a wide-eyed, dreamy and emotional boy drifts through life, never quite able to find where he belongs. His delicate, floating heart sets him apart—both a gift and a burden in a world that values groundedness, practicality and conformity. As he stumbles through life grappling against the weight of existence, he struggles with loneliness and the bane of being different. But one day, a quiet revelation shows him that what once felt like a flaw might be the very thing that sets him free.

items.title: Negro
items.overview: It addresses environmental issues by following the life of a dog living in an open-air landfill, a creature that suffers the effects of pollution and habitat displacement caused by so-called "progress" and changes in land use. The subject matter is inspired by events in Tizayuca, Hidalgo—where I lived—an area undergoing constant urban growth where open plains and fields are being transformed.

items.title: Monster Mati Lampu
items.overview: A man is unable to sleep during a total power outage in his city; while trying to drift off, he hears something and decides to record it as evidence.

items.title: Christmas in the Tropics
items.overview: A content creator returns to Jamaica to save her family's failing spice business, but an unexpected romance with the man holding its future forces her to choose between love and legacy.

items.title: Nightfighting
items.overview: A young boxer is set up for a strange fight by his shady coach.

items.title: Juniper Seed
items.overview: When nine-year-old Süleyman realizes his chicken, Şalgam, has fallen into a well, he descends into the deep darkness to save her. As he was waiting to be rescued, his 70-year-old forester grandfather gives him inspiration through stories of juniper seeds, birds and trees, encouraging him while revealing the true meaning of connecting with nature. Bringing together roots, love and the wisdom of nature, this journey explores the deep connections between humans and nature.

items.title: STARS
items.overview: (Based on the album made by TylerSkittles)  a burning glitchy 20 min film of you as a man in space, watching the glitches of life around you

items.title: Cat Ba Dream
items.overview: A filmmaker finds herself documenting not only a landscape, but its disappearance.

items.title: My Chicken
items.overview: When a little girl learns her pet chicken is meant to be Christmas dinner, she tries her best to save it.

items.title: If you love me
items.overview: Léo meets Ana by chance in a park. Neither of them knows it yet, but from now on, nothing will ever be the same.

items.title: Salda: A bridge to the Red Planet
items.overview: Spanning from Turkey to the United States, from the white shores of Lake Salda to NASA’s Mars explorations, the documentary uncovers the scientific link between Earth and the Red Planet. Guided by scientists investigating the depths and microbial life of Salda, it sheds light on how the lake’s similarity to Jezero Crater on Mars helps search for traces of ancient life. This journey bridges fundamental questions about the origins of life with an urgent call to preserve Salda’s unique ecosystem.

items.title: Andy, the Crux Isn't Always on the Wall
items.overview: After getting surgery and other treatments for endometriosis Svana's goal is to keep pushing her limits in climbing, while still fighting this disease that has no cure.

items.title: What Will PepeLand 11 Be Like
items.overview: This documentary pulls back the curtain on the behind-the-scenes preparations for the launch of PepeLand’s eleventh season. Its creator shares new features for the players, examines the mistakes of the past, and unveils a new community philosophy that shifts the focus from colossal builds to sincere creativity and collaborative content creation.

items.title: Last Summer in the Antarctica
items.overview: At an Argentine base in Antarctica, Irina, a scientist, begins receiving mysterious signals during Argentina’s matches in the 2022 World Cup. Isolated from the collective excitement, while her family tries to reach her from afar and focused entirely on her work, she uses these signals to assemble a machine, though she does not know its purpose. On the day of the grand World Cup final, Irina activates the machine, and something extraordinary happens.

items.title: Rejoice
items.overview: There lives a little, carefree girl named Maria, for whom a great purpose is ordained in the history of humanity. As she gradually grows older, the heroine gathers in her heart words that reveal the meaning of her future.

items.title: CHANT
items.overview: After his girlfriend goes missing under mysterious circumstances, Mitch hatches a deranged plan to figure out the truth around her disappearance.  CHANT was created in 48 hours as an entry for the SAITSA FPS F48 Film Challenge.

items.title: Dianthus
items.overview: After becoming an orphan, eight-year-old Dean brings his mother back from the afterlife, violating the laws of existence. This distorts the boundary between worlds. Mother and son long to be a family, but reality begins to crumble. Dean faces a choice: hold on to his mother, or save both worlds.

items.title: Andrew Ganvickton
items.overview: Andrew Ganvickton is a surreal, body-horror comedy short from Adult Swim Smalls created by brothers Joe and Charlie Pelling. The story follows a man whose routine doctor's appointment for persistent back pain takes an absurd turn when the doctor reveals the issue is actually an entity living inside him.

items.title: From Round Here with Pete Elsewhere
items.overview: Pete Elsewhere is a self-proclaimed visionary living on the fringes of modern London. Through a series of increasingly questionable encounters - from unsolicited hot takes on AI to a tour of his crumbling flat, an introduction to his weirdo housemate DERP, and an ill-fated day at the skatepark - a documentary crew attempts to understand the man behind the myth. Blending stylised motion-capture animation with deadpan British humour, Pete Elsewhere is a mockumentary about the strange optimism of people who refuse to stop believing in themselves.

items.title: Ghosting
items.overview: A woman's husband returns from the dead—to ask for a divorce.

items.title: Exp horror
items.overview: experimental short horror film. Sometimes, it is better not to know what lurks inside people's heads...  I have a passion for horror and the avant-garde, and I blended these two directions in this work. Here, I experiment with light flickering and explore my own signature style in sound design—for my future masterpieces...

items.title: Millie & The Milkman
items.overview: In the wake of a mysterious incident, a pensive woman becomes trapped inside of her own mind, imprisoned by memories of special moments shared with her milkman.

items.title: America the Beautiful
items.overview: Takes audiences on an immersive journey through America's most breathtaking landscapes, diverse wildlife, and vital ecosystems, celebrating the natural beauty that unites us all.

items.title: The City and the City
items.overview: Unfolding across a vast desert, the film follows a group of soldiers who watch and wait for an event that may never occur. Their presence produces a peculiar contradiction: the landscape appears empty, yet it is continuously guarded. Time stretches around this possibility, turning the seemingly empty landscape into a space charged with anticipation and vigilance. Waiting becomes a form of labour, while vigilance becomes a way of inhabiting territory.

items.title: Amanat
items.overview: In southern Kyrgyzstan, the ancient walnut forests of Arslanbob hold a memory that spans generations. Roots, seeds, voices, dreams, and bodies become traces of knowledge passed down through time, while the landscape bears the scars of Soviet transformations, exploitation, and climate change. Through imagery and an immersive soundscape, Amanat enters the forest as a living archive, suspended between legend and reality, between what we inherit and what we are entrusted to preserve.

items.title: The Silent Seat
items.overview: Following the death of their friend Liora, Cassia, Serena, Mitch, and Maeve are handed Liora's suicide note. Having to confront their feelings and opinions, some truths are revealed about the weight each of the friends carry with themselves. At a moment where they all feared judgement, they were left with nothing short of a stronger bond.

items.title: Caught Cold
items.overview: A young boxer prepares for her last shot at the title when, at the last moment, her opponent is switched, causing echoes of her past to be dragged into the ring with her.

items.title: Our Village from the Moon
items.overview: In the aftermath of the 2023 earthquakes in Turkey, children move through the ruins of a Kurdish village, turning destruction into a terrain of play and imagination. They dream of travelling to the moon, where their village, its ruins, and the pain they hold might appear smaller.

items.title: Silence
items.overview: A screenwriter in debt is pressured by two mobsters to finish his script. He's going to resort to a mysterious synthetic drug that may help him complete it.

items.title: Trabalho de Conclusão de Curso - O jogo como arte
Aadi Anant
items.overview: The story explores the emotional bond and generational gap between a devoted, elderly retired postmaster.

items.title: (Du) Coup Des Images
items.overview: Juxtaposing justice and violence with the story of The Three Little Pigs.

items.title: Rare as F@*k
items.overview: As college nears, designer Mindy Scheier clashes with her 17-year-old son Oliver over his independence. His degenerative condition increasingly limits him. Mindy creates Runway of Dreams, a Fashion Week show for adaptive design.

items.title: Storyboard Surah
items.overview: Perched on a bench through changing seasons, a bird named Pun watches as other birds forage and sing. All the while, verses from Surah Al-Asr and illustrated Quran lessons slowly reshape his understanding of time, life, and the world around him.

items.title: The Nestling
items.overview: After being displaced by wildfires and forced indoors due to air toxicity, an aspiring dancer takes a pet-sitting gig in a stranger's apartment, only to find hidden cameras, a missing cat, and a growing fear that she's not alone.

items.title: Тайке
items.overview: No description

items.title: Wooden Horse
items.overview: A young equestrian is torn between freedom and forbidden passion when captured and bound by a troubled recluse.

items.title: The Tuna Truth
items.overview: Journey with popular Chef, Serena Appleby, as she delves into the hidden depths of tuna fishing and discovers how we can make more sustainable and informed choices about the food we eat.

items.title: Pengin
items.overview: Tragic interaction between two friends struggling with life, which leads them to a difficult altercation.

items.title: Another Body
items.overview: Aurora, a 19 years old italian girl, is an art student in Florence. We’ll follow her into a day in her life in which she’s forced to come across problems provoked by her Eating disorder. She’ll be haunted by it through a marble statue

items.title: As July Ebbed into My August
items.overview: A young woman waits for her best friend to arrive back home in Novaliches. When the rainy season grows stronger, she goes around with an umbrella  on-hand to look for her. Their inevitable meeting will solidify their ever-growing connection, one that is tender and embedded in memory.

items.title: Işığın Daveti
items.overview: In a moonlit forest, a woman in a flowing red dress is drawn toward a mysterious light illuminating a winding path through the trees. A short visual journey into an enchanted landscape.

items.title: Mother Tongue
items.overview: During a Q&A where he serves as an interpreter for a film director, Ron briefly experiences the spotlight. Unable to let the feeling go, his conflict with the Brazilian director deepens as similarities between them emerge. The following day, during a live television interview, Ron makes a decision in an attempt to put himself at the center.

items.title: Phunjo
items.overview: Six years after setting her first world record on Mount Everest in 2018, Phunjo Jhangmu Lama aims to reach the summit in under 20 hours.

items.title: Christmas at Moose Lake
items.overview: When successful New Yorker Alyssa Dawson retreats to her family's lakeside cabin for Christmas to heal from a painful breakup, she is forced to confront shifting family dynamics and past grief. She connects with Sean and finds a Christmas spark of her own.
stream: Great American Pure Flix Amazon Channel

items.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
items.overview: After inheriting her uncle's struggling Christmas-themed bar, a Manhattan businesswoman competes with a rival club owner in a series of holiday challenges, only to find herself falling for him.

items.title: Pop Pop
items.overview: Dustin and Dibz survived their senior year of college and their future looks bright. But can they also survive cancel culture? The Manosphere? Neo-n*zis? THE 2016 ELECTION?! Will they ever discover how to be Real Live Grown Up Men in Society? Probs not.

items.title: I Am Not The Last
items.overview: Marooned by time and place in a natural world untouched by humankind, a refugee mother and her young son live alone in a mysterious sphere. The boy has never seen another human and fearing the inevitable solitude of outliving his mother, he refuses to believe they are alone.

items.title: Waterlanders
items.overview: In a flood-ravaged Netherlands. A father and his teenage daughter survive in isolation aboard an off-grid ship, cut off from a world shaped by floods & war. When a shellshocked soldier appears, claiming peace has returned, the father faces an impossible choice: trust a stranger and risk everything ... or protect his daughter at the cost of his humanity.

items.title: Em & Selma Go Griffin Hunting
items.overview: In the Depression-ravaged countryside of 1930s America, adolescent girls are expected to fulfill a long-standing rite in which they hunt and slay a mythical beast of their mother’s choosing.

items.title: Divine Direction
items.overview: A pastor grapples with his faith as his son battles a rare form of kidney cancer.

items.title: Kidney
items.overview: In a remote village, two rival families – one privileged Hindu, the other a struggling Muslim family – are trapped in an endless cycle of feuds. A young man dreaming of TikTok fame and a woman yearning to escape patriarchy fall in love. When an inheritance dispute erupts, their relationship is caught between greed, betrayal, and a conflict that threatens to turn blood against blood.

items.title: Gnocchi
items.overview: After an embarrassing mispronunciation of the word “gnocchi”, Emma decides to leave society behind and start a self-sufficient life in the woods, but even there, her obsession continues to haunt her.

items.title: Inside the Mind of Quentin Tarantino
items.overview: Quentin Tarantino is one of the most successful and influential Hollywood directors of the last thirty years. This documentary takes a fresh look at the director of cult hits such as “Reservoir Dogs” and “Pulp Fiction” and reveals how Tarantino’s films are deeply linked to his life story.

items.title: The New Extinction
items.overview: Egos, money and science intersect in this modern American parable that follows the king of the dinosaurs and those who unearth its remains. Paleontologist Dr. Thomas Carr hopes his latest find, a juvenile T. rex, can keep his crucial research alive as he navigates the crumbling world of academia and relentless funding pressure. Meanwhile, commercial fossil hunter Alan Detrich leads multimillion-dollar dinosaur auctions and teams up with a Kansas museum to show off a T. rex specimen so rare it could change the face of prehistory. As these two titans of paleontology clash, we are confronted with two paths for the future of science: raw capitalism or putting collective knowledge before the pursuit of profit.

items.title: Terry McMillan Presents: Paradise with You
items.overview: NFL star Carter retreats to Nevis before retirement and meets Simone, an interior decorator recovering from betrayal. Their island romance turns complicated when both want the same estate, forcing a choice between love and ambition.

items.title: Not All The Girls
items.overview: While trying to explain to her seven-year-old son what it was like to grow up in Chile under the civil-military dictatorship, a mother is confronted with her own memories and the need to revisit her past.  After almost twenty years living in Spain, she decides to find women who, like her, were born and spent their early years under the Chilean dictatorship. Andrea, Claudia, Alejandra, Daniela, Victoria and Sol gather in a house to share their experiences and explore how that early experience — often fragmented or beyond conscious memory — has left marks that remain present in their lives.  In this encounter, the personal and the political intertwine, giving rise to a collective reflection on memory, identity, and the ways in which the past transforms and endures from one generation to another.

items.title: Fatma Said and the Abdelwahab Plan
items.overview: The film bears a joint Egyptian-German character, and through its title and artistic journey, it provides a space to celebrate one of the most prominent figures of Arab music, composer Mohamed Abdel Wahab, and to explore his musical legacy and influence, with the participation of Fatma Said, who is considered one of the most prominent Egyptian voices in the world of opera and classical singing globally blending cinematic and musical language.

items.title: A Time in Eternity
items.overview: A woman embarks on an unyielding and possibly hopeless search for her missing husband, a journey that strains her already fragile relationship with her daughter. Along the way, she also faces the unwelcome advances of her persistent brother-in-law.

items.title: Grace
items.overview: Grace is a poignant coming of age drama centered on a woman in her late 20s with Down Syndrome, navigating the complexities of adulthood, independence and first love from within a residential support house. When Grace pushes the boundaries set for her, the consequences ripple through her carefully managed world.

items.title: Between Revolutions
items.overview: In Berlin, a diverse coalition of activists joins forces to speak out against the violence in Gaza and the German government’s support for it. Faced with arrests, possible deportations, and strict restrictions on protests, the activists seek ways to continue their struggle. In this climate, they start rehearsing a stage adaptation of a 1970s queer book entitled The Faggots and Their Friends Between Revolutions. This hybrid and experimental film shifts between rehearsals of the play and the everyday reality of activism. Passages from the play—about power structures, exclusion, and solidarity—are interwoven with their ongoing protests and their sometimes sympathetic, sometimes confrontational conversations with the press. Juxtaposed, the intensity of protest and the creative freedom of theater sharpen the focus on what it means to be an activist—and the toll it takes on those involved.

items.title: A Modern Roma Fairytale
items.overview: As the granddaughter of a Roma king, ten-year-old Nicoleta seems destined for a fairy-tale life. She will marry young and live in a palace. But looking at her grandmother, mother, and aunt, she also sees a traditional life constrained by patriarchy.

items.title: Biggest Thing in the World
items.overview: Pi is on a long, long summer vacation. He is learning about the special things that surround him. What is the stinkiest thing? The priciest? The prettiest…and what is the biggest thing in the world?

items.title: Exit
items.overview: A short film produced by the 2nd Unit Class at SZFE.

items.title: Blood Runner
items.overview: When Leila is dispatched to deliver blood for a patient suffering from a gunshot wound, the mission begins to mirror her own trauma. The past and present collapse into each other and her urgency becomes charged with survivor’s guilt and the fear of another irreversible loss.

items.title: _Preview_
items.overview: A theatre critic interviews the first AI to have an original play open on Broadway.

items.title: Mimetica
items.overview: A broken-hearted man takes a bizarre offer from an accordion shop owner to reconnect with his ex-girlfriend.

items.title: Todd & The Toad
items.overview: Anxious, awkward, and terminally avoidant, Todd is a man paralyzed by social anxiety. When pressure mounts from Polly—a girl he’s been messaging online—to finally meet in person, Todd spirals into neurotic panic. To cope with this, he find’s a hint in the darknet, that takes him to lick a mysterious toad... only to awaken in a bizarre therapy session with Juan Carlos (aka JC)—a charismatic, hallucination-induced psychologist claiming to be part of Todd's “corrective experience.”

items.title: Probation
items.overview: After a life crisis, Li Xiang and a rookie lawyer set out to prove her good deed was right, reuniting with three high-school friends who help her seek the truth, heal old regrets, and warm a cold legal process with friendship.

items.title: Waves of Time
items.overview: Following the final voyage of the enormous, ageing cruise ship Royal Splendor through the Three Gorges on the Yangtze, this experimental film explores the river as a living repository of memory.

items.title: Antisémitisme, une haine toujours en mouvements
Calamity
items.overview: Haunted by the trauma of his past, a troubled police officer must confront his own demons as he hunts down a ruthless killer, risking his sanity as the line between justice and obsession begins to blur.

items.title: I Just Want to Talk to My Mom
items.overview: An Iranian actress living in Istanbul tries to reach her mother in Iran during the recent events in Iran, marked by conflict, political tensions, and internet shutdowns. As communication lines collapse, she finds herself trapped between fear, uncertainty, and the painful distance separating her from the person she loves most. A personal journey about family, borders, and the universal human need to be heard.

items.title: Who Are You?
items.overview: An ordinary night turns into a living nightmare when a 14-year-old boy hears a sharp tap on his bedroom window.  Outside in the freezing air stands a breathless stranger, desperately running from the police. With sirens wailing in the distance, a terrifying standoff begins through the glass. Safe inside but completely isolated, the boy faces an impossible, split-second choice that will instantly shatter the security of his home.

items.title: Fido
items.overview: A young girl watches an old dog. Taking the dog on a walk, a rough encounter with a bully has dire consequences.

items.title: Patlang (Gap)
items.overview: A young Deaf artist struggling to connect with her mother finds an unexpected bridge through friendship, art, and Filipino Sign Language, forcing her to confront their widening distance.

items.title: The Boot Room
items.overview: A junior footballer navigates the brutal hierarchy of a 1988 professional football club steeped in a culture of systemic bullying . His growing unease culminates in a hesitant act of defiance sparking a brutal backlash, turning the violence directly onto him.

items.title: Appearances Can Be Deceiving
items.overview: Bruna, the country’s most powerful and sought-after influencer—untouchable, just like the biggest icons. Suzy is a fan; the kind who follows every single story. It was already a miracle having her idol staying at the hotel where she works, but fate leads her to an even more unlikely scenario. When Amanda, an up-and-coming influencer, suffers an allergic reaction, it is Suzy — her perfect lookalike — who steps into her shoes. Shining in this new identity, Suzy finds an unexpected romance with Bruna.

items.title: White as Salt
items.overview: Turkey's shimmering Tuz Lake, the country's second-largest lake, supplies 70% of its salt, even as its waters recede due to climate change. Here villagers still harvest pure, untreated salt. For widower Salih, salt is more than a livelihood – it's survival. Before dawn, he rides out on his loyal horse Fedai with his daughter Zeliş, gathering salt at sunrise and sharing the harvest with neighbours. But when Salih's friend Muhtar yields to the mayor's orders and a greedy corporation claims the lake's salt rights, villagers are barred from the shore and threatened with losing their horses. Salih refuses to give in. He makes forbidden journeys, devises schemes to outwit the ever-watchful gendarmes, and relies on his honest heart and loyal accomplices.

items.title: Al Tiempo le da Hipo
items.overview: The quest for a lost cyberpunk book written in the 1990s by Pepe Rojo, rumored to be a prophetic work of its time. After uncovering new leads, an obsessed young man embarks on a journey across northern Mexico to track down the remaining fragments and fuel his own delusion.

items.title: Augusta 2049: A Street Named Sin
items.overview: Augusta Street, São Paulo, near future. Amid neon and underpaid gigs claimed by robots and cyborgs, a lonely android wanders in search of a pleasure it may never have been programmed to feel.

items.title: Third Act
items.overview: Third Act traces the remarkable journey of Aleksandar Antonijević, a former principal dancer with the National Ballet of Canada, who returns to his hometown of Novi Sad after more than two decades of an international career. Having never performed on the stage of his hometown, Antonijević takes on a new challenge: creating his own interpretation of Giselle at the Serbian National Theatre.
