His return brings him face to face with a traditional and often resistant artistic environment, where new perspectives challenge deeply rooted conventions. Through his personal story and the creative process leading up to the premiere, the film explores themes of identity, artistic legacy, resistance to change, and the complexities of returning home.

items.title: The Grim Rapper
items.overview: Rap icon D.A. Mann is murdered at the height of his fame and returns from the dead three decades later after forging a dark pact with a blood demon and unleashes a wave of supernatural retribution wielding a cursed boombox in this dark action fantasy.

items.title: Amathia
items.overview: A politically obsessed young man is haunted by his older brother, a powerful media mogul he sees as pure evil. When his girlfriend pushes him to finally face his brother, their reunion turns into a devious psychological game as each tries to unmask the darkness in the other.

items.title: Regret to Inform You
items.overview: A woman is interviewed for a job.

items.title: Ghamela
items.overview: Bharat, a simple working-class man, finds himself in a fix after his wife makes a demand for a gold necklace for Dhanteras (annual festival for buying gold). He chances upon a world entirely different from his own which takes him down an unknown rabbit hole. Will he be able to get his wife a gold necklace before Dhanteras?

items.title: Roughing
items.overview: In the cold of Lac Saint-Jean, a young hockey player has no choice but to belong… or to become the violence that holds the system together.

items.title: Friends With Benefits
items.overview: Two former coworkers lose their insurance and decide couples therapy is a budget-friendly option

items.title: Selflove
items.overview: A young man finally finds his soulmate: himself. After all, no one understands him as well. The two of them could live forever in their comfort zone -- if only it weren't for that one little thing.

items.title: Radiant Mountain
items.overview: Long, observational shots of people and animals going about their activities in the landscape surrounding a gigantic, ever-growing landfill site prompt reflection on the traces we as humans leave behind on our planet.

items.title: Baby Angel
items.overview: A recent grad spends her summer avoiding responsibility in an empty apartment, bumming around her small, southern college town with the maintenance man.

items.title: You Don't Die Two Times
items.overview: Guided by a prophetic dream, Gift travels through Niger, Algeria, and Tunisia on her way to Europe. This poetic film follows her struggle to stand on her own two feet and shows the personal cost of her dangerous search for a better life.

items.title: Solo por hoy
items.overview: On the night of Argentina’s World Cup victory in 2022, Buenos Aires is still buzzing with celebration. Lalo, a restless young man swept up in the euphoria of the night, is thrown out onto the street, as if he were no longer welcome even in the aftermath of the celebration. There, he meets Carla, a vibrant and sharp-witted young woman who drifts through the night as if carried by a current. Together, they wander through empty streets, letting the hours slip by as they share a soda, stories, and postponed dreams. This intimate nocturnal journey sparks an unlikely connection, unfolding into a fleeting romantic fantasy that soon dissolves with the sunrise.

items.title: Here Where the Fire Burns
items.overview: In a small square in Mexico City, Haitian migrants live in a makeshift tent camp. This observational film follows three women whose daily life finds its own rhythm, despite the instability.

items.title: Alte Nazis und Neue Rechte - Der große Rechtsruck nach dem Krieg
Dream Girl
items.overview: On her birthday, Kiran, an overworked mother, is faced with a fantastical possibility when her yesteryear Bollywood crush arrives at her door, with just one request - to marry her.

items.title: She Was Not Alone
items.overview: Four years in the life of Zaira, an elderly woman living in the marshlands of Iraq. Against all odds, she clings to her life close to nature. A poetic and moving testament to resilience and perseverance.

items.title: Is It?
items.overview: After a sexual encounter that leaves him unsettled, Joey spirals into denial that his experience might be a form of assault.

items.title: (de)forma
items.overview: Different ages, situations and languages converge seemingly at random on the same mat: one person practices prenatal exercises, another takes contortion lessons, and another prays with disciplined devotion.  Gradually, through drawings, glances, flowers and somersaults, gestures and connections begin to emerge, hinting at a bond between them. Around the mat, a slow process of bodily self-deformation unfolds, where destruction and creation become indistinguishable, and care and pain intertwine.

items.title: Beautiful Birds
items.overview: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.

items.title: Women and War
items.overview: In a chalet in the Ukrainian mountains, four women attend therapy sessions to recover from their very different, deeply traumatic experiences of the war. They each try, in their own way, to resume their former lives.

items.title: D!SoRd3rEd
items.overview: In a wasteland of rubble and ruin, J. Doe—a Black Patient Zero—navigates the wreckage of a nation haunted by its own reflection. Pursued by histories of violence, erasure, and resistance, he confronts the ghosts of an unfinished reckoning. Blurring archive and hallucination, Disordered is a visual requiem—part ritual, part rupture—that confronts the consequences of a soul that cannot forget, yet refuses to remember its past.

items.title: Ciudad Jardín
items.overview: As he is about to leave Viña del Mar, his hometown, Javier begins filming gardens without quite knowing what he is looking for. For eight years, each time he returns, he explores trees, plants, and landscapes, composing a visual essay in which avocado trees, palm trees, and roses coexist with fairy tales, colonial ghosts, and the class conflicts that run through the heart of his own family.

items.title: The Bleeders
items.overview: Four friends have their interpersonal and professional lives fall apart across a day of smoking weed.

items.title: Sandra Roque
items.overview: Sandra Roque explodes in anger and attacks a man after being called Jimmy Cliff. We gradually learn about the passion and fury between Sandra and her wife Samira, and the motorcycle of their dreams.

items.title: Sinigang na Tuyo (Dried Pork Stew)
items.overview: When an unexpected event shatters a 10-year-old girl’s mental state, her hyper-precise daily ritual of cooking sour soup for her sick mother completely breaks down, leaving her with a ruined recipe she can no longer fix.

items.title: Smoke Suggests Fire
items.overview: Floating around the city after breaking up with her girlfriend, Ekim, a young actor,  meets Beril at a dinner party. They decide to leave.

items.title: Three Blue Boats
items.overview: Two boys wander lone backwaters in search of home after their father disappears.

items.title: KIRAC 32: The Anti-Friend
items.overview: The Anti-Friend is a film about friendship, money and art.

items.title: Lonan Tché
items.overview: An intimate double portrait of two young men from Ivory Coast who fled to Europe together. Kader now has legal residency in Italy, while Inza is undocumented in France. For both, the gap between expectation and reality proves almost impossible to bridge.

items.title: Halima - How to Stay Strong
items.overview: Halima underwent an operation to reconstruct her vulva after female genital mutilation. On her journey home, she talks about her way of staying strong. A film about the consequences of FGM, everyday racism in Germany and reality as a female refugee.  Halima is a collective figure, representing biography, struggle and point of view of five somali women, who had suffred from FGM/C and worked on the film in all stages of production.

items.title: Janet's Island
items.overview: During their holiday, two little girls help Janet, a heartbroken English traveller—unaware that this encounter will jeopardise their own family

items.title: Drop! Cover! Hold On!
items.overview: A major earthquake will occur along the San Andreas Fault in California sometime—that much is certain. But when? A free-associative road trip with mineral meditations about life on the edge, where tectonic plates collide.

items.title: To The Sun and Beyond
items.overview: Linda is a widow raising her seven-year-old son alone. The boy suffers from xeroderma pigmentosum, a rare genetic disorder. He will suffer severe damage once exposed to sunlight and has to stay in the shadows for most of his life. To protect her son, Linda builds layers of barriers to shut out the outside world. As time goes by, the mother gradually realises that overprotection will only deprive her child of the right to experience life.

items.title: Unspoken Worlds
items.overview: Inspired by real events where the heroic act of pedestrians saved a man from his cousin, who attacked him with a knife attack due to an argument about inheritance.

items.title: Every Death Diminishes Me
items.overview: A filmmaker completes medical training to work on the front lines in Ukraine. His diverse group of colleagues patch up the wounded in improvised operating rooms and reflect on war and sacrifice.

items.title: Ringatory
items.overview: An American expat’s first-day commute on Berlin’s Ringbahn becomes a loop that will not stop. Its enforcers demand a fare; his ticket and credentials mean nothing. The machine wants the one thing he refuses to give.

items.title: Octarine
items.overview: Two realities slowly align as Fang's chaos magic targeting pop star Eileen Rye triggers an unforeseen change. Fang seeks meaning in the mysterious thread they've pulled, both entering a world where memories, dreams, and digital encounters merge.

items.title: The Last Jewel
items.overview: At 89, Joseph Ullmann keeps the tradition of his grandfather’s Budapest antique jewellery business alive. In today’s Hatton Garden, he and his shop are the last of their kind.

items.title: The Toast Trip
items.overview: A film about a mind-numbing job, delicious food, absurd numbers, big dreams, death, and toast.

items.title: Streetlight
items.overview: Late at night, a young man walks through a quiet neighbourhood and is drawn to a streetlight.

items.title: Down the River
items.overview: Ruslan Fedotov follows the course of the Dnieper to observe the lives of young people in Russia and Belarus, tracing how collective memory enters the lives and imagination of youth.

items.title: What We Carry
items.overview: May and Sultan struggle to live within a home consumed by silence after a devastating loss alters their relationship forever. While Sultan clings to hope and the possibility of moving forward, May endures relentless physical pain and carries a secret she cannot bring herself to reveal. As the distance between them grows, old suspicions resurface, and the burden she bears begins to fracture the fragile foundation of their marriage.

items.title: Frame Story
items.overview: A fairy tale about an animated film. The life of this film suddenly takes a cursed turn. The consequences of this change become apparent

items.title: The One Who Draws Dance
items.overview: Edgar draws dancers in Amsterdam. Everyone knows him.

items.title: Tiempo Prestado
items.overview: What if life gave you a second chance? The sea might grant you a second life, but it doesn’t teach you what to do with it.  After surviving a shipwreck in the middle of the Atlantic as a young sailor, a man carries an impossible question for decades: what should he do with the time he was never meant to have?  Through memories, silences, and a relationship shaped by the sea, *Borrowed Time* is an intimate reflection on the fragility of existence, the weight of memory, and the human need to find meaning in second chances.

items.title: Don’t Bail
items.overview: Herbert, a middle-aged investment banker, secretly spends his lunch breaks learning to skateboard after a group of local skaters take him in. However, when a coworker finds out, he must decide what scares him more: judgment or regret.

items.title: Machines Learning
items.overview: In a dark factory, a bullying worker pushes his crew of robots harder and harder. They observe. They learn. And eventually, they act. The machines are learning, but what are we teaching them?

items.title: Rachel Jones Needs a Boyfriend Not a Bat-Mitzvah
items.overview: Follows a young Welsh Jewish girl on her quest for a boyfriend, while also trying to prepare for her upcoming Bat Mitzvah.

items.title: Nee Nange Allava
items.overview: Lucky, a cheerful young man who turns everyday clashes into laughter, finds unexpected romance when he meets charming singer Kushi. But when a painful secret from her trip to Chikmagalur comes to light, Lucky embarks on a testing journey of courage and truth, determined to stand by his love against all odds.

items.title: The Brush in Your Hand
items.overview: A portrait of painter Peter Dumas, the father of photographer and filmmaker Charlotte Dumas, is interwoven with observations of her daughter Ivy as she grows up. The creative process connects their lives.

items.title: Squid on the Skin
items.overview: Struggling actor Robert Duke finds himself forced to get a face tattoo in an effort to rejuvenate his stagnant career. What comes next is a nightmare beyond belief.

items.title: Birdlife
items.overview: Nine voices from different generations trace the history of wingsuit flying, from the invention of the suit to the preparation for a jump and the desire to fly.

items.title: danass
items.overview: Join Dan and many other friendly faces from across Austin, TX, as they perform multiple pain-inducing stunts and gags  to commemorate Dan's 26th birthday including; The Uni-Bastard, The Blind Butt Tattoo, and Baby Oil Couch Surfing.

items.title: Chilli Chong Carne
items.overview: A lonely British-Chinese girl is excited to finally make a new friend when her new neighbours move in, but soon comes to realise that the world is never so simple…

items.title: Knocked Cold
items.overview: Thian 'Tarzan' de Vries is a young kickboxing sensation from the Netherlands who is rapidly conquering the international fight scene. Behind his invincible image, however, lies a turbulent past marked by addiction, crime, and time spent in youth detention. Kickboxing became both his escape and his salvation. As Thian rises through the ranks toward global recognition, an unease grows beneath the surface: can he keep control when the system that protects him begins to crack?

items.title: Rambling
items.overview: A group of Jewish Ramblers from Manchester find solace, friendship and tranquility in the spectacular hills around the city.

items.title: Bubbles
items.overview: A forty-year-old woman floats in a relationship bubble until she realizes it is too late.

items.title: Murderers
items.overview: Ignored by history for 40 years, the Oversteegen sisters' true story inspires "Murderers" (1941-1990). Two teenage girls lure a Nazi to his death. Echoing the psychological trauma of war, emigration, and today's chilling winds of fascism, the film asks: what is the true price of murder for a righteous cause, and what remains of our humanity after we are forced to cross the ultimate line?

items.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'STEAL THE WIND'
items.overview: STEAL THE WIND is the fifth world tour by TOMORROW X TOGETHER. The tour commenced on November 13, 2026, in Seoul, South Korea.

items.title: The Phenomenon of Presence
items.overview: The architect of a virtual world called Presence is interviewed about its profound capabilities – it can trigger lucidity in Alzheimer's patients. Meanwhile, inside Presence, a daughter tries to reconnect with her mother, an Alzheimer's sufferer, and bring her back to the physical world.

items.title: UNSENT
items.overview: A young man walks through his city carrying things he never said. A message was deleted before it was sent. A drink that will never be finished. A letter he can't bring himself to let go of. But grief has its own way of speaking, and some goodbyes find their way out no matter how hard we try to hold them back.

items.title: Are You Open?
items.overview: Set in an ever-changing Malaysia, a bookshop owner goes through his daily life with mundane rituals. One day, when an old friend, now an actor in B-movies, goes looking for him, the reunion changes their prosaic lives. The two former friends rekindle their brotherhood through their shared love of cinema and literature.

items.title: Tenth Inning
items.overview: Dodger fans try to find an Uber home after a game.

items.title: Wolf's Hair
items.overview: In a remote village, a determined teenage boy named Asho makes a brave decision and takes a two-year-old girl named Asma to another village so her arrival may bring blessing. On the way, an unexpected event forces Asho to choose between returning Asma and following his own need.

items.title: Screwball
items.overview: Jackson Connelly, an ice-cream man, is left devastated when a family court ruling strips him of access to his young daughter. In a moment of mad desperation, Jackson kidnaps the judge responsible. How far is Jackson willing to go in order to win his daughter back?

items.title: Zapocelta
items.overview: Max, a blind Zapotec accordion player, and Sam, a British violinist who speaks "poquito" Spanish, meet on the streets of Oaxaca City. There a friendship is born that transcends language, culture, music, and the senses.

items.title: Razor Bumps
items.overview: A young woman battles with her own body to try and maintain an image of beauty and femininity.

items.title: The Audit
items.overview: A very important company audit is jeopardized when a staff member reveals the fates of his coworkers' eternal souls.

items.title: Miles of Life
items.overview: After falling short of his athletic dreams, a once-promising Ugandan runner rediscovers purpose - using the power of sport to rebuild his broken community and to honour his trainer’s life.

items.title: Ethos of Mizoram
items.overview: Mizoram unfolds as a land where mist-covered hills, close-knit tribes, and an enduring spirit of community shape every aspect of life. This documentary journeys into the heart of Mizo society, exploring the guiding ethos of tlawmngaihna—the tradition of selflessness, courage, discipline, and service to others.

items.title: No Cheap Shots
items.overview: A documentary set in Gatineau, Québec, following a group of teenage friends who gather for an underground fight club in a garage. Through an evening of boxing matches, the film explores the dynamics of friendship, rivalry and camaraderie among the group.

items.title: NON È LA FINE DEL MONDO
Don't Call Me Chef
items.overview: Clotaire Poirier is not your typical chef. A globetrotter and polyglot, he rose to prominence with French audiences as a finalist on "Top Chef", embodying a new generation of cooks for whom performance no longer comes at the expense of people.

items.title: Let It Be, Let It Bleed: The Unlikely Rock n' Roll Journey of Ethan Russell
items.overview: Photographer Ethan Russell gained fame for candid, intimate photos of rock legends like the Rolling Stones and Beatles. Built on trust and access, his iconic images—from Altamont to Lennon and Ono—capture a defining era in rock history.

items.title: Cabbageworm
items.overview: A horror stop-motion animation film exploring queer desire and emancipation after the death of Michelle's abusive and homophobic mother.

items.title: Renewal
items.overview: Internationally acclaimed earth artist David Popa travels to Alberta to create ambitious ephemeral artworks on the frozen surface of Abraham Lake using only natural materials. What begins as a search to reconnect with the reason he creates becomes a deeply personal journey of renewal, uncovering the story of his father, the impermanence of his work, and why the most meaningful art is often the first to disappear.

items.title: Stan By Me
items.overview: A portrait of 89-year-old unsung queer hero Stan Blacklock, whose experiences of persecution and personal loss have shaped a lifetime of service to Cumbria's LGBTQ+ community.

items.title: Don’t Bail
items.overview: A 45-year-old corporate worker befriends a group of young skaters and secretly begins learning to skateboard during his lunch breaks. When doubt and judgment creep in, he must decide whether to abandon the joy he’s found or embrace the risk of starting over.

items.title: Only 21
items.overview: Q, a 21-year-old filmmaker caught between ambition and self-doubt, isolates himself to finish a short film he hopes will change his life. But when his college roommate Alonso throws a party, the night spirals into tension, confrontation, and a moment of reckoning that forces Q to face what’s really holding him back. Only 21 is a grounded, emotional portrait of creative pressure, growing up, and finding the courage to take the first real step toward your dreams.

items.title: Dog Eat Dog World
items.overview: Keith Foster, imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit, is given a glimmer of hope when two women invade his isolation to allow him to be part of an experiment involving prisoners and dogs. After taking advantage of his opportunity and being granted parole, Keith plots to close down a dog fighting ring and get revenge upon those who sent him away. His two female cheerleaders try to convince him to seek higher ground to help him preserve his newly found freedom and faith.

items.title: Pizza Guy
items.overview: A pizza delivery driver is making his last run of the night when he comes across a mysterious individual who seems to crave more than just pizza.

items.title: League of Legends Worlds 26 - Finals in Cinema
items.overview: The 2026 League of Legends World Championship Final at the Barclays Center features a best-of-five clash between Gen.G and Bilibili Gaming, accompanied by live musical acts from K/DA and True Damage. Bilibili Gaming clinches a 3–1 victory over Gen.G, giving the LPL its first title since 2021 with mid-laner Zhuo "Knight" Ding taking home Finals MVP honors.

items.title: Rachel Maddow in Conversation with Nicolle Wallace
items.overview: November 11, 2026: A live event discussing Rachel Maddow's newest book, Department of Fate.

items.title: It’s Giving Smosh:  A Thanksgiving Special
items.overview: The guys take refuge in an old building as the apocalypse happens.

items.title: SAIL AWAY
items.overview: A woman struggles her with existence.

items.title: The Family Affair
items.overview: Vanessa Milimo, a single mother diagnosed with stage-three breast cancer, faces an uphill battle to protect her home and secure her children's future. As she navigates her diagnosis and the challenges surrounding her, she must confront the people closest to her in a fight for her family, her home and everything she holds dear.

items.title: Rocky 0.5: The Rockyning
items.overview: Spoiler alert! Your favorite Italian boxer is transphobic... Find out what happens to the traditional bloke in this Academy Award-nominated film!

items.title: L’ange Rémi – La liberté à tout prix
items.overview: Rémi Lange has always made films on his own terms: freely, passionately, and without ever asking for permission. From his very first works, he has captured intimacy, bodies, desires, loves, and life on the margins, blurring the line between his own life and his cinema. This radical freedom comes at a price: a body of work that has often remained outside traditional circuits, rarely screened, and largely unknown to the general public. In Marseille, his adopted city and the setting of his latest film, L’Ange Rémi reconnects with this singular filmmaker today. Through his films, personal archives, shoots, and the people who have crossed his path, the documentary tells the story of a man who, for more than thirty years, has kept filming against all odds. He is a filmmaker who may never have received the recognition he hoped for, yet has never given up on what matters most: turning his life into cinema, and his cinema into a space of freedom.

items.title: Papas
items.overview: Together since high school, Alexandre and Jordan travel to the United States to fulfill their dream of becoming fathers through surrogacy, which is illegal in France. Their meeting with Nicole, who agrees to carry their child, ushers in a period of hope and anticipation, as well as doubts and trust to be built. Through appointments, decisions to be made, and the upheavals of daily life, each of them gradually finds their place in this journey that binds them together forever.

items.title: RaTaTaTurn
items.overview: They've shared blood, money, and years of friendship. They know each other's habits, their weaknesses, their tells.  But someone at the table has been playing a different game all along...

items.title: The Memory of You
items.overview: A young woman, coming to terms with the loss of her boyfriend, receives a letter in the post with a USB containing videos of him.

items.title: We Happy?
items.overview: A playful re-enactment of an infamous scene.

items.title: Jolly
items.overview: For generations, a family has had a human skull in their home. They journey through historical, ethical, spiritual and scientific perspectives to try to understand who this individual was and how to properly care for their remains.

items.title: Without Prejudice
items.overview: Disowned by his parents at 19 after coming out, Harvey Brownstone refuses to let rejection or systemic bias define his future. Fighting his way through law school and the legal ranks, he shatters barriers to become Canada’s first openly gay judge in Ontario’s family court. Balancing a groundbreaking career on the bench with his personal search for acceptance, Harvey champions compassion and equality at every turn. Later in life, he steps down from the courtroom to reinvent himself once again as a bestselling author and television talk show host, proving that living authentically is the ultimate triumph.

items.title: Life Where Land Ends - Tom Crowe
items.overview: A surfer, RNLI and Coastguard volunteer, and coach at his local surf-lifesaving club, Tom Crowe’s life has been shaped around and by the ocean. From helping with his own search for identity, to passing on its lessons to the next generation, we explore Tom's relationship with the ocean and how he lives a life where land ends.

items.title: The Obsidian Mirror
items.overview: After uncovering an Aztec obsidian mirror tied to his late father's mysterious death, a grieving teen and his friends must stop an ancient entity from crossing into their world - before it claims them one by one.

items.title: TO(GET)HER
items.overview: A young man keeps returning to a moment from his past, hoping that this time it might end differently.

items.title: Projek Love Council
items.overview: Fakhri falls in love at first sight with Ilyana, a new student at his school. Realizing he lacks experience in matters of the heart, Fakhri takes advice from his best friend on how to win Ilyana over. However, his efforts face opposition from Jojo.

items.title: Icarus
items.overview: Kathelo, a struggling musician, approaches SPLNTR online to help him navigate the underground art scene of Johannesburg, South Africa. His perceptions are shattered when he discovers the nature of his mentor. He is left to decide: Use or be used.

items.title: Jean Gabin : Héros d'une France disparue
Le plus beau pays du monde, Opus 4
The Gay Agenda 40
items.overview: In this series of shorts, the phrase "Gay Agenda" is reclaimed from the religious right and transformed into a celebration of gay culture. Sit back and enjoy "Too Difficult," "You Are Different," "While There Is Still Time," and "Quodlibet."

items.title: Khushi - The Princess of the Jungle
items.overview: Welcome to Khushi – The Princess of the Jungle, a heartwarming 3D animated kids cartoon filled with magical forest adventures, forest friends, and fun learning stories. Join Khushi, a brave and curious girl, and her brother Chottu as they discover a hidden magical forest where glowing animals, mystical creatures, and nature come alive. Along the way, they meet amazing forest friends—from playful animals to magical beings—who guide them through exciting adventures.

items.title: Ecos
items.overview: Modern interpretation of Patricio Guzman's "La Batalla de Chile".

items.title: Six Weeks, 3 Days, and All The Years Before
items.overview: A pregnancy stirs long-buried childhood memories, leading a daughter to find her estranged father living in a remote Himalayan village after a lifetime apart. Addressing her unborn child, she traces the quiet imprints of parental absence on her becoming.

items.title: The Used:  A Mid Summer Night's Symphony
items.overview: Experience The Used like you never have before, supported by a full orchestra and choir, filmed at the Sydney Opera House.

items.title: Gísli Gunnarsson - Úr Öskunni - Live in Grindavík
items.overview: Gísli Gunnarsson performs his album Úr Öskunni live in the church of Grindavík, the town that had been left largely abandoned following the volcanic eruptions and the evacuation of its residents. A selected number of visitors attended the event, which was created first and foremost as an opportunity for the people of Grindavík - many of whom had been scattered across different communities since the evacuation - to come together in their hometown once again.

items.title: Deirdre O'Kane: O'Kaning It
items.overview: One of Ireland's favourite comedians, Deirdre O'Kane, is back with her brand-new tour, O'Kaning It - a box-fresh hour of side-splitting laughs.  Comedy fans can look forward to an unfiltered, no-holds-barred performance from Deirdre as she delivers an evening of relentless laughs, fuelled by her distinct blend of raw humour and unapologetic honesty, promising to keep audiences on the edge of their seats from start to finish.

items.title: Domestics
items.overview: 12 Scenes. 20 Characters.

items.title: The Clambake Mutiny
items.overview: An animated adaptation of Jerome Beatty Jr.'s undersea book published in 1964, illustrated by Tomi Ungerer. When his uncle is caught in a trap and taken out of the ocean, a young lobster decides to get in the next trap and see what happens to caught lobsters. Together they lead a mutiny at a clambake.

items.title: Enough
items.overview: In the wake of police killings, civil rights attorney Lee Merritt stands beside grieving families in an unrelenting fight for justice. As the cases mount, the toll on him and his team reveals the hidden cost of resisting America’s broken system.

items.title: The Mantises
items.overview: After losing her mom, 14-year-old Aitana stays at her relatives' rural home, where she encounters a forest spirit that helps her process her mother's death.

items.title: Infinitely Absent To Creation
items.overview: A Violent Reckoning Of Abstraction Reflected Against Layers Of Trees. The Wide Surrendering Of The Images Running To And Remaining In Their Own Demise. The Weight Of That Expression Trembling In The Distance, A Separate Sky Where All Time Exists, Unfaltering And Death Starved. Leaving The Vision Of Reason Bound And Unreachable.

items.title: Laterz
items.overview: An aspiring Melbourne rapper and her two best friends want to get her track on the radio and secure the clout that comes with the airtime. Over one afternoon in the suburbs, their dreams start to collide with reality.

items.title: Unesta tehty mies
items.overview: Aulis Sallinen (born 1935) speaks about his work and life, while dramatized sequences weave in a narrative that links real life with Sallinen’s opera The Horseman. The film also features material from the Sallinen family archives, as well as extensive footage from the Finnish National Opera’s spring 2025 production of The Horseman.

items.title: Chameleon
items.overview: Father and son go to the forest - away from the city to remember what it means to be a family. A bonfire, heart-to-heart talks. But in the morning they wake up in an abandoned village, which shouldn't be here.

items.title: Mai American
items.overview: A Vietnamese refugee turned American carries an unforgettable past in her body. A queer filmmaker and his mother seek belonging and healing through memoirs, paintings, and conversation—a vulnerable film about love and acceptance.

items.title: A Better Way: James Lawson, Architect of Nonviolence
items.overview: he Rev. James Lawson was an unsung founder of the Civil Rights Movement who helped shape it through faith, moral clarity, and nonviolence. A close colleague of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., he later confronted racism, police violence, and apartheid. Featuring rare archival footage and reflections from civil rights leaders past and present, this compelling portrait offers a fresh perspective on American history and a timely reminder of the importance of speaking truth to power

items.title: The Best Justice System in the World
items.overview: A humorous look at the not-so-funny ways the government and corporations strip us of our right to a jury trial

items.title: Petite Chinese Twink Gets GAPED by Big Bull
items.overview: Chang, a shy young adult renting a room for the weekend, finds his quiet getaway taking an unexpected turn when a flirtatious encounter with a throbbing bull leads to an after-hours lesson in obedience.

items.title: #SOSCUBA
items.overview: What is it like to live in a culture of fear where you could be pulled off the streets by plainclothes government officers at any time, where your job can be taken away for no reason, where your voice can be silenced and your history erased. A young generation of artist activists in Cuba confronts 66 years of authoritarian rule, challenging the heroic myth of the Cuban revolution and paying the price for it.

items.title: Drawn from Sleep
items.overview: Drawn from Sleep is a psychological horror film that explores the unsettling boundary between sleep paralysis and reality, as a young woman encounters a sinister presence she cannot explain.

items.title: The Newsreel: Characterization of Subversive Organization
items.overview: The story of how a group of fiery activists decided to create an archive of 1960s counterculture. This is the extraordinary origin story of the NYC institution: Third World Newsreel.

items.title: Isabella- Beer Sheva
items.overview: During the summer of 1955, the beautiful and rebellious Isabella leaves her husband and takes their daughter Alissa  to her mother's house in Jerusalem.  There she meets Richard, an English business man on a trip and falls in love with him against her mother's wishes while using Alissa as an alibi.  Alissa, torn between her mother and grandmother, begins to discover old painful secrets in her family are preventing her mother from ever being truly happy.  As the truth slowly comes to light, it threatens to destroy everything they've built and known...

items.title: The Notebook: reimagined
items.overview: A satire of the well-known, "The Notebook" (2004).

items.title: Shaolin 3
items.overview: Shaolin III takes place nearly a year after the events of Shaolin II. Shaolin has become the founder of a wildly popular basketball club, attracting followers who see him as both a sports icon and a philosopher. Filmmaker Aiden Diorio returns to document this unexpected new chapter in his life. Their journey leads them to Grease Master, a familiar face from the previous film. Believing he may be worthy of joining the club, Shaolin brings him to a basketball court and subjects him to a series of bizarre physical, mental, and spiritual tests. What begins as a playful evaluation gradually becomes an increasingly hostile rivalry. As tempers flare and old tensions resurface, the challenges spiral out of control, culminating in a brutal confrontation that appears to end with Grease Master's death. But as the documentary unfolds, strange signs begin to suggest that Grease Master may not be gone after all.

items.title: Jayannth & The Jingo Pen
items.overview: JAYANNTH and THE JINGO PEN is a heartwarming Telugu family entertainer celebrating childhood, imagination, friendship, and family values.The film follows Jayannth, a mischievous schoolboy who fears mathematics and uses clever tricks to escape homework and his strict Maths Teacher

items.title: Krummels
items.overview: The warm and heartwarming comedy-drama follows five elderly friends who refuse to surrender to age or adversity. When an extortionist threatens their successful school feeding project, the group decides to fight back in their own way.

items.title: Attack of the Giant Shaded Lozenge
items.overview: Frank goes to Fieldfield to meet his friend Bob. There is a lozenge.

items.title: What did the sheep see
items.overview: This film follows T, a sex worker who meets JJ, an unusually devoted client. After their first encounter, JJ becomes overly attached, forcing T to warn him to keep his distance. When they meet again, T asks how JJ can afford to keep paying for him. JJ reveals that he spends his days breaking into houses, living off whatever he finds inside. Fascinated, T asks to come along on his next venture.  The two break into the home of a wealthy family expecting riches, only to find a strangely ordinary life. They spend the day picking through leftovers, sharing half-eaten eggs and toast, and drinking a half-finished glass of apple juice left on the kitchen counter. Despite searching every room, they discover nothing of value. Their search eventually leads them to the attic, where a single painting hangs among the dust and forgotten belongings. It is the only thing worth taking. But as T admires the strange find, JJ makes a decision that changes everything...

items.title: NOT T/HERE
items.overview: Not T/here is an experimental documentary, reflecting on time, self-narrative, myth-making and our increasingly complex relationship with reality. Drawing on six years of documentary footage and ongoing research, the work traces our paths from the COVID-19 pandemic towards a speculative near future, set in 2035. A narrator attempts to piece together an archive left behind by a friend, an archivist who disappeared after documenting a world undergoing rapid

items.title: Sidney Rivers: Rebel Heart
items.overview: Prom night is just around the corner at Roarville Academy, and 17-year-old Sidney Rivers isn't exactly thrilled about going. But with his enthusiastic best friend Harvey Brooks determined to make it a night to remember, and a new girl in town catching Sidney's attention, things might just get interesting!

items.title: I am Poop Biju , Not Jackfruit Chacko
items.overview: ITS MOTTA VINOD VS MOONJI RENGITH

items.title: Iliya Muromets
items.overview: Iliya the Knight of Murom, son of a peasant, was born disabled and was unable to walk until he turned 33. He then was miraculously healed and became a great warrior during his faithful service to Kniaz Vladimir Monomakh by fighting against invaders and helping Kniaz consolide Russianlands.

items.title: A Match for Mr. Christmas
items.overview: A no-nonsense PR executive Lori agrees to help a charmingly irresponsible toy empire heir Emmett find love and prove he’s the right man to take over the company when his father retires – all by Christmas. But after a string of hilariously failed dates, she discovers the perfect match might be the one she never planned on: herself.

items.title: Las Altagracias en Navidad
items.overview: A Christmas family comedy starring SoyKleiii, who brings to life the unforgettable characters of the Altagracias family. Amidst comedic mix-ups, traditions, and the unmistakable spirit of a Venezuelan Christmas, the film celebrates humor, affection, and the value of family during the most special time of year.

items.title: You Won't Believe What Happened Before
items.overview: Two rogue journalists clash over a damning video that could topple a crooked regime. As betrayal and blackmail mount, their twisted road trip spirals into chaos, murder, and a scandal that could bring the whole system crashing down.

items.title: Oblivion
items.overview: A young sex worker, Maria, sets out to reconnect with her estranged biological father, but their growing relationship takes an unexpected turn as she conceals her true identity, forcing her to confront the delicate line between deception and healing.

items.title: Salón de Belleza
items.overview: In an unnamed city, a beauty salon becomes a space of passage where those cast out gather, suspended between life and death. At its center is the Individuo, a solitary presence who tends to this place without any promises or explanation. The film unfolds as time and place dissolve into one another. What is lived, remembered, and imagined coexists in a continuous movement, where meaning emerges through ritual, drifting, and return. Within this space, beauty and death are intertwined. The salon becomes a threshold where presence and memory fade and reappear, and where the boundaries between reality and vision begin to loosen. The outside world remains  fractured, its tensions quietly permeating the space. As everything shifts, what emerges is a passage: a meditation on the fragility of existence.

items.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing: Revisiting Mulberry Street
items.overview: In 2005, a group of up-and-coming filmmakers based in Lower Manhattan set out to make an independent horror film called Mulberry Street, in which a virus turns ordinary New Yorkers into rat people. 20 years later, they reflect on the making of the film and what it has to say about the evolution of New York City.

items.title: Hollow Ones
items.overview: A lonely house on a farm is haunted by a scarecrow, but what lives inside the house is far more dangerous.

items.title: Bahía Honda
items.overview: Laboring in a Cuban ship graveyard, an almost apocalyptic world of fire and creaking sheets of steel, Pitufo dreams of a better life. An atmospheric, magical glimpse into a life on society's margins.

items.title: erōtikós
items.overview: A poetic and political investigation into eroticism as a vital force. The documentary essay delves into the tension between control and desire to explore what remains of the erotic in a society shaped by guilt and colonial logic. Uniting philosophy, psychoanalysis, and art through deep interviews and visceral performances, the film challenges moral constraints and invites us to recognize the body as the first territory to be counter-colonized.

items.title: Aroma
items.overview: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving between waking life and dream, Aroma is a dark contemporary fairy tale about the body, desire, and love that refuses to disappear when the body does.

items.title: The Neighbourhood is Changing
items.overview: Documentary on the making and legacy of Mulberry Street featuring new interviews with cast and crew

items.title: The Monster I Made
items.overview: June stays endlessly busy and tethered to her devices to keep her demons at bay. But when she forgets to plug in her phone before falling asleep, she’s forced to face the monster her denial has unleashed.

items.title: L'art de perdre en politique
items.overview: Politicians lose far more often than they win: every one of them will eventually face defeat at the ballot box. Failure reveals far more about politicians than success ever could. For the first time, former Presidents, Prime Ministers and Members of Parliament speak candidly about their defeats.

items.title: In un battito
items.overview: The film follows the months after December 1, 2024, when Edoardo Bove suddenly collapses on the pitch during Fiorentina’s match against Inter. The incident disrupts what seemed to be a clear path for one of Italian football’s brightest young talents and marks the beginning of an entirely new chapter in his life. From that moment on, Edoardo faces a suddenly uncertain future: will he play again? Will he still be able to do so in Italy? And who is Edoardo beyond football?

items.title: One Sweet Hour
items.overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

items.title: The Contract
items.overview: Longing for love and a place to call home, Oliver agrees to visit the remote manor of a man he has met online. As Oliver explores a BDSM life alongside his new potential master, he must contend with jealous rivals, unexpected visitors, and horrifying revelations about what it truly means to belong to someone...

items.title: Beyond Ballroom
items.overview: In Indiana, a grassroots ballroom community creates space for safety and belonging. Through Indy Kiki Circle, people discover connection, care, and the freedom of being themselves.

items.title: Girl and Wolf
items.overview: "Girl and Wolf" is an animated feature film for a young adult public based on the Roc Espinet's homonymous graphic novel. It tells the story of Paula, an innocent girl who lives in a medieval village attacked by wolves. Paula will have to face dark childhood traumas, soulless hunters, magical wild spirits and an ancient pack of wolves.

items.title: Tunnelblick
items.overview: Tamina is followed by a strange man. As she looses her grip on reality, she realizes that she can't deal with him on her own...

items.title: The Days Off
items.overview: In the near future, during a relentless summer break and with a solar eclipse approaching, 12-year-old Bego struggles to find her place within her family and among girls of her age. As the moon seems to eclipse the animals and people around her, she meets REN__, an online friend, who introduces her to “shifting” – a practice where teens believe they can enter other realities through lucid dreaming.

items.title: Small Expectations
items.overview: This deep dive into Romania's chaotic 2025 elections echoes global patterns of democratic erosion and the growth of fascist movements—with social media fueling the frenzy.

items.title: No Man's Air
items.overview: Cyprus, July 1974. President Makarios has been ousted in a coup, and a Turkish invasion is imminent. A pilot recounts the very last flight to Nicosia Airport: should he land or not?

items.title: Morro Grande
items.overview: After his childhood friend Vaguinho commits suicide, Rodolpho decides to devote a novel to his rebellious friend. Vaguinho was a leading figure in the punk movement of the farming community where they grew up, amid plantations drenched in pesticides.

items.title: ¿Quién hace la...? - 1979
items.overview: At the end of the 70s, Eduardo Kabral continues with his TV show presenting all the members of his crew.

items.title: In Your Heart Movie Version
items.overview: Childhood friends Ling Zi Ming and Cheng Yi, along with bickering duo Lu Xiang Lin and Yue Yu Zhi, have grown up side by side. The four boys share the happiest days of their youth together, but along the way, subtle changes begin to emerge in their feelings for one another. They once believed they would never have to say goodbye, yet as they grow older, their paths gradually lead them in different directions...

items.title: My Own Personal Gulag
items.overview: An essay film exploring the gap between the propaganda and reality of Soviet labor camps. Composed entirely of archival footage that often evokes a reality all its own, it juxtaposes conflicting accounts from figures including Gorky and Solzhenitsyn.

items.title: Mazhalai
items.overview: A young man helps his friend overcome his insecurities about cricket by sharing his own unfulfilled childhood dream, reminding him that we don't have to be good at something to enjoy doing it. A heartwarming story about friendship, childhood passion, and never losing the inner child.

items.title: Old Crow
items.overview: At 83, Louise Forestier is a freer, more engaged, and more vibrant artist than ever. Structured in nine chapters, like the nine songs on her latest album, this "docu-musical" unfolds as an ode to nature and the passage of time.

items.title: A Minute of Silence
items.overview: On 14 March 1978, 17-year-old Rico Carpaye was killed by far-right militants on the island of Réunion. Those responsible went unpunished. Nearly 50 years later, this desktop documentary unravels the story behind the silence surrounding the crime.

items.title: Alter Ego
items.overview: For years, exiled Syrian artist Assem Al-Bacha has been working on a giant sculpture of the 11th-century poet Al-Maari, intended to raise awareness of his country. Will the sculpture ever make it home?

items.title: Where the Sun is Born
items.overview: Immersive and poetic film in which a dancer from Honduras leaves the city to return to the Afro-Caribbean Garifuna community of his youth, searching for his past, cultural identity, healing rituals, and a sense of connection.

items.title: Midnight Knocks at the Door
items.overview: Stripped of color and clothes, ready to be cleansed. A young man's midnight bath becomes a surreal nightmare the moment he realizes he is not alone.

items.title: Heaven
items.overview: On 3 February 2018, Luca Traini opens fire in the streets of Macerata, wounding six people. Two of them, Kofi Wilson and Omar Fadera, had reached Italy after a dangerous journey from Ghana and Gambia, risking their lives in the desert and in Libya. They believed they were finally safe in Macerata: “Maybe I’m in Heaven,” Kofi says. But they were not.

items.title: The Lookalike
items.overview: Across football stadiums, concert halls, and religious gatherings, three Egyptians live in the shadow of famous figures they strikingly resemble. A journey into how a genetic coincidence evolved into a profession, an identity, and a destiny - and how the lookalike came to fill a space the real celebrity never could, meeting admirers in streets, villages, and local celebrations, becoming a star within reach and, at times, rivaling the original.

items.title: The Fraying
items.overview: As a burdened teen girl’s hallucinations intensify, she confides in her devout mother, unaware of a buried truth resurfacing to fracture the reality within their home.

items.title: Jenin & the Nakba Between Us
items.overview: Serene Husni, a Palestinian filmmaker living in the diaspora, returns to her parents' hometown in the occupied West Bank. Conversations with residents reveal the continuing impact of the Nakba, the mass displacement of Palestinians in 1948.

items.title: The Noah Movie; Epilogue: The Last Don
items.overview: 4 years after the events of “The Noah Movie: The Complete Epic”,  Noah Feliz is operating quietly in New York City.  Things go wrong quickly once again when he almost gets killed at a friendly dinner hosted by fellow don, Salvatore Giorgio. See how it all ends in this fantastic conclusion to an amazing crime saga.

items.title: Trifecta
items.overview: On the night of her 21st birthday, a sexually frustrated virgin tries to convince her celibate boyfriend to have sex with her.

items.title: Los Fantasmas de María
items.overview: A hypnotic journey through the archive of María Tupper (1893–1965), a Chilean artist and spiritualist who tirelessly compiled and organized her photographs, drawings, paintings, diaries, letters, and 8mm films.

items.title: Canti della specie - Un viaggio con Antonio Moresco
items.overview: What if the end is simply a moment of transition? In Canti della specie, we hear the voice and thoughts of the writer Antonio Moresco on human extinction through five deliberately conflicting conversations.

items.title: Piccola anatomia di corpi al lavoro
items.overview: The four directors build the narrative around these repetitive movements: moving objects, operating machinery, digging holes and laying foundations. The workers' bodies follow a precisely timed routine, leading the viewer to question what an artistic gesture is. This routine is interrupted by the metamorphosis of the images, as the workers' silhouettes detach themselves from reality to become two-dimensional projections on a screen. The conventional meaning usually given to manual labor is subverted, taking on an entirely new significance.

items.title: Schattenfangen
items.overview: Eclipse of the moon. The shadow of the earth gets projected onto the moon's surface. The Super-8 camera tries to catch it. A playful imprint on the emulsion, brought back to light by hand in the darkroom.

items.title: Connor (Muppet Movie 2.0)
items.overview: After this, there's no turning back

items.title: Off-Key
items.overview: Two old highschool acquaintances reconnect by coincidence after running into each other at a bar. Hijinks Ensue.

items.title: Above the Ground
items.overview: Two strangers leave a club to look for a place to pee. A childhood game echoes through the streets. While deciding who will be “it,” they realize the game has already begun, long enough to forget why they went out in the first place.

items.title: The Oasis Concert
items.overview: An alcoholic and drug-addicted father takes his children Joaquín and Valentina to see an Oasis concert in Castilla y León after seeing a surreal advertisement on television.

items.title: Photomaton, la grande histoire de la petite photo
Cuts
items.overview: Set on Halloween night, CUTS follows a group of young friends who cross paths with a mysterious figure wearing a cracked clown mask. What they mistake for an elaborate Halloween prank quickly descends into a brutal fight for survival.

items.title: At the Mercy of Faith
items.overview: After his sister's murder, a grieving man is haunted by visions and forced to confront his shattered beliefs.

items.title: Golub
items.overview: For a short time, young Milan has been living alone with a father who doesn’t take care of him, preferring to spend time breeding pigeons. With a major pigeon competition just days away, their relationship has never been so strained.

items.title: TNA Destination X 2026
items.overview: Destination X (2026) is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on November 15, 2026 at Edmonton Expo Centre, Canada.

items.title: Unfortunate
items.overview: On a bright and peaceful morning, a figure suddenly loses a part of its body. After attempting every possible way to restore itself, it finally comes to terms with the unfortunate incident-only to pass it on to someone else.

items.title: Ball
items.overview: A corporate corgi struggles to pick between work and play once he's face to face with his favourite toy.

items.title: Nodi Swamy
items.overview: An intimate journey through the unnoticed moments that shape who we are, even when nothing seems to happen.

items.title: Squatter hunter
items.overview: A man comes home to find a squatter in his house and after the police can't do anything he resorts to hiring a down on his luck PI to get his house back.

items.title: Chaos Is The True Nature of Things
items.overview: A little boy visits his grandparents, but the grandmother is missing and the grandfather is acting weird.

items.title: The Children Trap
items.overview: In a home where fights erupt and everything is quietly reset by morning, two young sisters begin secretly plotting their parents’ divorce, believing it’s the only way to save their family.

items.title: Perú
items.overview: 7-second short film about child pregnancy in Peru.

items.title: XG WORLD TOUR: THE CORE show at Prudential Center in Newark
Alleyway
items.overview: A young street satay vendor burdened by financial struggles and a failing satay business , struggling with the arrival of his estranged younger brother, faces the harsh realities of urban poverty.

items.title: Lu
items.overview: A story about identity, heartbreak, and music– about the selves we lose, the ones we become, and the ones still waiting for us. Somewhere between a memory and a dream.

items.title: Pámpano roto
items.overview: On the island of Gran Canaria, an old tradition has faded into legend: el pámpano roto, a ritual that brought local young people together in a phallic dance whose original meaning has been lost to history. Fearful that recollections of this tradition may fade from memory, three journalists set out to find the last surviving people to witness the dance in person.

items.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Lincoln in the Bardo
items.overview: The supernatural story takes place in the “bardo,” a transitional plane between the end of this life and the beginning of the next, populated by those who resist all the powers of light and darkness and refuse to accept their fates. The action revolves around 11-year-old Willie, recently deceased son of Abraham Lincoln, whose grief-stricken visits to Willie’s tomb prevent his son’s spirit from moving on.

items.title: Sound Pressure
items.overview: Vostrov, a talented sound engineer who despises the cynicism of the entertainment industry, agrees to fabricate audio evidence of infidelity for a jealous client. He has no idea that his professional lie will trigger an act of domestic violence.

items.title: the offerings
items.overview: An ode to the culture of northern Bali, where the gods are thanked through offerings to the past and the future. The rice cycle, with its ancient traditions, paints a timeless portrait of life.

items.title: The Lantern
items.overview: A tick infestation drives a group of campers out of their tent as their only light source slowly loses power. Their conflicting instincts pit them against one another.

items.title: Route 16
items.overview: Ira reluctantly takes the bus to meet up with a guy from online, but when her date cancels mid-ride, she decides to join the middle-aged bus driver on his smoke break.

items.title: Stolen Hearts
items.overview: The future is ripe with stolen hearts and dreams filled with body parts. Two dream rescuers known as Wakers attempt to rescue a boy trapped in a machine-induced dream, but something dear and dead to him comes in the way.

items.title: Now Cry
items.overview: Struggling actress Devin and sound mixer Tom share an unlikely behind-the-scenes moment of connection, leading to an outpouring of emotion that neither of them expected.

items.title: Landlines
items.overview: Interwoven with animation, observational footage, and shadow puppetry, an exploration of migrant truck drivers living in the Greater Toronto Area as they navigate the unjust realities of their industry.

items.title: Food and Shelter (Hey Hey Bye Bye)
items.overview: docu-melodrama in which a woman remembers their childhood and escapes from hell.

items.title: Devils Advocate
items.overview: A recent PR grad walks into an interview, only to slowly realize he’s being recruited to be the literal Devil’s Advocate. As the meeting becomes increasingly unhinged, he tries to keep cool… until it’s too late

items.title: Plan Fawks
items.overview: A action-drama movie about if the gunpowder plot succeeded

items.title: The Audition
items.overview: An aspiring actor and drummer confronts his own perfectionism, and growing frustration with a faulty bass drum pedal, as he attempts a self-tape audition for a local production of the play “Stereophonic.”

items.title: Biscuit Poltergeist
items.overview: After a bad date, Hailey, rather begrudged, partakes in a cigarette, leading to a destructive and ridiculous consequence.

items.title: Stitches
items.overview: When an elderly relative comes to stay with their family for the holidays, little Oli faces an insurmountable challenge: neither of them speak the same language. The two find a way to weave an unexpected connection without words.

items.title: From Baseball to Bloodshed - When Unconditional Love Turns Deadly
Submergence
items.overview: The physical world recedes into a distant echo, gradually dissolving into an unfamiliar state of existence before descending into darkness.

items.title: Second Chance Holiday
items.overview: Dating expert Chelsey is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame, she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.

items.title: KILL/SAVE
items.overview: In a locked-down megacity where reality is optional, a lonely programmer risks his mind to rescue his girlfriend from a virtual prison — only to face a truth that challenges the very meaning of salvation and free will.

items.title: Hook: Never, Never Ending
items.overview: Straight from the set of HOOK, this hour-long documentary features never before seen behind the scenes footage.  Relive the adventure of creating this beloved film that has become a cult classic with extraordinary access to access to Steven Spielberg, Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman, Julia Roberts, and the crew through interviews and footage captured during production, as well as Steven Spielberg’s home movies.  Experience the triumph and trials of making HOOK in a thrilling and nostalgic time capsule that audiences will treasure.

items.title: Hell's No Place for a Pretty Face
items.overview: Two pornstars cross the country robbing porn theaters

items.title: The Sweetness of Bitter Things
items.overview: In rural Macedonia, Dora, a middle-aged doctor, has built her life around duty – to her distant husband, troubled daughter, and ailing mother. When an injured young woman is brought into her home, caring for her awakens a desire Dora has suppressed for decades. Their growing intimacy becomes a secret affair, slowly destabilising the life she has worked so hard to preserve.

items.title: I Could Punch You (If I Wanted To)
items.overview: With no other means to get to her boxing match in London, Toni is forced to hitch a ride with her distant older brother. Over the course of a car ride, 'I Could Punch You (If I Wanted To)' explores the bond between two siblings and the tensions that arise in the struggle to stay connected.

items.title: GW:s mord - Mordet på Wilma
items.overview: After breaking up with her boyfriend, 17-year-old Wilma is gone. Neighbors hear desperate screams. Two weeks later, the police make a gruesome discovery inside a suitcase.

items.title: Intolerant
items.overview: Paula is having an important day at work, but a mishap with her coffee order sets off a chain of surreal and absurd events. As she struggles to navigate the chaos, she fights to prove her worth and make her voice heard.

items.title: DDT XX Century
items.overview: From Malevich’s “Black Square” to “Black Dog of St. Petersburg” — this is how DDT and filmmaker Sergei Kuznetsov defines the boundaries of the short 20th century. All the characters in the film are the heroes of DDT’s songs. Each episode is one track and one unique artistic method. The live‑action episodes alternate with chronicles, fragments of documentary films — both classic and little‑known — as well as with animation.

items.title: Cadence
items.overview: Cadence, an elite runner, discovers how far she will go to succeed. Subjected to a corrupt experiment that harvests adrenaline from her nightmares to enhance her performance, she faces an impossible choice when her dream is threatened: her sport or her morality.

items.title: asturias es jazz
items.overview: Cafes, bars, stores for transfer, lottery administrations, rainy streets and other people's conversations are drawing an urban and popular Asturias, far away from any tourist postcard. Images captured almost on the fly, overprinted texts, radio fragments, interviews and sound materials follow one another with the characteristic freedom of his cinema.

items.title: Mamá
items.overview: Viewed through the lens of a cars back up camera, a grieving immigrant mother is forced into a night of life altering crime. After receiving a frantic call from her son in prison, Daisy’s motherly love is put to the test, putting her Christian morals to the side in order to keep her son alive.

items.title: Bad Ass Bear
items.overview: After her cub is killed by a group of backwoods hunters, an angry mama gets revenge, developing a thirst for revenge and human blood. A group of college co-eds head out on a spring break camping trip for a weekend of partying in the woods. They soon become the target of the enraged bear and must battle for survival against a blood thirsty predator.

items.title: The Great Family
items.overview: Inspired by true events, the film follows a young man struggling to reclaim his freedom inside a shelter ruled by a woman whose authority blends maternal care with strict control. As he navigates loyalty, fear, and the desire to escape, the fragile boundaries between protection and domination begin to unravel.

items.title: Long Haired Businessmen
items.overview: Kevin, Kyle, and Seth are long-haired, buzzword-fluent middle managers with a passion for staying looped in and on the same page. When the ruthless Torrence Group acquires their company and sics Gen-Z efficiency experts on them, the trio must survive team-building gone haywire, a scheme to replace them with AI, and a corporate conspiracy to eliminate middle management entirely - armed with nothing but jargon, synergy, and one sacred truth: the weekend’s never long enough.

items.title: Arrow For a Stone Heart
items.overview: On the outskirts of São Paulo city, a train cuts through an indigenous territory. Within this territory, Jera dreams, and in her dreams the city invades her village. In the same community, Rete, an animal that can move through different dimensions, remembers the history of an ancient river, swallowed by the city centuries ago.

items.title: Cuscú
items.overview: Filmmaker Risseth Yangüez Singh explores her family history while helping her grandmother move. Together, they reflect on the history of Panama, the straightening of Afro-textured hair, and the suppression of Black identity.

items.title: On Top of the Cliff
items.overview: In 1950s Lima, a Catholic girls' boarding school clings to a cliff above the Pacific Ocean. Ana, 16, pursues holiness obsessively, secretly mortifying her body. When Rebecca, a rebellious foreigner, arrives at the school, Ana’s leadership starts to crack. As fascination turns into jealousy and desire clashes with faith, discipline takes on a dangerous charge.

items.title: bonus track desesperada
items.overview: An urban bus beyond the limits of Xixón leads the film to a foggy periphery where everyday life begins to acquire a strange quality of mystery and loneliness. The journey is interrupted with a jazz concert in one of those cafeterias that occupy a recognizable place in the universe of Seles, while the assembly adopts the logic of a happy visual and sound improvisation.

items.title: Qué lejos están las fuentes y los pájaros
items.overview: A child touches an insect and, without realizing it, sets a journey in motion: birds and fountains guide the transformation of a world that takes shape and then falls apart. Amid the remnants of a fading splendor, the forces of the earth persist, and everything returns, like an echo, between what once was and what will never be again.

items.title: Make Work
items.overview: Four choreographers have two weeks to create original ballets with New York City Ballet dancers, navigating pressure, experimentation and the balance between honoring tradition and pushing boundaries.

items.title: Breaking the Cycle
items.overview: Ken, a Christian conservative, and Rowan, a tree-hugging skeptic, bike from Santa Monica to D.C. before Congress breaks—raising money for shelters and demanding a standard: a safe bed for anyone who needs it. Their odd-couple chemistry fuels a documentary that's part comedy, part gut-punch, meeting the homelessness crisis face-to-face and proving unlikely partners can unite to change the world.

items.title: Montpellier
items.overview: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.

items.title: Rivers of Memory
items.overview: Along the coast of Odisha, India, the sea is slowly swallowing entire villages. Once-fertile land is turning into barren plains, and an older generation is being left behind, with the memories of the past.

items.title: The Blood of the Covenant
items.overview: A filmmaker with Cape Verdean roots films his mother in the home where, after more than 40 years of marriage, she will now live alone. As she sorts through her belongings, painful memories sometimes surface, but also liberating new insights.

items.title: The Message
items.overview: Are there actually extraterrestrial explanations for unidentified aerial phenomena, but we're not getting the message? With nuance, persistent curiosity, and inventive camerawork, filmmaker Guylaine Maroist sets out in search of an answer.

items.title: Vandycorn
items.overview: As recent heir of the Vandycorn company, Cash J. Butters explores cheaper ways to run the family business.

items.title: The Debt
items.overview: A Mafia associate contemplates his choices and morals as he is faced with an unthinkable decision.

items.title: MEAT
items.overview: A feral child befriends a stray dog in a lonely post-apocalyptic world, but at what cost?

items.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
items.overview: Azrael has guided countless souls into the afterlife, but has never understood why people choose to love, even though it always ends in loss. When he falls for a convenience store worker, one tragic night forces him to discover the answer for himself.

items.title: Happy Ending
items.overview: Elaheh, a literature student, lost her father three years ago during the protests against Ali Khamenei's regime. Now she is piecing her life back together, working illegally as a masseuse in a private flat. Whispers of Elaheh's magical hands spread through Tehran. Men with ties to the government book appointments, some enticed by the prospect of a "happy ending". Elaheh never wears a hijab and speaks openly about her hair, but takes only the risks she can measure. She dreams of escaping suffocating Tehran and stealing a kiss from her boyfriend, Soheil, in the heart of Berlin.

items.title: The Painter, the Forest and the Canvas
items.overview: "The Painter, the Forest, and the Canvas" is a documentary short blending interviews and dramatizations. It explores inspiration, dreams, and childhood through the creative lens of Argentine visual artist Ricardo Celma, guiding the audience on a fantastical journey centered on a boy’s adventure and his bond with mythical characters.

items.title: Tiché Vody
items.overview: In this portrait, a creative rise gradually collides with a personal fall, followed by a search for the strength to carry on. It follows his journey from the making of the album S.A.M.O. to the preparation of his biggest concert to date. Through different periods and situations, the film brings us closer to Saul's personality, his way of thinking, his relationship with music, and the people around him. In this way, the film captures not only the creation of music, but also the person at a time of profound personal and creative transformation.

items.title: Vertigo Garden
items.overview: The extraordinary ideas of an East Chinese botanist who sought to connect with the Earth's memories through the roots of a "living fossil" tree species are brought to life through creative filmmaking techniques, editing, and soundtrack.

items.title: Maaya Oviyan
items.overview: A street artist’s life takes an unexpected turn when his artwork comes to life, leading him on an emotional journey filled with mystery, love, and hidden memories.

items.title: Freeborn
items.overview: In the aftermath of a devastating civil war and amid the ruins of a fractured America, a father risks everything to protect his daughter from an oppressive new regime - setting the stage for a battle that will decide the fate of humanity.

items.title: People Experience
items.overview: Three HR colleagues have to deal with an unexpected, last-minute request on a late Friday afternoon.

items.title: Silent Speed
items.overview: Nathaniel Dorsky’s poetic re-imagination of footage shot for the documentary “Illuminations” by Patrick Shen and Brandon Vedder.

items.title: Charlies Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
items.overview: Charlie, a wannabe influencer who vlogs his life is faced with a zombie apocalypse, he knows there's no way out so he’s documenting his experience of what it’s like in the apocalypse while he’s still alive and not dead.

items.title: Para Mì
items.overview: Telling the story of the end of a love affair gives rise to something unexpected. Para Mì, by Caterina Bertini, began as a diary to come to terms with the end of a relationship, but gradually evolved into a photographic account of one of the most difficult periods in Cuba’s recent history.

items.title: The Death of Eskel McLaughlin
items.overview: The sequel to 'The Adventures of Eskel McLaughlin'. Join Eskel McLaughlin on a new case, in a high-stakes political thriller where the future of Wales is a stake.

items.title: Lo scrittore di silenzi
items.overview: What if AI were used not as a visual gimmick but as a human, therapeutic resource? In Lo scrittore di silenzi, a man in his seventies with ALS can communicate with the outside world only through an eye-tracking device, transferring his thoughts, memories and emotions onto a screen, accompanied by the sound his steady breathing in the background.

items.title: Pensaba que te habías olvidado de escribirme
items.overview: A man recalls his time as a political prisoner during the Chilean military dictatorship at Pisagua prison: on one side, the desert; on the other, the sea. A collection of letters he sent to his wife and family meets the desert in the present. Underground images pass one after another, blurring the distinctions between stone, rock, and bone.

items.title: Bus Window Memories
items.overview: A rainy bus ride becomes a poetic reflection on memory, love, and the small details of urban life. Through imagined cinema, conversations, and drifting memories, two voices travel across a city suspended in nostalgia and time.

items.title: Sapped
items.overview: Lucas, a laid-off Canadian steelworker, heads into the woods for a solo camping trip but winds up aboard a UFO. Face-to-face with a snarky alien threatening to obliterate Canada, Lucas gets one chance to convince his captor that his homeland is worth saving.

items.title: Human.ID
items.overview: Human.ID is an immersive XR documentary that plunges viewers into a near-future digital ecosystem where adaptive AI systems analyze, question, and redefine the boundaries of human identity and consciousness.

items.title: A Space Love Story Against Oblivion
items.overview: In 1977, the Voyager probes left Earth carrying the Golden Record: a collection of images, sounds, music and greetings in fifty-five languages, an attempt to describe humankind to an unknown recipient, whose existence was uncertain, as was its ability to understand us.

items.title: Storia di un bimbo mucca
items.overview: Elisabetta Falanga sets out to reconstruct the childhood of her partner, Abido, in Morocco in order to understand his sudden return to religion. But their conversations end up exposing the prejudices and differences that run through their life as a couple.

items.title: Melma
items.overview: A mother and her son, deserted roads, the flight of birds. Beaches, hands, faces, flowers. Nature, cities and mechanical presences come together in Melma, by Maya Ivona Peiu and Alessia Cascone, to create a visual poem that slips into nightmare. A boy searches for his lost beloved in a post-apocalyptic world engulfed by sludge. He and she, nameless figures bound by a love that has run its course, of which only fragments and unrealized possibilities remain.

items.title: Volta ao Mundo
items.overview: 17th century. Twelve years after setting sail on a sea voyage, Adriano — presumed dead — returns to Marta’s coastal home in an attempt to reclaim his past with her. Upon his return, he finds the house inhabited by her new husband, Costa — a kind man who welcomes him with open arms — and the couple’s mute son. In order to avoid destroying the family, Adriano conceals his identity, pretending to be a messenger.

items.title: Behind the Rockies
items.overview: A solitary paraglider follows the spine of the Rocky Mountains, from the Mexican border all the way to the heart of Canada, moving forward only with the wind beneath his wing or the slow rhythm of his steps, over more than 3,000km. From the southern deserts where snakes glide through the dust to the vast Canadian forests watched over by bears, his journey gradually transforms into an inner quest for the true meaning of adventure. As the landscapes unfold and solitude deepens, he discovers that the greatness of a journey does not necessarily lie in the extreme, but in those simple moments when one feels alive, far from the world, suspended between earth and sky.

items.title: Blue After Gold
items.overview: A quiet film student forms a fleeting connection with a pianist, forcing him to choose between capturing moments and truly living them.

items.title: A Deadly Proposal
items.overview: Marisa Pete's life is turned upside down when her ex-husband James claims he is dying of aggressive cancer and asks her to care for him in his final weeks. Against her better judgment and with reluctant support from her husband, Stephone Marisa brings James into their home. As James' condition fluctuates and tensions rise, unsettling clues begin to surface. What appears to be compassion soon reveals itself as manipulation, with life or death consequences, forcing Marisa to confront a terrifying truth before it's too late.

items.title: Love?
items.overview: When a partner decides to go through the other person's phone and finds everything that they thought they would. They both must confront the truth of what their relationship and love are.

items.title: Look for It
items.overview: Sanya, a guy from the provinces, inflicts severe injuries on a local thug named Shurup while defending himself. Shurup loses consciousness, and it becomes clear that his life is in danger. Sanya hopes for the best, but the next morning, there’s a knock at the door.

items.title: Solitaire
items.overview: A man’s mind descends in his time stuck in a bathroom

items.title: Gun Boy
items.overview: The story follows a 10-year-old boy named Thai who wakes up one morning to discover a terrifying power he never wanted: he can shoot real guns directly out of his hands.

items.title: Rory Scovel: Improvised in Brooklyn
items.overview: In January of 2025, comedian Rory Scovel did ten straight nights of shows from Union Hall in Brooklyn, New York where he experimented with improvising stand-up alongside different musicians who were also improvising their music.
