This is the full length recording of the second show, accompanied that night by Grammy Award-winning composer Bill Sherman.

items.title: Serafima
items.overview: experimental short

items.title: Travessia - Passa Quatro e a Revolução de 1932
What Happened to Danny
items.overview: Danny Chen, 19, from Chinatown, dies in Afghanistan under suspicious circumstances. Family and community seek truth about his final weeks, confronting racism and institutional power, honoring his memory and seeking accountability.

items.title: Tiny Things
items.overview: A woman finds solace, connection and fleeting joy in a recorded message from her astronaut wife.

items.title: Sidemen: The Motive
items.overview: Everyone has a motive. When an opulent murder mystery dinner takes a deadly turn, a group of unsuspecting guests must outwit a hidden killer among them before the night is over

items.title: Redemption's Price
items.overview: Submitted for the 'Shooting from the Hip' 48 hour film competition. Shot on iPhone.  A Hitman battles his morality as he's given his latest assignment.

items.title: Model Minority Girlfriend
items.overview: Ever wanted a girlfriend who could fix all your problems for you? Perhaps one who doesn't believe in divorce? Well, do we have the product for you.

items.title: Devil's Burger
items.overview: George is a delivery driver for a burger restaurant. One day, at the very end of his shift, his boss gives him one last assignment. Once he arrives at the house, George has no idea what's in store for him.

items.title: Sister Act (Newcastle west music society)
items.overview: When lively lounge singer Deloris sees her mobster beau commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, she proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters.

items.title: Romeo & Juliet
items.overview: The Bard's classic from the Public Theater's Free Shakespeare in the Park, set in the fictional border town of Verona, where Romeo and Juliet speak to each other in Spanish, the language of their private world.

items.title: La Partida
items.overview: For a child, losing a beloved grandparent can be strange and incomprehensible. In this story, Daniel and his grandmother reconnect and relearn after the loss of his grandfather.

items.title: Fucking Nowhere
items.overview: November, 2026. A group of 10 college students travel into the isolated upstate New York woods to shoot a horror film.

items.title: Papa
items.overview: Papa' follows Attila Ponczók’s irascible grandfather as a lifetime of generational patriarchal patterns collides with Hungary’s housing crisis. His pride upends his devoted sons’ lives as they struggle to find him a home and battle the labyrinthine, ineffective social system meant to protect him.

items.title: One Arm Under The Bridge
items.overview: A man tells a traumatic story. His friends convince him to face his fears.

items.title: One Last Walk
items.overview: so, how long do we have...

items.title: Young, British and Tradwife
items.overview: Film-maker Poppy Jay meets British women who embrace the tradwife lifestyle to ask why they are rejecting feminism, pinning on the apron and obeying their husbands

items.title: The Motive
items.overview: Who done it?

items.title: Har Maidan Fateh
items.overview: The story follows five troubled youths who unite after participating in a reality show to build a startup. They face mounting challenges, harsh realities, family expectations, and rising ambitions as they try to carve out a path to success.

items.title: Mourning's King
items.overview: A group of friends in their twenties sneak into the garage of an abandoned house to get high and talk about their lives and their afterlives. They are haunted, but only by themselves. This is not a horror story, but it is a ghost story.

items.title: Did It Wrong
items.overview: Hearing a cashier sing his song is the best thing that’s happened to Marty all year. Finding out who she thinks wrote it is the worst.

items.title: Hard Debt
items.overview: Hard Debt is an action filled movie, following two humble civilians who have never hurt a fly, engage in more criminal acts to avoid Loan Sharks and try to pay off the debt. Their character development starts out as pure yet willing to turn to a life of crime in order to survive and gradually will try to overcome more fears as they evade the law.*

items.title: Inside the Asylum Camp
items.overview: Mass accommodation sites are central to the Government's plan to end the use of asylum hotels and this undercover investigation goes inside Crowborough, a former military training camp in East Sussex now housing asylum seekers. The programme investigates conditions inside the site, finding how systemically poor welfare checks are having serious consequences, and also examines the local community's response to asylum seekers being housed in the town.

items.title: One Early Morning, the Alligator Swallowed Me
items.overview: The northern Colombian town of Plato is known for the legend of the Alligator Man, who could change shape and use his disguise to spy unnoticed on women in the river. There is even a museum dedicated to him. This confident student film breathes new life into the local folklore through an enigmatic portrait of a solitary fisherman. He is filmed on the river and in the wetlands, with an emphasis on the beauty of the surroundings.

items.title: Thanks, Putin - The Housing Crisis in Europe
items.overview: Journalist Gabriele Nunziati investigates the housing crisis in Europe from Brussels, through the voices of homeless people, squatters, activists, social workers and Members of the European Parliament.

items.title: Amalaamrutha
items.overview: Amalaamrutha is a 2026 Kannada film

items.title: Esquisse
items.overview: A young girl discovers that the boy born from her drawings has come to life.

items.title: Punjab Na Bhuliyo
items.overview: Deep chases dreams abroad but vanishes into a human trafficking trap of fake visas. When the government fails, his mother Simran and brother Aman fight back. It's not one family's story — it's the story of countless youth.

items.title: ELLES
items.overview: Lola begins her gender transition without a support network that understands her. A transvestite helps her find her place in a magical trans and non-binary community where certain hormones trigger animal transformations. This debut feature is a self-funded film produced by a team entirely composed of LGBTQIA+ individuals.

items.title: Animas
items.overview: Celebrating Día de los Muertos in Pilsen, Chicago, this short follows community members as they blend culture, grief, and advocacy through this ancient practice—honoring the dead while strengthening the bonds of the living.

items.title: I Hit a Deer
items.overview: On the way home, Mian’s father hits a deer. The burgeoning anxiety from this incident builds to a climax in a tunnel, where she experiences both nothingness and the universe.

items.title: Califato 3/4: Bale el êffuerço que emo exo
Frosted
items.overview: Jack Frost’s daughter and Santa Claus’s son must come together to save Christmas from a blizzard that Jack Frost’s newest invention has caused

items.title: Rapid Eye Movement
items.overview: A young woman falls asleep while watching a movie about laziness

items.title: Gaming Rebels
items.overview: The year is 199X and the company known as NAN has a monopoly on the video game industry, but one man plans to challenge that... Jack Wang, businessman extraordinaire, is pulled into a world of crime and corporate espionage for one last job.

items.title: Guarding Stars
items.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

items.title: ENE Repeat
items.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

items.title: White Blast
items.overview: At a remote train station covered in heavy snow, a station master Gap-su is facing the last day of his life-long dedication to the station. Devastated by the sudden layoffs, Gap-su keeps waiting for his young replacement, who still hasn’t yet come. As the hush reigns throughout the station, Gap-su sees the breaking news that dozens of convicts escaped from the overturned prison bus, and just then, a young man walks into the station claiming himself as the one Gap-su has been waiting for.

items.title: The First Five Minutes... The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
items.overview: An in-depth exploration into the life of Dan Perri, the man who created titles for some of the most iconic movies of all time.

items.title: Heysel 85
items.overview: When 39 people are killed prior to the European Cup at the Brussels Heysel stadium in 1985, the mayor's daughter and an Italian journalist are torn between their professional assignments, family, and human nature.

items.title: When She Hears the Bells
items.overview: Afghanistan, summer 2021. As the Taliban gradually seize control of the country, Leila, a young widow, arrives in Kabul. She begins working in a kitchen that she discovers is part of a Bacha Bazi house. Very young, androgynous boys there dance dressed as women before audiences of men. She meets Tamim, a Bacha whom she decides to help. She will try to save other young boys and leave the country before the city falls.

items.title: Brighter Than Fire
items.overview: At seventeen, HSU I-NING drifts into a precarious, power-unequal relationship with her teacher, HSUEH, and meets a mysterious BOY freeing a pomelo from a car on the same night. Ten years later, trapped in a stifling marriage, she reunites with the same mysterious boy. After her husband vanishes, I-Ning returns to the rooftop, where burning pomelo peel reignites her lost self.

items.title: The Royal Nannies
items.overview: Carter is tasked with serving as both nanny and protector to Princess Isabella while the King and Queen are away on a trade mission. Under the guardianship of her uncle, Prince Theo, the family is faced with unexpected challenges, and as Carter and Theo grow closer, she finds herself torn between love and duty.

items.title: Status: Rejected
items.overview: Longing for love and the promise of a better life, a grandmother finds herself swept into an unexpected online romance that challenges her sense of worth, family, and the dreams she refuses to let go of.

items.title: Andoy
items.overview: A surprise birthday celebration turns into a waking nightmare when an enigmatic clown transforms a gathering of old friends into a series of disturbing performances, forcing each of them to confront the darkest truths they've hidden from one another.

items.title: Enjoy Your Stay
items.overview: To avoid losing custody of her six-year-old daughter in Manila, Luz, an undocumented Filipina cleaner working in a luxury Swiss ski resort, must earn money at any cost – even if it means transgressing her own moral limits.

items.title: Last Meal
items.overview: The passionate love between pianist Sebahat and Bekir is cut short when he vanishes without a trace. Years later, when fate reunites them, they realize that neither time, distance, nor the life Sebahat has built could ever break their bond. Together, they embark on a journey that pushes the very limits of love, loyalty, and sacrifice because some loves are worth fighting for, no matter what.

items.title: Arne Goes to Space
items.overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.

items.title: Malika
items.overview: A biopic of Malika Bellaribi, a French-Algerian woman who grew up in the Parisian projects, who survived trauma and ultimately achieved her dream of becoming a renowned lyrical singer.

items.title: Caballé
items.overview: The beloved opera star Montserrat Caballé faces a challenge that takes her back to the beginning of her career.

items.title: The Night Was Completely Ruined
items.overview: One chaotic, wild night in the streets of Cairo. The story revolves around a young man who is fiercely determined to chase his dream of becoming an entrepreneur and starting his own business. Alongside his friend and his cousin, his ambitious plans take an unexpected turn when their paths cross with a local taxi driver.

items.title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince
items.overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.

items.title: V. Shantaram
items.overview: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

items.title: The Holdout
items.overview: Harold Milton, a fiercely independent rancher, is enraged when expanding AI data centers contaminate his land and water, killing his livestock and threatening his family’s livelihood. After confronting the development company CEO, Arthur Irwin, and discovering that they intend to proceed despite the harm, Harold finds himself increasingly isolated as neighboring ranchers accept lucrative buyouts. When Arthur and his security team are involved in a violent confrontation with Harold’s ranch hand, Harold decides that peaceful resistance is no longer enough. Armed with explosives and firearms, Harold is forced to take a stand before they take everything.

items.title: The Matriarch
items.overview: Seventeen-year-old Kim lives with her emotionally distant mother, mute younger brother, and strangers hiding in a secret room in their apartment at the Baltic coast. Vietnamese migrants regularly pass through their home as her mother, a key figure in a criminal network, runs human trafficking operations. When her mother's associate Luc defects to start a rival operation, Kim seizes her chance to prove herself to her mother. She navigates her first romance while entering a clandestine family business. As her good intentions drag her into a dark and brutal underworld that contradicts her sensitive nature, Kim begins to question the true costs of earning respect by crossing her own boundaries.

items.title: Hot Wieners and Coffee Milk
items.overview: On the night before Halloween in a small New England town, a local hot wiener delivery driver attempts to get out of work on time for a holiday tradition he’s kept since childhood. Things prove difficult as he navigates car troubles, a rival pizza delivery driver, and a cast of lonely regulars all keeping him stuck.
A short film that explores the concept of a film within a film, and what happens inside the world of a film, when it glitches in someone's software.

items.title: Pretty Model Author of Bloody Movie
items.overview: A documentary about the life and career of model, actress, and screenwriter Allison Louise Downe

items.title: Chris Kent Goes Offline
items.overview: After going through a period of anxiety, successful Irish comedian Chris Kent decides to forgo the internet in an attempt to reconnect with his family- all whilst writing a new show

items.title: Sixty-eighties
items.overview: As CANAL+ pays tribute to the 80s, Kyan Khojandi is hosting a new special show to celebrate this colorful decade with many guests.

items.title: One Month
items.overview: For 45-year-old artist Sarah, this is not a hypothetical issue. With her parents' 50th wedding anniversary approaching, they give her an ultimatum: she has one month to leave the family home. After a lifetime of being protected and supported by them, Sarah is suddenly expected to become independent. And there is one bizarre condition: if she ever wants to return, she must have a child to carry on the family line.

items.title: Snow in June
items.overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.

items.title: Ricardo Remix Feat. COVID-19
items.overview: Amid the isolation of the COVID-19 pandemic, Ricardo, a young film student, grapples with heartbreak and family tensions. As reality unravels, he retreats into imagined versions of the film he’s struggling to create—blurring the line between his script and his life.

items.title: When I Existed
items.overview: Silvio Bertolini has just retired after 40 years as an Accounting Manager. His reward? A pregnant daughter in Barcelona, a wife eager for a family trip, and a government that insists he is dead.

items.title: A Primeira Vez A Gente Nunca Esquece
The Manhattan Projector
items.overview: A young movietalker attempts to prevent the end of the world via a collective collect call. A prequel to WAX OR THE DISCOVERY OF TELEVISION AMONG THE BEES, the first movie on the internet.

items.title: LIM YOUNG WOONG | IM HERO THE STADIUM 2
sad pride generation
items.overview: Paris, June 2024. It's summer, it's Pride, but Maël is getting ghosted and Emilie just got dumped. Luckily, somewhere in the crowd, Maël meets Emilie and Emilie meets Maël.

items.title: Princess
items.overview: Twelve-year-old Kallpa has one big dream: to be chosen as Ñusta, the sacred princess in her Andean community's Winter Solstice Festival. However, she is barred from taking part because she was born in the body of a boy. As rigid traditions and growing rejection push her out, Kallpa finds a new home and family among a group of local trans women. Even while facing harsh prejudice, this close-knit group wraps Kallpa in real warmth and tenderness, giving her the room to figure out who she is and learn to love herself. Her journey becomes a quiet, resilient fight to live life on her own terms.

items.title: Mangabangabaka
items.overview: Vibrant, colorful, and warm portrait of 47-year-old Sonia, who wants to leave her life as a sex worker behind and find a different means of making a living—no easy task in Madagascar, one of the poorest countries in the world, but Sonia is determined.

items.title: Vagar
items.overview: February 2026: Nerea, a young dreamer, arrives in the city where she meets Sael. Through voice memos recorded on the underground, streets and buildings, Nerea reflects on our place as human beings in the world. Nerea’s message will fall into Sael’s hands, thrown from the top of a skyscraper.

items.title: TechnoChimères
items.overview: A young drag queen falls asleep. Her dreams take shape above her face: she dreams of herself bringing her future show to life.

items.title: Madness
items.overview: Deep in the night, on a desolate road, a driver and a hitchhiker hears on the car radio, a chilling broadcast that a serial killer is on the loose nearby — and tension rises.

items.title: Delta Kids
items.overview: Leo, Unai and Josepet are three children who live in La Ribera, in the heart of the Ebro Delta (Catalonia). During one of their last summers before adolescence, we observe their friendship and the little adventures that fill their days. Between rice fields, motorcycles and dives, the sincere portrait of a radically free childhood and a rural world emerges, which gradually disappears.

items.title: Where the Air Tastes Like the Sea
items.overview: After a long winter of competitions, expeditions and personal setbacks, four Arc'teryx athletes trade fixed plans for fifteen days aboard a small sailboat in Northern Norway. Chasing ski lines through unpredictable weather, they soon realize the trip has little to do with perfect conditions. Living shoulder to shoulder and moving at the pace of the wind, they rediscover the joy of slowing down, embracing uncertainty, and finding freedom in the simplest moments.

items.title: Briciola!
items.overview: A young woman scrolls through her desktop and finds her childhood filmed in VHS by her mother, until that gaze disappears. What remains are files on computers: a girl growing up under the watch of her PCs searching for approval.

items.title: Chair, Chair
items.overview: Two chairs run away from society and decide to live in nature...

items.title: Salam Beresoon
items.overview: Despite their deep bond, Mahnoush and her father Shahin are separated by their different realities. When Mahnoush visits Shahin, a confrontation ensues.

items.title: The Fable of the Oplose
items.overview: The Fable of the Oplose follows two coworkers, Kellen and Rose, as they navigate life between shifts at a local restaurant. The story follows the 'magic' that holds the service industry together, exploring the tension of a workplace romance.

items.title: Historic Sites
items.overview: A woman travels through the Northeastern United States, gradually engaging with modernism and paintings from the 19th century.

items.title: Expiation
items.overview: Juan rescues a young woman in trouble, never suspecting that this single act will drag him back into the depths of his past.

items.title: Moth Wood
items.overview: A moth leads a young girl into the woods, where she discovers a huge cocoon, its dust causing her metamorphosis. Shot on 16 & 8mm and hand-processed with nettles from Cornish woodlands, this film is imbued with the landscape in which it was made.

items.title: Sofi Jeannin dirigiert Bach und Nystedt - Auditorium de Radio France, Paris
Non è la fine del mondo
items.overview: A volcano erupts; black clouds fill the sky. The end of the world is getting closer, or perhaps it is just an illusion. Francesco Mastroleo counters this apocalyptic atmosphere by interviewing Neapolitan women at the Virtual Archeological Museum in Ercolano.

items.title: Oscena
items.overview: What if we woke up from the collective hypnosis that keeps us forever tense and striving for unreachable aesthetic ideals? What if we reclaimed our real bodies, left outside the frame? Oscena is a visionary journey of images and sounds through the battlefield that is the female body. A manifesto film, political and poetic, that turns the gaze back on the body: a space to inhabit, to desire and, finally, to set free.

items.title: Gomorrah
items.overview: Private Investigator Donald Anderson is hired to follow a woman believed to be having an  affair, but when he sees something that defies all explanation, his grasp on reality slips. The  further he gets in his investigation, the thinner the line between the real and the surreal  becomes.

items.title: The MINIMAL : a short chapter
items.overview: few leaders and a company collabrates and  brings national income crises  hero tries to stop it and save people from poverty life

items.title: Just as artificial as I am
items.overview: A boy constantly seeking validation begins turning to an artificial intelligence for answers to the most diverse questions about his life. Amid endless questions, doubts, and insecurities, he develops an increasingly dependent relationship with the technology. Until, unexpectedly, the AI begins responding in a hostile manner, questioning his behavior and sending increasingly strange messages. Gradually, inexplicable events begin to invade his reality, making it increasingly difficult to distinguish between a technological malfunction and what might be happening beyond the screen.

items.title: Tangenziale
items.overview: Mia and Baxter learn what it truly takes to be Italian at the Norton St Italian Festa.

items.title: In Passing
items.overview: A naive young man must overcome fear in pursuit of instinct for a girl he sees everyday.

items.title: Asterione percorre in bici tutte le rotonde di Caravaggio, (BG), 24043
items.overview: In Greek mythology, Asterion is one of the names given to the Minotaur, a creature hidden in the labyrinth of Crete. Andrés Testa Herranz and Giacomo Colombo bring the myth to the Po Valley: a figure wearing a bulky paper mask rides a bicycle through the roundabouts of Caravaggio.

items.title: Interrogation
items.overview: Two criminal investigators find themselves caught in the dark while interrogating an unsound individual.

items.title: Cyberleek: Origins
items.overview: A discord mod makes a team to steal GTA VI in order to save his grandma's life.

items.title: Where Did You Sleep Last Night?
items.overview: Since his parents’ divorce, Andrea, a young man of Sri Lankan descent living in Naples, has been suffering from severe episodes of sleepwalking. He wakes up in different places across the city in the middle of the night, having no idea how he got there.

items.title: Sucession
items.overview: An aging professional luchador at the twilight of his career hands down his mask to his son in a final act of love and sacrifice.

items.title: Money by Sundown
items.overview: When kidnappers take her teenage daughter, a small town divorcée must team up with her good-for-nothing ex-husband in order to pull together the ransom money.

items.title: Bicycle
items.overview: A peaceful bicycle ride winds through a sunlit rural path bordered by lush trees and golden agricultural fields, capturing a quiet moment of everyday countryside life.

items.title: Fan
items.overview: This Experimental Debut showcases distorted close cuts, Horizontal and Vertical angles and Color Frames next to a Ceiling Fan.

items.title: In superficie
items.overview: In 1959, an expedition of Italian geologists was sent to Iran in search of oil. As the days went by, their gaze wavered as the landscape became inscrutable, unfamiliar and unsettling.

items.title: The Community
items.overview: 5 people enter a secluded location with the intention to join a secretive community and meet the leader behind it all. When the leader doesn't show up, tensions rise and everyone is thrown under suspicion.

items.title: Chronic
items.overview: A sensitive teen falls for his masculine brother's girlfriend.

items.title: Una distanza siderale
items.overview: In a documentary, every image reflects the subjectivity of the one who creates it. In Una distanza siderale, Noemi Forti transforms this awareness into narration: the footage of a performance by Thomas Valerio, artist and co-writer of this film, conceals a relationship. The attention devoted to the performance coexists with the love and fear that permeate every image.

items.title: And
items.overview: The friendship between two boys end when one finally admits they need to part ways.

items.title: When It Happened
items.overview: After a painful breakup, Kohl Rivas and Verona Marsh are haunted by everyday reminders of their time together; as they navigate the echoes of their past, they find moments of healing—but is it closure they’re reaching for, or a way back to each other?

items.title: Virginia Woolf : Un lieu à soi, une voix pour toutes
railroad underdogs
items.overview: railroad underdogs (2026) is a short film about local bands in the Denton TX scene that have impacted the community with their music. From advocating for the LGBTQ+ community, freeing Palestine, to harm reduction.

items.title: A shirt
items.overview: A young man meticulously puts on his public  armor—straightening his collar, counting his  money, and stepping out to face the world.  But behind closed doors on a quiet terrace,  the facade strips away, revealing the stark  contrast between how we present ourselves  to strangers and who we are when no one is  watching.

items.title: Nook & Cranny
items.overview: Through the sequences traced by different body parts, the complexities of seeking connection are explored.  From awkwardness to a gradual unravelling, fleeting moments to a swelling height of emotion, the quest for intimacy is revealed to be a bittersweet pursuit—one with many tensions we must learn to navigate.

items.title: Creatureland
items.overview: A melancholic office worker is confronted by a gaggle of magical creatures.

items.title: Melt Music
items.overview: An overzealous music collector gets more than he bargained for after finding a mysterious CD

items.title: CJ Wallace’s Looking Glass: The Root Beer Overfloweth
items.overview: Entranced by the dopey nature of an internet root beer reviewer, filmmaker CJ Wallace attempts to craft an electric documentary film.

items.title: She Who Refused Death
items.overview: When the Great Darkness returns to consume the world, Matilda, the daughter of the legendary King Adler, must journey through a realm swallowed by death and corruption. Armed only with her father's stories and an unbreakable will, she challenges an ancient force that has claimed countless lives, refusing to accept that death is the end.

items.title: Grahanam
items.overview: Grahanam is a psychological thriller that focuses on the conversation of Deepan and his psychiatrist for a cause that takes an unexpected turn.

items.title: Lonely Boy Goes To a Rave
items.overview: A social recluse finally gets a chance with his crush.

items.title: Here and There
items.overview: WARNING! EXTRATERRESTRIAL SIGHTING!  Cork City has been invaded by an  extraterrestrial creature who's only after one thing: to find a new home.

items.title: City of Light
items.overview: A short film about the lights and love of a city

items.title: Au loin
items.overview: A summer in rural France. Fourteen-year-old Marion urges her brother and his friends to confront a young group of nomadic travelers who have just settled on the outskirts of their village. But when she meets fifteen-year-old Wendy, an unexpected bond destabilizes her, challenging her perceptions and arousing emotions she struggles to understand.

items.title: Let’s Build a Shelter for the Beaver Population on Campus!
items.overview: Two offbeat college students go on a quest to pay back the local beaver population.

items.title: Enthéorie
items.overview: With neither villains nor heroes, Enthéorie takes place in a wondrous elsewhere, where a hero, accompanied by his horse-headed squire, sets out in search of a princess he believes he must rescue. Through the conventions of a fairy tale, the film explores determinism, free will, and the roles assigned to us.

items.title: Iteraciones
items.overview: A woman becomes trapped between the hallways of her building, her memories, and an unresolved grief.

items.title: Generation Loneliness
items.overview: They are the most connected and yet the loneliest generation: Generation Z is torn between fear, anger and the search for genuine connection.

items.title: The Runners
items.overview: Four friends from the outskirts of Buenos Aires get lost while travelling to a party downtown. A parody of the 2026 film "Los Nadadores".

items.title: The Root Of It All
items.overview: A young man, fearing for his future, suddenly falls into the tourist trap of the Wisconsin Dells, where he is chauffeured on a seemingly never ending weekend by an eclectic heir to The Museum of Root Beer.

items.title: Shades of Darkness
items.overview: A thriller-satire about how hurtful stereotypes can be.

items.title: IDK $H!T
items.overview: In a reality that doesn't exist outside of their screens, A therapy program brings togather Arabella Skyler Barney, a 14-year-old rebellious and full-of-life girl and Braxter Felix, a 16-year-old boy who has grown up in dark and unsettling places all his life. Two VERY different people that will have to figure out who is behind this simulation and how to break free from it.

items.title: The Last Song
items.overview: After losing his daughter in a tragic car accident, a former report will follow the perpetrator, hopping that it will ease his mind

items.title: The Lure of Light
items.overview: On Broadway, the night lights up to sell. Amid flashes, advertisements, and glowing surfaces, the camera observes the intensities and flows of desire that move through images. An audiovisual essay that attempts to make audible what light keeps silent.

items.title: Still Living
items.overview: Through repetition and routine, a newspaper vendor’s life unfolds amid the slow disappearance of the world that once depended on him.

items.title: The Cowardly Chandoks
items.overview: The Chandok twins, Rahi and Roohi, face the consequences of stealing a magical orb from the town sire in this whimsical fantasy/drama.

items.title: The Cell
items.overview: In an alternate reality where housekeeping is officially the best job, an intern at the Ministry of Household Affairs must face a final test that will determine the future foundation of his world

items.title: White and Fluffy
items.overview: Following her divorce, Olya is dividing up her assets and numbing her troubles with alcohol. On the night of her birthday, in a drunken state, she unleashes all her pent-up rage on her innocent twin sister. The next morning, her sister has vanished—and Olya discovers a thin, white dog in the house

items.title: Beni
items.overview: The owner of Beni discovers that he is capable of other skills.

items.title: Melting Ice
items.overview: Following the death of her mother, and while struggling with the tragedy, Alyona lives a reclusive life in an old village house. Her peace is disrupted by the sudden return of her brother, Mitya, and his wife, Marina

items.title: O.M: Operation Mole
items.overview: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

items.title: Josephine
items.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

items.title: Bachelor Party D'eux
items.overview: When urban chaos erupts around them, a band of honour-bound thieves must pull off a dangerous escape together, refusing to abandon each other despite deadly obstacles in their path.

items.title: Inherit
items.overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.

items.title: The Body in the Locker
items.overview: When Amy, the CEO of a major charity, loses her father, she's shocked to discover he owned a mysterious storage locker with a deadly secret inside - the body of a woman. Was her father a murderer? Who was this woman?

items.title: Hamka: Awal Mula Vol. 3
items.overview: Set against the backdrop of West Sumatra, a passionate young rebel clashes with his strict scholar father, prompting a self-funded pilgrimage to Mecca where he discovers his destiny to reform Indonesian Islam and finds the love of his life.

items.title: The Fire Within You
items.overview: Antonio, who fled Naples many years ago, has built a family and a successful career in Milan, far from his mother Angela — a woman excessive in both her virtues and her flaws, irresistible, old-fashioned and hostile like few others — who has come to visit for Christmas and seems determined to stay.  Christmas Eve dinner becomes an emotional battlefield, at once comic and fierce, bringing to the surface a past of impositions and misunderstandings. With a stubborn capon that refuses to end up in the pot, a daughter whose arrival remains uncertain, and an unexpected distinguished guest, the evening turns into a reckoning between mother and son destined to change the meaning of their bond forever: a love that burns like a fire within, one that never dies out — not even by leaving.

items.title: The Kolotun and the Magic Kingdom
items.overview: The Snegirev family is preparing to celebrate the New Year together for the last time, after which Anfisa and Igor will tell their son Roma about the divorce.

items.title: Viana – The Legend of the Golden Hearts
items.overview: In the north of medieval Portugal, the beautiful Ana falls in love with Thomas, a poor artisan. Her father immediately forbids their union, demanding that his daughter’s suitors produce a jewel as proof of their nobility. But the young couple refuse to give up. With the help of their faithful companions, the generosity of the townswomen and the talent of a mysterious jewellery maker, Ana and Thomas will face many challenges out of love, including the powerful and evil Duke of Aragon.

items.title: I Am Going to Miss You
items.overview: Amanda and Caio are a trans couple who share seven years of love and dreams. However, when they decide to live together, the differences between them begin to take their toll.

items.title: The Rainbow Fish
items.overview: The rainbow fish, an outsider obsessed with his glittering scales, learns the power of friendship on an adventurous sea voyage with the little blue fish. He finds his place in a colorful fish community—and realizes that sharing brings people together.

items.title: Dark Noon
items.overview: Caught in a cycle of petty crime and imprisonment, a man is released from prison for a failed bank robbery attempt while an impending solar eclipse offers a way out of the cycle.

items.title: Traveler's Hell
items.overview: On an isolated road late at night, a young woman, driving alone, comes across a stranded male driver whose car has broken down on a mountain road notorious for disappearances and murders. Choosing empathy over a creeping sense of foreboding, she offers him a ride to the nearest station. That single choice unleashes a harrowing chain of strange and terrifying events in the dead of night, turning a simple gesture of kindness into a real-life nightmare.

items.title: The Painter & the Prince
items.overview: Prince Henry of Serendovia goes undercover on a Christmas painting show to prove to his family he was born to paint, not to rule. He never expects to team up with Shelby, a self-taught painter fighting to save her mother's art hub.

items.title: Off Screen
items.overview: No one knows what demons the darkness hides within itself.

items.title: Father's House
items.overview: In an intriguing cinematic exercise that straddles fiction and documentary, 'Faderhuset' seeks to bare intricate workings of domination and manipulation, as ex-members of the notorious Christian sect Faderhuset direct scenes with well-known Danish actors, including Trine Dyrholm and David Dencik.

items.title: Time Machine Maidan
items.overview: In this haunting and visually inventive documentary, a spectral voice drifts through time and memory to trace the Maidan revolution and the roots of resistance in Ukraine.

items.title: Christmas En Pointe
items.overview: Years after breaking off their engagement, a small-town dance teacher and an ambitious senator returning home for Christmas are thrown back together to save her struggling studio, rekindling the love they once lost.

items.title: Дедмобиль
items.overview: Valera, a flawless driver with 30 years behind the wheel, loses his job just as his dog Lincoln needs an expensive lifesaving surgery. Desperate for income, he’s approached by a sleek, AI-powered self-driving taxi. To avoid spooking passengers, the car asks Valera to pretend to be its driver and help it achieve a top user rating — in exchange for all the earnings from their rides. For Valera, it’s his dog’s only chance; for the taxi, it’s a fight for its own survival.

items.title: The Assignment
items.overview: The summer of 1947. Although it is already the second year of peace following the devastating Second World War, its deep wounds are still everywhere. Thirteen-year-old Ewout, is also recovering from the conflict. He is just a boy, but he wants to be a man of distinction. He joins the scouts to prove himself. Unfortunately, things do not go to plan, and the others turn against him.

items.title: Gropiusstadt Supernova
items.overview: Berlin-Gropiusstadt, a prefabricated housing estate on the outskirts of the city. On the last day of the year, three young people are at a turning point: Tarik receives a letter about his impending deportation, Stella gets accepted to an acting school abroad, and Luan wakes up from a nightmare in which he is left behind by both of them.

items.title: Forest High
items.overview: In the northern Alps, Anne, Hélène and Suzanne take turns looking after a mountain hut. Through the seasons, hikers come and go. Stories bloom and fade, leaving each of them facing the silence of their chosen solitude and the poetry of nature.

items.title: Love in a Hopeless Place
items.overview: Modern dating sucks. Deidre is looking for love but she also has the luxury of feeding off them when they don't work out.

items.title: In Starland
items.overview: In small-town America, a solitary man drifts through life - until a group of fearless young artists crash into his world. A coming-of-middle-age story about identity, belonging, and the strange beauty of connection.

items.title: Piye To Kih?
items.overview: A broken heart drives Mukidi to prove that he is worthy of marrying the woman of his dreams. He works hard until he is able to buy an inexpensive house, which turns out to hold a mystery. In that house, he meets Sukma, a mysterious woman from the spirit world who has a different religion and background, yet manages to help Mukidi get over his heartbreak. Strange events begin to unfold, dragging his two best friends, Gendut and Penyok, into the chaos.

items.title: The Lost Plot
items.overview: Artur is a stand-up comedian who plans to turn his life around and write a book about the story of a female guerrilla fighter from the 1970s. He gets mugged and his computer containing his drafts is stolen, but an app takes photos of the people using the stolen computer and emails them to him.

items.title: Supporting Role
items.overview: A retired Georgian film star, used to playing heroic leads, embarks on a cathartic journey after a casting session with a young female director, who has offered him a supporting role of a bizarre and unsympathetic character in her debut film.

items.title: Mom and Dad are Gods
items.overview: In a clash of distant centuries and cultures, two children from the 7th century awaken inside a mystical cave from a thousand-year slumber into the chaotic 21st century. Along with them, two ancient Slavic gods rise, incarnating themselves as the parents of Petr and Simona, siblings from the 21st century, leading to countless entertaining adventures in which the four children join forces and bridge the gap between old and new times, cultures, and customs to save the souls of their parents, who are currently unbearably divine.

items.title: Bisikan
items.overview: A young man haunted by past trauma and hated by his father begins to experience disturbing whispers and horrifying visions in an old mansion. As he struggles to save his family, he becomes trapped between reality and his own imagination.

items.title: My Friend The Sun
items.overview: Diego, a father struggling to give his daughter Xóchitl a real home, sees his life transformed when the mural she paints opens a portal to Tollan, the realm of the Mexica gods. As Xóchitl is chosen as a possible Sixth Sun, the ambitious Tezcatlipoca plots to claim that power. Separated between worlds, father and daughter must face deception, gods, and their own flaws to reunite. With the help of unexpected allies, they discover that true strength is born from sacrifice, trust, and faith in humanity.

items.title: Sh*t Happens
items.overview: When their nine-year-old daughter falls mysteriously ill, a wealthy Dominican couple turns to an experimental treatment created from their housemaid Liddy's feces, without her knowledge. Once Liddy and her colleague Dominga discover the truth, they seize the opportunity to turn the household’s power dynamics upside down.

items.title: Black Shirts
items.overview: The story of the historic Vasco da Gama team—composed primarily of Black players from humble backgrounds—which, in 1923, secured the club’s first-ever Campeonato Carioca title. Blending documentary and fiction, the film bridges over a century of history to examine the persistence of racism in both football and contemporary society.

items.title: Spinoza
items.overview: In 1656 Amsterdam, young Jewish philosopher Bento de Spinoza watches his world collapse when his closest friend is executed for printing forbidden ideas. The city is gripped by plague, fear, and religious zeal, and Bento's growing habit of questioning sacred truths makes him a danger to both Church and synagogue. Amid this turmoil, he meets Rembrandt van Rijn, the once-celebrated painter now sliding into debt and disgrace.

items.title: Fight Back
items.overview: It’s not the hit… it’s how you rise.

items.title: Observer
items.overview: Filmmaker Ian Cheney embarks on an experiment in which he brings a series of keen-eyed observers - scientists, artists, a hunter - to a range of locations around the world, often without telling them where they are going, and asks them simply to describe what they see. What unfolds is a deep exploration and celebration of the power of observation: what happens when you find new ways to sense and perceive the world around you?

items.title: Menang Untuk Kalah
items.overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.

items.title: Break
items.overview: With his shimmering scales, the Rainbow Fish is the most beautiful fish in the entire ocean. But he is also vain and proud, which alienates the other fish. As a result, he becomes increasingly lonely. When he eventually loses one of his beloved glittering scales, it is none other than the Little Blue fish who accompanies him on the search into the deepest parts of the ocean. An adventurous journey begins – and the Rainbow Fish learns that together we are much braver than alone, and that true friendship is more precious than the most magnificent coat of scales.

items.title: Il destino dell'ape
items.overview: Emma is a young woman who discovers that the man who raised her is not her biological father. Her search for the truth becomes a transformative journey across Morocco; a quest for identity, freedom, family and self-discovery.

items.title: A December Tale 2: The Lost Letter
items.overview: Whilst preparing for yet another round of spreading holiday cheer, saint Nicholas discovers an unopened letter that had been sent to him by a young boy named Borys 30 years ago. Now the latter is a sucssesful businessman who had lost the abbility to see the joys and whimsy of life after being severly beaten down by the world around him. The legendary giftgiver enters a race against time to help the broken man regain his childlike wonder, or else one will forever loose the abbility to feel joy and the other, his magical powers.

items.title: The Great Lake Bums
items.overview: Over the holidays, Michael returns to the Midwest to stay with his best friends, all still living in their same old house from college in Milwaukee. During his several weeks stay, nights out are had, attempts are made to rekindle old flames, and it becomes more and more clear that his friends haven't grown up at all, while maybe Michael's grown up a little too much.

items.title: Разыскивается Дед Мороз
items.overview: On New Year's Eve, a not-so-lucky thief, Misha, breaks into a house in the very center of Moscow, where a lonely old man lives. Misha hopes to improve his unenviable financial situation and bring back his family - his wife and seven-year-old daughter. However, in the old man's big house, he finds nothing of any value, except for the deposits of children's toys in the basement. The old man himself assures him that he is none other than the real Father Frost.

items.title: The Girls Garden
items.overview: Julia inherited her mother Asunta’s job as a domestic worker in the wealthy De la Puente household, where she was raised alongside the family’s daughters. Asunta, an Andean woman who migrated to Lima after Peru’s 1970 earthquake, carried a life shaped by displacement, silence, and sacrifice. Over the years, affection and inequality became inseparably intertwined within the household. Now, as illness and old age expose long-buried secrets, Julia is forced to confront the invisible social order that has defined her existence. Torn between loyalty and freedom, she must decide whether to remain in the role imposed on her or finally reclaim her own identity.

items.title: Somewhere Else
items.overview: Somewhere else, two people, two separate lives. Moving through the same world, beneath the same sky, caught in the same quiet patterns. Their paths seem to mirror one another, as if written in parallel, always close, yet never close enough. Two stories unfolding side by side, in a universe where almost meeting is its own kind of loneliness. They exist in the same somewhere, but never in the same moment.

items.title: Migrantes: el viaje que nadie quiso emprender
Турбозавры. Суперфильм
items.overview: When the secret of the good dinosaur-transformers is threatened, children and Turbozaurs join forces to protect their friends.

items.title: Crypto
items.overview: The story revolves around an Italian mafia family that contacts the two sons of its late leader, who are living in Egypt, to inform them of their inheritance rights. However, two Egyptian men impersonate the heirs and travel to Italy, where they find themselves caught up in a series of unexpected situations and complications.

items.title: Trinkets From My Homeland
items.overview: After an Armenian man comes home to his adopted Russian son, the two begin conversing about the ongoing cultural conflict of the Armenian SSR, over a game of chess.

items.title: Show Pony
items.overview: Mid drag performance at a queer bar in Cork, Claire is shocked to spot her traditional Catholic Nana in the crowd. A  conversation unfolds with them backstage, where they realise they both have a lot more in common than they ever could have imagined.

items.title: When the clouds move south
items.overview: Francisca reopens her family home in southern Chile, empty and frozen in time since the death of her parents. As she restores the place with her brother, the figure of her alcoholic father takes shape through their memories, Fran's diaries, and family photos, opening up an exploration of what silently persists between generations.

items.title: Carnival of the Animals
items.overview: A colourful town inhabited by animals prepares for a carnival parade.

items.title: было не было
items.overview: A student from St. Petersburg, Vasilisa, learns of a fatal diagnosis. She goes to Murmansk to look for her father, whom she has not seen for 20 years. It turns out that strangers have been living in her childhood home for a long time. The girl is ready to give up, but at that moment she begins to receive clues that can lead her to her father.

items.title: Transition
items.overview: Renowned documentarian Thomas Heise begins a film on Berlin's Schönhauser Allee, the road he lived on for decades. A few months later, Heise dies unexpectedly.

items.title: Zombucha!
items.overview: After one particularly catastrophic day at their respective workplaces, busy professionals Maddie and Leo find themselves both unemployed. Dreaming of a fresh start but needing reliable income to support the family they hope to start together, the couple have a chance encounter with Kai, a smouldering kombucha artisan raking in the cash. Seeing dollar signs, Maddie and Leo swipe Kai's kombucha culture to kickstart their own enterprise, but when they mix in some mysterious herbs from a neighbour's garden, the culture gains sentience and proves deadly. With their relationship hanging by a thread, can Maddie and Leo unite to prevent a full-blown zombucha apocalypse?

items.title: La Fábrica
items.overview: Un equipo de documentalistas llega a una fábrica abandonada para investigar la polémica muerte de varias empleadas. Mientras la investigación avanza comienzan a registrar algo aterrador que no los dejará salir.  - A documentary crew arrives at an abandoned factory to investigate the controversial deaths of several female employees. As the investigation unfolds, they begin to capture something terrifying—something that will not let them leave. -

items.title: The Year of the Ghost
items.overview: Following his father's death, Louis Hothothot turns the camera on his mother and sister in China. With fearless affection, he explores how misogyny has affected the lives of the women in his family across generations.

items.title: SUPER BULLET
items.overview: Chad Chadley, a man who's wife died of super aids, and Norman Nerdyman, a virgin, are sent by The Boss to diffuse a bomb by playing Wordle to save the world.

items.title: Obitus
items.overview: After a devastating flood, a mysterious parasitic outbreak engulfs a remote village. As Luna and her father, Damien, struggle to survive, they're forced to confront the brutality of nature and the darkest side of humanity. Filled with separation, loss, and horrifying truths, their journey changes their fate forever.

items.title: Rat Story
items.overview: I woke up at 5am with a giant rat lying on my chest.

items.title: The Project
items.overview: An Afro-Brazilian filmmaker and a Swiss-Serbian photographer embark on a personal and political journey to confront the colonial mindset that still shapes relationships in today’s world. From Brazil, one of the most unequal countries marked by structural racism, to Switzerland, one of the richest and most privileged nations, they face uncomfortable questions: how can a Black woman thrive in a society built on racism? And how do you decolonize the mind when you’ve grown up surrounded by privilege? In search of answers, they dive into transformative conversations with inspiring voices around the world, while reflecting on their own contradictions, complicities, and hopes.

items.title: Todo lo que me pasa sucede en otro lugar
When Cooling-Off Ends
items.overview: The brutal legacy of a serial killer haunts a seemingly wholesome community.

items.title: Come In From the Cold
items.overview: A foreign student, stranded on campus over winter break, decides to make a video diary.

items.title: Jimoto Loop
items.overview: What if leaving home simply wasn't an option? For 29-year-old Satomi, the answer seems absurdly literal. On the very morning she is finally ready to abandon her hometown for Tokyo, she discovers that every attempt to leave brings her straight back to where she started. Caught in an inexplicable time loop, Satomi has no choice but to confront the place and the people she was so determined to leave behind.

items.title: When the Wind Starts to Fade
items.overview: ‎A former doctor meets a mystic healer after attempting to end his life. Although the doctor wants to recover from his past with the help of the healer, he still can't escape the consequence for what he did.

items.title: Der Hagel or yum and how I ate it all up last year
items.overview: Ratko makes his living selling drugs around New York City, getting from one place to another via his beloved bicycle. Misfortune continually befalls both Ratko and those around him, as though the man himself is cursed to struggle.

items.title: Mein Mann, mein Mörder
items.overview: This Sky Original documentary reconstructs an extraordinary true-crime case, focusing not on the perpetrator, but on the women—and their desperate attempts to break free from his violence. For the first time, Winfried’s first wife, Marja-Leena, and his daughter, Tuija, speak publicly about their experiences.

items.title: Too Old Not To
items.overview: “Feel the fear and do it anyway” is the motto that 55-year-old Heli Murray teaches, and practices, as a birth doula and endurance athlete. Parallel to navigating motherhood, divorce, menopause and grandmotherhood, the ocean has been Heli’s sanctuary and outlet for expanding her own edges.

items.title: The Search for Milliseconds
items.overview: Inside mountain bike downhill phenom Jackson Goldstone's high-stakes bid to become one of the youngest riders in history to claim the UCI DH Elite overall title. From pre-season testing to the tense, pressure-filled moments leading into the last race of the year, the film follows Jackson and the team that supports him as they hunt for every possible edge in a sport where the smallest fractions of time can define a champion. With the title on the line and only one decisive run remaining, Jackson prepares to risk everything for the win.

items.title: Cool Off
items.overview: Two sweaty best friends try to find a way to cool off before their dates arrive in 30 minutes. Can they clean themselves up in time to save the date?

items.title: My Ride or Die
items.overview: Morgan McGlashon (professional mountain guide) and Caite Zeliff (professional skier) picked obscure paths. Those paths collided and became intertwined. When their careers took off they found themselves spending less time in the mountains together but they always dreamed of one day coming back together on a proper adventure. On a 10-day expedition in Alaska, the two reconnect.

items.title: A Little Closer
items.overview: While keeping a friend company on a night out, a young woman, grapples with the past, when faced with questions about her own identity.

items.title: Sponde
items.overview: To escape the scorching afternoon heat, five teenagers head to the river. We hear their voices as they talk in the shade of the mountain and the surrounding forest. They swim, sit on rocks and invent new games. Embraced by nature, the teenagers become part of it; they are almost one with the water, the earth, the little rocks lining the riverbed.

items.title: Jahti
items.overview: A young man Raid is waiting for his date at his home in peace. The idyll breaks however, when he gets unwelcome visitors at his door.

items.title: Tender Flesh
items.overview: Luna wakes up disoriented in a workshop where a stranger harasses her while chopping meat. After attacking her, the kidnapper offers her a  way out: find the key to earn her freedom, forcing her to go to unimaginable lengths to survive.

items.title: Good Luck, Kid
items.overview: Grit, gear, growth – this film is a portrait of Taylor Shaffer’s coming-of-age as a photographer and filmmaker, following his creative trajectory as he shepherds Alex Honnold and Tommy Caldwell through a 2,500-mile expedition to attempt a single-day traverse of the Devil’s Thumb massif and finds his artistic voice amid risk, friendship, and a changing Alaskan landscape.

items.title: Lamb
items.overview: Sol, a dancer and choreographer, is a pivotal figure in contemporary dance who, at 59, finds herself at a critical moment in her extraordinary career. With her crew, she's preparing "The Lamb and Her Army", an ambitious work that seems to mark the end of her career as a performer. With joints worn down after decades of physical demands, her doctor has surprising news…

items.title: Date Night
items.overview: As Moira prepares for her anniversary dinner, her fond memories of true love put the romance back in necromancy.

items.title: The Other End
items.overview: Two men find themselves trapped together in a locked apartment with no explanation of how they got there. They claim not to know each other. But the more time passes, the less certain that feels. When an analog phone rings, it becomes clear that not everyone in the room is as lost as they appear. One man answers and says nothing of what he heard. The other grows desperate for answers he wished he had never sought.

items.title: This is Why
items.overview: During a depressive period one night, a guy discovers a ghost in his room.

items.title: Michael Michael Michael
items.overview: Jazz drummer Michael Brewer takes Chicago by storm.

items.title: The Ride Home
items.overview: After a fatal car crash, four friends awaken trapped inside their wrecked car in a liminal space between life and death.

items.title: Puddle
items.overview: A man investigates a mysterious puddle in the street.

items.title: Analog
items.overview: In a world of digital immediacy and AI art, one filmmaker explores how a passionate community is turning back to the tangible beauty of film.

items.title: While I Wait
items.overview: A young man races against time to find and finish writing a book so he can hand it over to a higher entity and be judged.

items.title: One Night
items.overview: At Ana's quinceañera party, her chambelán, Mauricio, aims to confess his love after facing a series of obstacles that will make him second-guess his decision.

items.title: It Takes Two To Tandem
items.overview: Longtime riding partners Sam and Jazz take a tandem bike across some of their favourite trails in the Rockies, marking ten years since their first tandem adventure together. Part celebration, part reflection, the film explores friendship, trust, and the rare joy of moving through the world in sync.

items.title: The Politician
items.overview: First Minister Damian Owen Cles addresses the media after the sudden arrest of a member of his cabinet. The press conference takes a supernatural turn when The Judge appears, and questions the First Minister on his wrongdoings.

items.title: About Rainbows
items.overview: Bobby, a musician who spends his days playing on his instrument, watches his life suddenly collapse when a rainbow crashes onto his house and steals his instrument. Bobby goes after it, embarking on a journey that promises to take him to the end of the rainbow...

items.title: My Grandmother’s Sketchbook: Under Mont Blanc
items.overview: A 30-year-old sketchbook leads Max Romey to the Mont Blanc region. The Alaska-based watercolor artist and environmental advocate sets out to follow in the footsteps of his grandmother, who visited this landscape in the late 1990s and captured it in dozens of drawings. With mountain guide Hillary Gerardi, Max attempts to locate each sketch’s exact origin point. Many match perfectly—until the Mer de Glace throws him off course. The glacier has changed too much in 30 years to recognize.

items.title: The Valley
items.overview: An elderly man returns to the place where he was born with his granddaughter, embarking on an intimate journey through memory, belonging, and the ties that bind generations.
stream: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

items.title: Refuge
items.overview: In the remote Accursed Mountains of Kosovo, former junior ski champions Seb and Hamda have built an off-grid freeride lodge in search of something they lost long ago. Through breathtaking mountain landscapes, snowboarding and deeply personal memories, the film traces their journey from childhood dreams, through the upheaval of war in the former Yugoslavia, to the creation of a place built on friendship, freedom and belonging.

items.title: Back By Tea Time
items.overview: In a world where it feels like we have everything we could ever want at our fingertips – Amazon, Spotify, next-day delivery, door-to-door, Uber, Netflix, Deliveroo, quicker than ever before, pure convenience and luxury without a second thought – in that world, perhaps there is something to be said for choosing the long way round. When Alice Lemkes realises she's out of milk, it is an excuse for an adventure in ‘Scotland's Last Great Wilderness.’

items.title: One Minute
items.overview: During a brief stop in the heart of a forest, Selvan, a Tamil migrant bound for England, finds himself stranded in France with no landmarks or resources. Left to wander an unfamiliar city whose language he does not speak, he drifts between hope and panic, facing silence, suspicion, and rare glimmers of humanity. Oru Nimidam (One Minute) captures, over a compressed timeline, the intimate downward spiral of an ordinary man whose life suddenly hangs in the balance revealing the invisible violence of borders and the vulnerability of those who cross them.

items.title: The Squirrel Diaries
items.overview: “Night of the Living Dead” but with squirrels! Four Gen Z neighbors are thrust into a squirrel apocalypse, so they hunker down in a bunker-like basement doing their best to survive, hoping there is refuge from the rodent rampage. One among them is an amateur survivalist “prepper”; emphasis on amateur.

items.title: No Strings Attached
items.overview: Two puppets meet on a blind date, and it's hate at first sight. But for their dutiful human puppeteers, the sparks fly instantly. What happens when a puppet and puppeteer disagree? A rowdy comedy about love, work, and obligation, in the age of social media.

items.title: The Movie Central Movie 2
items.overview: Three years after The Movie Central War, the movie central members have to battle a foe that threatens to destroy Movie Central.

items.title: The Himalayas in My Heart
items.overview: In 1802, the Survey of India Institute launched the Great Trigonometrical Survey, a colossal undertaking aimed at precisely mapping British India from which the world became aware of the vast scale of the Himalayan range. From August to November 2024, using these historical maps, Jérémy Bigé makes his way on foot over 2,300km from Indian Kashmir to central Nepal. His goal: to connect the various Himalayan cultures in a single journey by following routes from the past.

items.title: Invisible Paths. Redemption
items.overview: The investigation of a seemingly ordinary murder in the wilderness confronts operative Nyurgun Vasiliev with a difficult moral choice: to follow the letter of the law or to show human compassion. This dilemma becomes the main test for the hero, revealing new facets of his character.

items.title: (Trying to be) Bangkok love story
items.overview: A Normal Day in Bangkok, Kook and Jib, a couple who work as housekeepers at a university walk home together. But unresolved feelings from the 2010 Thai military crackdown force them to confront their past and threaten their relationship.

items.title: Chronography III
items.overview: An experimental 360° animated film that renders time visible from an extremely personal perspective. Through contemplative, poetic imagery, it illustrates the tensions between stillness and movement, between scale and duration.

items.title: The Limit
items.overview: A teenager and a older man are dining in an elegant restaurant, the young one is clearly uncomfortable with the physical contact of the adult towards him, after a moment of introspection, decides to put a limit to escape the situation.

items.title: The Stained Glass Witch
items.overview: A stained-glass artist witch loses her magic, essential to her craft, just as she is tasked with creating a piece for the kingdom's anniversary.

items.title: Andata Ritorno - Capitolo I: Senza fine
items.overview: Andata Ritorno is the first chapter of a movement in an almost diary-like form, which takes the director from illness back to the world. From the very first days of his hospital stay, Tonino films, as though capturing this suspended time might help him endure it. It is a long passage, populated by the people closest to him. There are his daughters, Giulia and Veronica, their children, his lifelong partner Mariella, and Alberto, who has stood by his side throughout his filmmaking journey. And then there are his geographies, stretching from Casalborgone to the wider world, bringing together the many people he has filmed there, in the microcosm of a room that opens up countless doors onto life and his films alike.

items.title: Girl Scout Law
items.overview: A young girl reluctantly attends a winter girl scout retreat and unravels the truth behind her identity.

items.title: Peretera Maneta
items.overview: This film chronicles the journey of a sophisticated young schoolteacher whose city upbringing contrasts greatly with her new-found environment. Her reluctance to form relationships with other villagers takes a turn as she discovers a friendship in the place she never expected: with her students. With little time remaining during her placement at a village school, it is up to her to reveal the shocking discovery she has made. But will local folks believe this arrogant city woman?

items.title: Tocata Piolin 2: Winter Edition
items.overview: A documentary recording of the second edition of Tocata Piolin—a day when, despite the rain forecast, music and friendship made it happen.

items.title: Ed Byrne: Tragedy Plus Time
items.overview: One of the UK’s favorite comedy stars returns with his most personal show to date, extending his nationwide tour through April 2025 after winning British Comedy Guide’s Best Comedy Show of 2023. Inspired by the idea that comedy is “tragedy plus time,” Ed Byrne explores the most difficult event of his life with honesty, vulnerability, and sharp wit.

items.title: À bord du vide
items.overview: A poetic exploration of the art of steep skiing with Aurélien Lardy. This film celebrates the art of the movement, the commitment, and the intimate relationship between the man and the mountain, and what draws us to vertical places.

items.title: A Cidade e os Mapas
items.overview: A bangladeshi delivery rider and an urbanist tour guide drift through Porto witnessing how the city reorders itself in the era of digital globalization.

items.title: MiLakóta Yeló
items.overview: Milakóta Yeló follows a traditional Lakota grandmother on the Cheyenne River Sioux Reservation. It's a quiet reflection on identity, memory, and the enduring presence of Lakota life and matriarchal power.

items.title: The TransAtlantic Way
items.overview: At dawn, riders set off from Cork City on a self-supported journey of up to 2,400km, bound for the finish line across Derry’s Peace Bridge, battling fierce winds, rugged terrain, and shifting light. Narrated by veteran long-distance cyclist and event organiser Adrian O’Sullivan, the film immerses viewers in Ireland’s dark and mystical landscape, capturing the endurance, solitude, and raw beauty of the western coast.

items.title: You Should See Me Now
items.overview: Every year, a group of Scottish teenagers who feel unseen - bullied, isolated, struggling to cope - are selected for something extraordinary: a year of brutal physical training culminating in a polar expedition. The expedition, whether Finland or Greenland's storms, is the culmination, not the point. What the film really tracks is one transformation happening in different registers at once: invisible kids learning how to be seen.

items.title: The Witchy Girls
items.overview: 'The Witchy Girls' is a supernatural drag-comedy that reimagines 90s teen-witch stories through a chaotic and incredibly “internet” lens. What if the witches at the heart of your favourite supernatural teen show were not heroines but instead bad self involved people. Best friends Lazy Susan and Zelda Moon stumble through high-school armed with spells…and very big hair. It’s 'Sabrina the Teenage Witch' meets 'It’s Always Sunny'…but QUEER AS HELL! SCREAM

items.title: Zembla Special: De neonazi-files
items.overview: Together with journalists from the VRT program Pano, Zembla investigated right-wing extremism in the Low Countries for nearly a year.

items.title: Getting Killed
items.overview: Two slacker record store employees get dragged to hell following The Incident. Cameron Winter is there.

items.title: Island
items.overview: A man attempts to go on a vacation.

items.title: Nina
items.overview: Nina lives with her husband, Sam, in an isolated house in the countryside. Sam, a doctor, tries to control Nina’s recovery in his own way. However, life in the house becomes increasingly restrictive. Nina loses her freedom, becomes isolated from the outside world, and struggles to make Sam understand how she truly feels. Meanwhile, she begins to experience strange events surrounding a painting in her room. As time goes by, Nina becomes increasingly convinced that something is wrong with the painting. Whenever she tries to explain what she sees, Sam dismisses her experiences as mere anxiety and hallucinations. Nina gradually becomes more obsessed with the painting and what it might be hiding.

items.title: The Pigeon King
items.overview: He hatched a massive pigeon-breeding empire that brought in tens of millions from across North America - until it was exposed as a huge ponzi scheme and feathers went flying.

items.title: Hate Marriage
items.overview: Radhika lives in West Australia and is married to Kumar. Things are a bit rocky in their relationship when he forgets her birthday

items.title: Angler
items.overview: A reserved man discovers an alleyway garage concealing the ultimate mancave, and a charismatic host who won't take no for an answer.

items.title: The Boingy Boingy Film
items.overview: one late night Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy and Catwoman bump into each other having similar motives to steal the "Belgian minature" they play a game of rock, paper, scissors to determine who gets to try and steal it first, Harley Quinn gets the honor.

items.title: MEN TOO
items.overview: A man struggles to stay strong after a painful divorce, moving through his days with a quiet loneliness that no one notices. This PSA explores how a single moment of genuine care can change everything for someone who feels forgotten.

items.title: BLISS BLISS
items.overview: Na Mira. BLISS BLISS, 2026. Two-channel infrared high-definition video (black and white), glass, plexiglass, sun. Courtesy the artist

items.title: MANHATTAN MANHATTAN
items.overview: MANHATTAN MANHATTAN (2026) is a newly commissioned video installation work by Korean American artist Na Mira

items.title: Fallax
items.overview: A prisoner flees into the Icelandic countryside. After their friends mysteriously vanish, the protagonist is drawn into a space where time and nature move differently.

items.title: Fear of Nonexistent Forms
items.overview: Parham Golipour, a young filmmaker, has been murdered. Upon discovering his archives, his friends stumble upon some strange things.

items.title: Kidical Mass
items.overview: After years of exploring their world by bicycle, the Moss family knew that they wanted to raise their kids on two wheels. But after a frightening accident on the way to school, they had to take a step back from their pedal-powered ambitions. Then they found Kidical Mass. This is the story of how one family is helping to reclaim their streets, one giant kid bike party at a time.

items.title: More than Everest: The Life of T.H. Somervell
items.overview: T. Howard Somervell (1890-1975) is best known for his role in the 1922 and 1924 expeditions to climb Everest. This film explores the lesser known aspects of Somervell's remarkable life as a missionary surgeon, artist and composer of music.

items.title: Still Rider
items.overview: After a mountain bike crash resulted in a life altering injury, Chantelle Grafton and her husband Warren have gone to great lengths to get Chantelle back out on the trails. Still Rider explores this journey, highlighting the unanticipated complexities that come with a major spinal cord injury and more importantly the benefits of prioritising adaptive design for those with and without accessibility issues.

items.title: KISS: End of The Road - The Documentary
items.overview: The final chapter of KISSTORY. Go all-access backstage on the farewell tour, from the triumphs to the disasters, health scares and cancellations.

items.title: The Blood Brides
items.overview: Hunted by the three brides of Dracula, a terrified woman must flee from the bloodthirsty beasts or face an agonizing death. This was created for a final project in an Audio/Visual Productions class.

items.title: Oda entrecortada a las arrugas
items.overview: A grandmother, a daughter, a grandson, and a conversation about the wrinkles that can be ironed out and those that cannot.

items.title: The Spell
items.overview: A PSYCHOLOGICAL FILM, BROUGHT TO YOU BY T3.  A woman escapes into a dream state via a ritual, arriving in a dream where a version of herself gives her a warning.

items.title: O Pequeno Moisés
items.overview: In an Egypt gripped by fear and cruelty, the Pharaoh orders the killing of all newborn Hebrew boys, spreading anguish among the families of the community. To save her son’s life, Jochebed makes a desperate decision: she places the baby in a basket and entrusts him to the river, trusting that God will guide him toward a greater destiny. Amidst persecution, fear, and small acts of bravery, the story unfolds of the one who would one day be called Moses—the boy saved from the waters, destined to liberate his people from Egypt.

items.title: Phnom Penh Night
items.overview: One of the finalists for 15th Chaktomuk Short Film Festival

items.title: Atmospheric Instability
items.overview: Mayoral candidate Sarah carries the hope of changing things from within. But as massive protests erupt across Iran, her sixteen-year-old daughter, Saghar, is accused of creating a protest video that has gone viral. When security forces pressure Saghar to record a televised confession, Sarah finds herself torn between her hard-won position and her role as a mother.

items.title: Stitching Undone, Threads Broken
items.overview: Nemat, a Rohingya refugee who sells pickled fruits on the street, races against time to save his sister from grave danger is pursued by a policeman while on his way. All his life on the run, today will determine whether his years of escape can save him and his sister.

items.title: PISSER
items.overview: a man struggles to urinate

items.title: Renacimiento
items.overview: In Baja Verapaz, the Maya Poqomchi community of Renacimiento continues to resist the land dispossession that forced them from their territory in the 1990s. Today, a new generation is leading a collective struggle for justice, historical memory, and the restoration of their ancestral lands. The story of Renacimiento stands as a living testament to the resilience of Indigenous peoples and their tireless defense of land and life.

items.title: Yellow Fiction
items.overview: A new student has just moved abroad. He starts meeting people on a dating app... until a funny surprise spices things up.

items.title: Formline
items.overview: Formline is the defining visual language of traditional Northwest Coast First Nations art; continuous, curvilinear shapes that swell, diminish, and never meet at a hard edge. This film traces the unexpected kinship between this ancient art form and the physics of big mountain snowboarding, where reading terrain and carving a line demand the same fluidity, restraint, and trust in the material at hand.

items.title: Iztépetl: Glimmers of the Past
items.overview: In the Sierra de las Navajas, in the state of Hidalgo, a craft connects Mexico’s past and present: working with obsidian.

items.title: Grape Soda
items.overview: The accidental and unlikely mixture of bodily fluids and grape soda create a vengeful, bloodthirsty purple blob.

items.title: Todo se devuelve
items.overview: On the night two earthquakes shake Venezuela, Edgardo — a Venezuelan father in Miami — gives his last twenty dollars to an injured cyclist and loses his wallet without noticing.
