His daughter Isa sees everything. He tells her just one thing: "Everything comes back." Now life has to prove it. Based on true events.

items.title: Bird Aid
items.overview: While the plight of the common pigeon is of little concern to most New Yorkers, Brenda has compassion for the birds who face great distress when their toes are painfully entangled with string or hair. She has made it her mission to help them out.

items.title: Out of the Fog
items.overview: More than 50 years later, Gottheim revisits his discarded footage, assembling the material into a vibrant, free-flowing meditation on family, memory, and film itself.

items.title: SYNCYTIUM
items.overview: A mortal encounters a celestial being in the forest, whose magical flute controls the flow of time.

items.title: Inflation Point
items.overview: The story of how a handful of near-death experiences, tragic losses and some clever engineering led to big-wave surfing’s most notorious invention and changed surfing forever.

items.title: La llegada al río de un apuesto piraguista
The Bride from America, or New Year’s Movie 2
items.overview: While serving in the army, Sevak meets a volunteer girl who sends aid to soldiers and promises to come back to her in December and marry her. His friend Hayk will do whatever it takes to help Sevak make his dream come true. A New Year’s comedy about love, waiting for a miracle, and a holiday fairy tale that can become real.

items.title: The Supper
items.overview: In a quiet home, Maya, a heavily pregnant wife who always warmly welcomes her husband, is suddenly confronted with a heartbreaking tragedy shortly after his return.

items.title: Gentle Monster
items.overview: A trippy new campaign for Gentle Monster's AI-powered eyewear collection.

items.title: Solo
items.overview: A failed jazz genius, on the verge of death, sells his trumpet to a mysterious buyer. The buyer turns out to be an angel, offering him a chance to play the very solo he had once walked away from. This final concert becomes his redemption—and his ticket to eternity

items.title: Watch out, Dragon!
items.overview: A story about a man who spent his entire life trying to defeat his dragon

items.title: Here Among Strangers
items.overview: In a rapidly growing city, seventy-year-old farmer Sudhakar Bhujbal continues to cultivate his shrinking patch of land, rooted in a world that no longer sees him. As glass towers rise around his soil, he remains- tending the earth among strangers, a quiet figure of continuity against a skyline of relentless change

items.title: Pain Will Pass and Joy Will Come
items.overview: Several young women share their life stories with one another while staying at a crisis center. Each of them grew up in a troubled family, and now they find themselves facing a situation where their own children’s lives are beginning to mirror their own

items.title: Office Punch
items.overview: An office worker's bland life as a pushover takes a turn for the worse with one phone call...or does it?

items.title: Dawn By Dawn
items.overview: Reagan and Wren are studying for their classes and both exhibiting signs of burnout. This short examines how we justify our privilege and deem our own worth based on the work that we do.

items.title: The Other World
items.overview: When someone ignores their friend, they get sent to a different world where no one exists.

items.title: Love on a Plate: A Pixar Artists' Film
items.overview: A short film about food, love, community and finding ourselves.

items.title: Watch, Don't Listen
items.overview: People are disappearing in Corpus, along with their headphones. Kayla Holmes and her neighbor team up to find their friends, and stop whomever caused this. But will it be the very music they lose themselves in that helps them solve the case?

items.title: Maatrubhumi:  May War Rest in Peace
items.overview: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

items.title: November 1963
items.overview: Prior to the election of John F. Kennedy in 1960, his father Joe Kennedy asked for a favor from mob boss Sam Giancana and the Chicago Outfit to ensure a win for the younger Kennedy. However, during the presidency, the national organized crime syndicate came under heavy fire from Attorney General Bobby Kennedy. The mob answered this perceived betrayal with the ultimate revenge: the assassination of the 35th President of the United States on November 22, 1963. The events are depicted through the perspective of Sam Giancana's brother, Pepe, who was present during the critical planning stages, detailing the intricate circumstances and the mob's direct involvement in setting up the assassination.

items.title: Steps
items.overview: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.

items.title: Perfect Liars
items.overview: Jude Derry arrives at the exclusive Tagus university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. What begins as revenge turns into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction and lies, drawing her toward a truth she may not be ready to face.

items.title: Witch on the Holy Night
items.overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

items.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
items.overview: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

items.title: Kaali Kheti
items.overview: A story of inheritance land, legacy, trauma and the cost of trying to bury the past to grow the future.

items.title: Red Snow
items.overview: In Finland, sixteen-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti — a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. When Johanna crosses paths with Martti on Christmas Eve, she thinks her dark fairy tale has come true. But instead of eternal romance, she finds herself trapped in a bloody and horrific nightmare of aging masculine toxicity, family trauma, and festive slaughter. By morning, the snow will turn red.

items.title: Three Generations, One Christmas
items.overview: Set in a close-knit American town, The Starlight is a beloved local supper club and longtime community gathering place where generations have gathered to celebrate music, family, and Christmas traditions. Frank—a legendary song-and-dance man—prepares to sell the family’s beloved restaurant lounge after 40 years. With the future of The Starlight in question, three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey that reminds them what is worth preserving — and how faith, family, and home can quietly lead us back to where we belong.
stream: Great American Pure Flix Amazon Channel

items.title: Ash and Crayons
items.overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

items.title: Sathyavan Savithiri
items.overview: Follows a cheerful lawyer whose life turns upside down when she takes up a major case while navigating her own emotional pain and fighting for social justice.

items.title: El director
items.overview: War correspondent David Jiménez becomes editor of El Mundo newspaper and discovers hidden deals with elites while pushing digital changes. His fight for editorial independence leads to his removal after a year.

items.title: The Happiest Cell
items.overview: Phuc (Tuan Tran), once a gentle and kind-hearted teacher, became a murderer—and ended up in prison—in a desperate attempt to save his younger sister (Sally Hong Anh). Life behind bars was grueling, yet Phuc endured it with patience, hoping for an early release. Thanks to his innate goodness, he gradually influenced Tu (Ma Ran Do)—a strictly principled prison guard—and his fellow inmates, fostering positive change, harmony, and mutual empathy among them. While this "most unique lesson" was unfolding within the prison walls, Phuc’s sister was facing a challenging life on the outside without her brother by her side. Meanwhile, the notorious inmate Long (Luong The Thanh) was constantly lurking, waiting for the right moment to exact revenge on Phuc.

items.title: Our Holiday Playbook
items.overview: Returning home for Christmas, Lexi recruits a former football star to pose as her boyfriend for her family's annual flag football rivalry, but their fake romance soon turns into something real.

items.title: XI: Thou Shalt Not Be Indifferent
items.overview: Marian Turski, the world-renowned historian, journalist, and until his recent passing, president of the International Auschwitz Committee, takes us back to the roots of evil. A survivor of the Lodz Ghetto, Auschwitz, Buchenwald, and Theresienstadt death camps in his youth, Turski explains with firsthand knowledge and surgical precision how otherwise well-educated and cultured people can, under certain circumstances, turn into criminals and mass murderers. He reminds us about the painful past, explains the present, and warns about the future. His dramatic plea, "do not be indifferent!" remains more relevant now than ever. Andrzej Wolf, the director and cinematographer of this film, pays a loving tribute to one of the last moral compasses of the Greatest Generation.

items.title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe - Part 1
items.overview: Set against the backdrop of the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy, army officer Maki Staufenberg is assigned to Valkyria II, the second planet in the Asgard system, where she is tasked with investigating Ash Vamps, a soldier who has earned the nickname of “Witch” because of her habit of being the sole survivor in missions assigned to her ragtag band of soldiers on punishment detail.

items.title: Unbearable Christmas
items.overview: Out-of-work weatherman Troy Tipton has one Christmas mission: retrieve the beloved teddy bear he pawned for holiday cash. With wife Becca, mother-in-law Dawn, and the kids in tow, Troy hits the road from Ohio to Florida in his old news van. But the family road trip gets even wilder when they discover the cherished bear is actually a priceless Teddy Roosevelt antique worth millions.

items.title: What Remains
items.overview: A poet breaks free from a life that has become suffocating to reconnect with her inner voice and conscience and allow her creativity to flow again. As she begins to question the conventions of family, identity and the meaning of life, her journey towards self-discovery challenges those around her to reconsider their own lives — taking the whole family in a new direction.

items.title: Investigations of a Breakup
items.overview: Sophia struggles with overthinking her life as a poor, nihilistic drifter. Exiled to a life of solitude, she has the chance to change it all upon meeting Liza one night...  Did she let her in or was she destined to burn it all? The aftermath of their breakup is explored through three different angles.

items.title: Letters This Christmas
items.overview: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.
stream: Great American Pure Flix Amazon Channel

items.title: Pray for me: Pope Francis' story
items.overview: Pray for me: Pope Francis’ story is a documentary that follows the life journey of Pope Francis, with a particular focus on his social and humanitarian work. The film portrays a man deeply devoted to the causes of the poor, the marginalised, and the forgotten: from his early years in Argentina to his role as a spiritual leader on the global stage.  Blending archival footage, personal testimonies, and a thoughtful, ethical perspective, the documentary offers an intimate and timely portrait of one of the most influential figures of our time.

items.title: Transplant
items.overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

items.title: 70 Syaal
items.overview: “From the Folklore of Punjab”

items.title: The Moon Is Watching
items.overview: A doctor dissatisfied with his marriage proposes a trip to France, secretly planning to confine his wife in a mysterious château.

items.title: Party Animals
items.overview: Childhood best friends Mann Patel and Armaan Khanna reunite in Mumbai for a night out that spirals into chaos with romantic complications, escalating fights, and every fix creating more problems.

items.title: Pratap
items.overview: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

items.title: Citas: la película
items.overview: On Sant Jordi in Barcelona, roses and books change hands, but four love stories have yet to learn what they want to receive. Among nervous blind dates and a truth about to surface, the day moves toward a question nobody dares to ask.

items.title: The Day After Sunday
items.overview: Awaiting prenatal screening results, Mai’s mounting anxiety collides with her husband Koichi’s passive avoidance, escalating hidden spousal tension into unbearable friction.

items.title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
items.overview: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

items.title: Jalaaki
items.overview: Jalaaki is a powerful and deeply emotional love story that explores human relationships, hope, sacrifice, and resilience. Through compelling storytelling, captivating performances, and beautiful cinematography, the film seeks to touch the hearts of audiences while highlighting the rich social and cultural values embedded within the Magar community.

items.title: Brindavihari
items.overview: Set in the enchanting world of Brindavanam, Brindavihari follows Madhava, a man who falls deeply in love with Radha, only to have his world turned upside down when she leaves. As Meera enters his life, Madhava is forced to confront the truth behind his world and the very nature of love itself.

items.title: Himalayan Gold
items.overview: A young village girl's journey to collect the rare Himalayan herb Yarsagumba turns into a desperate fight for survival when she encounters a ruthless gang of robbers in the mountains.

items.title: Déjà Vu: The Eye of LuLu
items.overview: Mysterious assassinations and blackouts throughout Manhattan are linked to a major aerospace company, its corporate hit men, and two bumbling Russian agents hellbent on capturing the world-changing power of its AI technology. True-Crime Blogger Cassie Cole enlists the help of a masked whistle-blower, a high-end hacker, a CIA psychic, and the sassy sentient AI, to uncover their international conspiracy and its lethal consequences.

items.title: My Girlfriend is a Serial Killer
items.overview: David comes home ready to propose to his longtime girlfriend. But when he walks on her in the middle of a gruesome murder, he's left questioning the relationship. Can he see past her murderous habits or will love prevail?

items.title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
items.overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

items.title: After the Song
items.overview: We often spin tender lies out of love for someone. Fourteen-year-old Kiita has grown up in just such a lie, living alone with his blind mother, Hanae. As his voice begins to change, the boy decides to venture beyond the fence on his own, and in the back alleys of Tokyo comes face to face with realities far removed from what he has known. Yet just as truth has many faces, so too does its opposite, and Kiita gradually comes to see—and accept—that the lie that has protected his world has another face of its own.

items.title: The Misty Man
items.overview: A lonely film critic watches a romance in which the woman who rejected him falls for a movie star. Lost between the screen and his own imagination, he enters the film itself, hoping to rewrite a love story that was never meant to include him.

items.title: Une zone d'échos
items.overview: In Mexico, the keen pain of the loved ones of missing persons deepened by a lack of understanding, injustice and a lack of recourse. To bring this internal suffering to light, a group of women takes part in a project of creation and research that takes the form of a cathartic performance. In a warehouse transformed into a symbolic space dedicated to externalizing pain and frustration, they engage in reenactments, exchanges, and role-playing situations relating to their daily lives as the mothers, sisters or spouses of people whose lives were suddenly taken. Their stories resonate until the echo of their distress meets that of the others, bringing forth a poignant ode to sisterhood and solidarity.

items.title: Filthy
items.overview: When an actress goes looking for the man who assaulted her, she turns her trauma into art and asks the question nobody wanted her to: why didn't you do anything?

items.title: The Swamp
items.overview: After stealing from the wrong Amsterdam druglord, Ana finds herself homeless, desperate, and reluctantly teaming up with a filthy street goblin who dreams of robbing banks. Together they drift through scams and grifts in a scuzzy fairytale about survival and accidental friendship.

items.title: Sophomores
items.overview: When a group of friends come back from college to have their annual Friendsgiving dinner, they realize that they have all changed since high school.

items.title: A Bouquet of Light for You
items.overview: Shoko Someya feels ordinary and struggles to see what makes her special. Mahiru Suzuki, her popular classmate and a rising idol, seems to have everything figured out. When the two become library committee members, Shoko discovers a side of Mahiru that he has kept hidden from everyone else.

items.title: Hechos probados
items.overview: Delia and Inés are sisters and lawyers who see the law, and life, in opposite ways. When both of their careers fall apart, they have to work together at a legal tech company to take on the law firm of Prado, a rival they both have scores to settle with, while dealing with a rebellious daughter, a failing marriage and a difficult father.

items.title: Shankarabharana
items.overview: Shankarabharana is an upcoming Kannada action thriller story written by Shine Shetty and directed by Sumanth Bhat.

items.title: Gummy
items.overview: A serial killer goes out one night in search of a new victim and ends up encountering his worst nightmare.

items.title: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
items.overview: Bamakhyapa, an Indian saint living in the 18th century, is a great devotee of Goddess Tara. Though he is against the unconventional orthodox temple practices, he uses his divine powers to help the needy.

items.title: Saudade Cat
items.overview: A disgruntled slacker searches for his lost cat.

items.title: Gipsy Kings Featuring Tonino Baliardo
items.overview: Discovered by Brigitte Bardot while busking on the beaches of Saint-Tropez, a Romani gypsy guitarist of Catalan musical lineage forms the Gipsy Kings and turns a marginalized culture into a global music phenomenon.

items.title: The Hillbilly Scientist
items.overview: While modern running has evolved toward sleek curation, optimisation, and commercialisation, Lazarus Lake has spent 50 years designing formats with an unapologetic, honest difficulty. The Hillbilly Scientist reveals that Laz’s cruellest courses are rooted in a deeply scientific understanding of human psychology and physical limits. This is the only official documentary dedicated to the creator of the Barkley Marathons and Big’s Backyard Ultra. Filmed over more than a year, it reveals the man behind the myth through never-before-seen footage, exclusive testimonials, and exceptional access to Laz’s world.

items.title: One Night at the Aztec
items.overview: A comedic collection of six stories during one night at a local movie theater. Love and loss, friendship and hate, all experienced within the dark auditorium. A love letter to cinema of the past and to the artists working today.

items.title: Chakkven
items.overview: Set between Punjab and Canada, Chakkven follows brothers Sukha and Jassa, whose strong bond faces challenges when Jassa's wife moves abroad. Amid student struggles, long distance separation, and growing rumors.

items.title: The Last of the Lookouts
items.overview: High atop Sinkut Mountain in northern British Columbia, Bart Vanderlinde begins each summer's day the way he has for the past nine years: scanning the forest for smoke. He's among the last lookout people in the province. Where three hundred lookouts once formed an interconnected network across the region, Bart now often keeps watch alone. This is an intimate portrait of a man and a profession facing obsolescence. The film gives insight into the craft of fire detection while capturing the quiet solitude of a life lived in observation.

items.title: Creepy Nuts - North America Tour: Live in NY
items.overview: concert documentary following hip-hop duo Creepy Nuts on their 2026 North American tour. It combines behind-the-scenes footage—including their Coachella appearance—with highlights from their first solo concert in New York, capturing the duo’s growing international reach.

items.title: Stranger From the Lake
items.overview: A young woman takes home an injured man she found half-dead in the lake. When her grandparents disapprove, she is forced to defend the man from their malicious scheming.

items.title: The final shot in the Milky Way
items.overview: In a working-class neighborhood of Medellín, Adrián and Rafael, two daring friends, hide away in an abandoned cemetery to smoke and be alone. When Rafael discovers his portrait drawn in Adrián's notebook, a powerful desire ignites between them. But Rafael can't bring himself to let go and fears that his troubled cousin Ismael will find out about his relationship with another man.

items.title: Prism
items.overview: A prisoner is trapped in an experimental hallucinatory chamber with nightmarish scenes.

items.title: Canada Corpse
items.overview: A young woman escaping into her drug fuelled fantasies.

items.title: Painted Faces
items.overview: An art student who hides severe cystic acne behind colorful face paint must venture out of her comfort zone to unmask and embrace her true authentic self.

items.title: What's Left Behind
items.overview: After his wife's death, Jacinto returns to the home he shared with her; consumed by her absence, a presence manifests, forcing him to confront her memory and bid her farewell.

items.title: Let It Kill You: Jeff Tremaine
items.overview: Let It Kill You turns the lens on Jeff Tremaine—artist, instigator, and quiet architect of a generation’s chaos. Best known for co-creating jackass, Tremaine reflects on risk, responsibility, and the creative drive that never really lets go. Series creator Ben McQueen sits down with Tremaine, Johnny Knoxville, Spike Jonze, and more to get an inside look at the man—and the career—behind the mayhem.

items.title: A New Man
items.overview: A creature living under a stairwell on a college campus finds an unlikely connection which helps bring him back to civilization. He is invited by Ruby, a polite, kind student to attend a screening of "Nosferatu" (1922) where he sees himself and his impact on others. Ruby's kindness helps bring him back to normality. The film explores loneliness, the power of art and cinema as well as the human condition.

items.title: Natasha
items.overview: After Natasha’s murder, three friends cross Mato Grosso do Sul toward the Pantanal to fulfill her last wish: to compete in a drag queen contest. With few resources and facing prejudice along the way, the journey reveals bonds, conflicts, and dreams. Amid loss and discovery, the trip becomes an experience of friendship, belonging, and the affirmation of their own existence.

items.title: Secret Rivers of the Nakanai
items.overview: In the village of Ruraï, in Papua New Guinea, people tell of a water hidden deep within the Nakanai Mountains so pure that anyone who drinks it is said to gain extraordinary powers. Immersed in the heart of a tropical rainforest, a team of cavers including the inimitable Cédric Lachat, set out to uncover this mysterious underground river system.

items.title: Experiment 26
items.overview: Ten boys were abruptly torn away from their normal routine at the TOM Radotín children’s camp without warning to take part in the grueling game “Experiment 26”—a harsh psychological and physical survival reality show set deep in the woods. In this game, where no one knows who is “infected” or who to trust, they must also face isolation, hunger, and the constant pressure of the field laboratory. This gripping documentary captures 72 hours of paranoia and exhaustion, during which friendship turns into an uncompromising struggle for survival, and victory is achieved only by the ability to sacrifice others for one’s own survival.

items.title: Muy azul, pero...
items.overview: A couple plays with a camera, observing each other through it. During a storm, she disappears. His solitude is interrupted as memories of her begin to haunt him. The storm starts to resurface.

items.title: Obsession: The Beryl Burton Story
items.overview: A documentary about Britain’s greatest athlete. Undefeated for 25 years, Leeds-born amateur cyclist Beryl Burton won seven World Championships, beat men’s records and transformed women’s sport; all while working on a Yorkshire rhubarb farm. Through unseen archive, letters and intimate interviews, the film explores the glory of her achievements and the cost of her obsession, particularly on her relationship with her daughter Denise, who followed her into competitive cycling.

items.title: TEDE. Forever Rap
items.overview: An uncompromising portrait of Jacek "Tede" Graniecki – one of the most influential and controversial artists in the history of Polish rap. The film is driven by never-before-seen private archives from 1993–2002 – a priceless record of the years when hip-hop in Poland was just being born, with Tede and his crew at the very heart of that revolution. Twenty-two years after his first visit, the artist returns to the streets of New York on a sentimental journey, asking how he, Polish rap, Poland and America have changed.

items.title: the 4th turning
items.overview: Several trans women navigate Amsterdam's rapid decline into technofascism.

items.title: 4000m From Home
items.overview: For over twenty years, Vivian Bruchez has pursued a singular vision: to ski all 82 Alpine summits above 4000 meters. A journey built on patience, commitment, friendship and a deep relationship with the mountains. As the project nears completion, something begins to shift. What started as pure exploration slowly becomes a quest to finish.

items.title: Find Mòr
items.overview: Scotland still has its mysteries roaring in remote glens and sometimes hidden in plain sight. Find Mòr follows a group of canyoneers over the span of two years as they embark on a journey of exploration into the hidden corners of the Scottish Highlands. The film offers a unique perspective from within the relatively unknown niche community and discovers the myriad motivations that drive this passion of curiosity. Setting out in search of uncharted canyons, they find true adventure and forge deep connections to people and place.

items.title: Big Jim: An American on Everest
items.overview: “Big Jim” Whittaker (1929-2026) was a legendary Pacific Northwest mountaineer who became the first American to summit Mount Everest on May 1, 1963. This short documentary explores his “brotherhood of the rope” with his twin brother, Lou, as well as Nawang Gombu Sherpa, his Everest climbing partner and lifelong friend. Featuring rarely seen 16mm footage from the 1963 Everest Expedition, archival images from the Whittaker family collection, and interviews filmed in Jim’s late 80s, the film is both an intimate portrait of an extraordinary life and a celebration of the adventurous spirit that helped define a generation of climbers.

items.title: When you return
items.overview: Inspired by an ancient legend from Galicia, this short film tells the story of a young woman who, following an inexplicable encounter in the woods, discovers the dark secret of the Santa Compaña. A story about fear, destiny, and that which we can never escape.

items.title: 22nd Century Cat
items.overview: Yoshiko is an actress working on an indie film while living with her elderly father. In her latest role, she plays the wife of an eccentric man running for local political office, a fictional situation that gradually begins to overlap with the circumstances of her own everyday existence. As she moves between the demands of the film set and her domestic responsibilities, the distinction between performance and reality becomes increasingly uncertain.

items.title: How to Avoid Elves?
items.overview: A group of students search for traces of Philippine elves in their university.

items.title: Inside the Mountain
items.overview: In 1988, Paul Eastwood and his climbing partner became the first men to free-climb Britain's deepest open cave shaft, rising from within the UK's largest underground chamber and traversing around its highest unbroken waterfall, three times the height of Niagara falls. The iconic route will have gone unrepeated for almost 40 years. Decades later a new team of climbers, Olympian Molly Thompson-Smith and legend Steve McClure, will tackle the climb once again, hoping to join the few who have ever free-climbed the route.

items.title: Zuma Rock
items.overview: Rotimi, an amateur climber and writer from London with deep family roots in Nigeria, sets out to achieve the unthinkable: a first ascent of Zuma Rock, a 300m monolith considered sacred by the communities who live in its shadow. To do it, he enlists Olympic climbing champion Shauna Coxsey but neither of them has ever tackled a wall of this scale.

items.title: Bloomin' Octopus!
items.overview: Explores the sudden rise in octopus numbers in south west England through a series of interconnected perspectives, showing how shifts beneath the surface ripple outward, affecting ecosystems and people alike.

items.title: Earworm
items.overview: Austin is a grieving young man who can't keep himself from revisiting the room where his ex-boyfriend murdered another former partner. Meanwhile he finds himself in a co-dependent dynamic with Eve, a non-confrontational, quietly misanthropic student who now lives in the very same room.

items.title: Rongo
items.overview: With plenty of powder to go around, un-ridden waves rolling into secret golden beaches, and local characters to greet you with a smile, six professional athletes make the most of every moment during an action-packed adventure through Aotearoa, NZ!

items.title: The Perfect Warrior
items.overview: On a remote island deep in the Orange Sea, an elite clan of warriors called the Totomé train and fight to keep peace among their lands. Every 100 years the top warriors compete to see who will take over as leader, or Abeoji. Katana and Sai are given this opportunity, but when their forbidden relationship is discovered their final challenge to become the leader is to fight in a Si Dou— a sword fight to the death.

items.title: Piscodelia
items.overview: At a party, Alex decides to end his relationship with Sara, who goes to the bar looking for a drink. But after drinking a magical shot of Pisco, she goes back to the past, and after an unexpected event, she decides to go back several times to let her feellings out.

items.title: Borrowed from the Earth
items.overview: Tells the story of the powerful connection between the Blackfeet people and horses, and how that life-giving relationship remains alive today. Throughout their histories, both horse and Indigenous people have been corralled - horses by fences, and Indigenous people onto reservations. Yet centuries-long attempts to subdue both ultimately strengthened the bond between them. Saddle up for a visually poetic journey from the origin story of the horse to the modern day Indian Relay Race. Filmed on the Blackfeet Reservation in Browning, Montana.

items.title: Unthankful
items.overview: A Thanksgiving fanatic shows a stranger the true spirit of Thanksgiving.

items.title: King of kings
items.overview: A stand up special of mohd suhel

items.title: Coffee Table Poetry
items.overview: How can a coffee table change a life? How can it move the things inside you? How can it give you the spark that you needed the whole time? What is a coffee table capable of?

items.title: So Close
items.overview: SO CLOSE tells the story of two prisoners divided by a series of walls, in a world where voices are silenced and laughter is forbidden. Originally commissioned by San Diego’s The Rosin Box Project as a stage ballet, the film was conceived in playful defiance of Chechnya's law banning music below 80 and above 116 BPM, with its score composed exclusively in 79 and 117 BPM.

items.title: Return to the Deep
items.overview: Follows Neil Gresham’s white-knuckle journey as he attempts to repeat the six hardest Deep Water Solos in Pembroke. Fifteen years ago he pushed the standards of British Deep Water Soloing on these cliffs: his routes earned a fierce reputation and some went unrepeated for a decade, but now they’re a target for the next generation and Neil has re-joined the action. The film traces back to the evolution of Deep Water Soloing, from its origins in the UK to the development of top destinations worldwide.

items.title: Mother's Mushrooms
items.overview: There live a rat-catcher and his wife in a hut on an isolated mountain. The wife gives birth to a half-bird, half-human child. Right after birth, the child grabs the bangs on his mother’s forehead and eats some of the hair. The bird-child grows so fast that he becomes a boy in a very short period of time. The rat-catcher loves his wife’s bangs very much and hates that she only thinks about the child now, and that the child is not of man but of beast. He soon starts plotting to kill the child. The mother and her child only have each other to face the scheming of the cruel man. Then, a solution - their way out of the trap - presents itself.

items.title: μtopia
items.overview: Yussef is a teenager who lives in public housing in Genoa, in an area known as “Le Lavatrici”, and dreams of becoming a film director. We see him wandering among gray concrete buildings, peeling walls and small bridges connecting one building to another.

items.title: Searching for SuperCrust: The Lost Tapes
items.overview: Five cyclists set out to cross Europe's largest glacier by bike. An expedition 30 years in the making, the film explores the past, present, and future of Vatnajökull through the stories of those who have braved the glacier’s icy expanse on two wheels.

items.title: The Way Home
items.overview: The Way Home is the story of Chucho, Marco, Erika and Christian; four actors who, through theater, face a world that is not built for them. A world that is not for the blind.

items.title: Aldo's Raptor Roundup
items.overview: Six-year old Aldo spends an exciting weekend banding migrating raptors in Cape May, New Jersey with his friend John, a volunteer bander with the Cape May Raptor Banding Project.

items.title: Regrowth
items.overview: There is a kaleidoscopic beauty to the rich micro landscape of lichens. The beauty of lichens is what drew April Windle to them. She is one of just a handful of professional lichenologists in the UK, spending her time studying a lifeform that goes unnoticed by most people. In this short film, April reflects on how, when she experienced a period of mental health crisis, her love for lichens gave her a window back to the beauty in the world, and a way back to balance.

items.title: Folk Who Roam
items.overview: Sheffield-based violin maker Emma Hardy is bridging the gap between nature and music by designing and hand-crafting a uniquely decorated violin inspired by the Peak District’s history of folk music and land access rights.

items.title: The Albons, in Pursuit of UTMB
items.overview: Jon and Henriette Albon are professional ultra-runners, sharing their passion for the mountains and the sport. Married for 10 years, they have built a life together competing at the highest level in trail running. The 2025 season marks their journey towards their first UTMB.

items.title: Beparwah
items.overview: Starring Dev Kharoud

items.title: Favours After Death
items.overview: After a young man decides to take his own life while dressed in his best clothes, his tie comes to life, intent on breaking into his neighbour's apartment to seek help.

items.title: Back on North Face
items.overview: Why risk everything on a thousand-foot cliff? After legendary Taiwanese climber Shiu Yau Chiun's fatal accident, his Canadian climbing partner Patrick Lindsay and student (the director) lead a cross-border team back to Yushan's East Peak North Face. Battling storms and grief, they establish a new route, “Shiu Be Here,” honoring their friend. Years later, Patrick returns to a remote Canadian summit, whispering, “See you on the next peak.”

items.title: Blank Patterns
items.overview: A collection of athlete portraits following Jacob Bélanger, Emma Patterson, and Ugo Troubat. Through their individual stories, the film explores the experiences, choices, and communities that shaped the lives they lead today. While each has taken a different path, together they reflect the many ways people find their place within skiing and contribute to the culture in their own way.

items.title: [2 - the son]
items.overview: Can we find freedom in our abandonment

items.title: Glacier's Requiem
items.overview: In isolation on Iceland’s Snæfellsnes Peninsula, Nigerian-born modular synthesis artist Colloboh transforms glacial and oceanic recordings into sonic compositions; uncovering a dialogue between ice and sea that reshapes his understanding of consciousness, ecological collapse, and humanity’s place within both.

items.title: Lucia
items.overview: Sweet Cionsi and Captain Walker travel across the Po valley in search of the Ciocobuoni alla Panna biscuits, Saint Lucy's favorites.

items.title: Joyride Returns
items.overview: Rusty Nail returns 12 years later, to turn the desert road of the Arizona in blood, as a group of friends on vacation go to a small town near the mountains to explore them, as Rusty Nail with his black truck is near.

items.title: SILA
items.overview: Set on an island 600 kilometers north of the Arctic Circle, this intimate vérité portrait follows two young Inuit coming of age. Created in close collaboration with a local children’s home and filmed in the Greenlandic language, the story traces identity, tradition, loss, and resilience. Living alongside its protagonists, the film observes a fragile passage between deep cultural roots and an uncertain, rapidly changing world.

items.title: Brother
items.overview: Two brothers set out on a quiet walk after a lazy afternoon at home, but casual conversation slowly uncovers tensions that put their bond to the test.

items.title: Phantom 814
items.overview: Heavy Weekend 03: Unique access to the most mysterious organisation in France. Jake Hanrahan travels with the bizarre syndicate known as "814SSR". They shoot guns, host fight clubs, and make money in the underground. Yet still, they insist they're not a gang and are simply doing hardcore trolling. The truth? Decide for yourself...

items.title: Two Brothers
items.overview: After escaping from a boarding school, two Osage brothers find themselves lost in the woods at the turn of the century, trying to make their way back home – physically and spiritually.

items.title: Border Chocolate - The Second Life Economy of Cars
Thank You for Your Patience
items.overview: A dating website matches Jack with his supposed "soul mate" but he is automatically enrolled in a paid subscription. After failed attempts to cancel, he's forced to visit the company headquarters, a  bizarre labyrinth of hallways.

items.title: Per rimanere insieme
items.overview: Claudia and Leo are the film’s protagonists, two friends with sparkling eyes full of wonder. They film themselves as they shop for groceries and play as if it were the end of the world: they hide in an abandoned house, cook canned beans on a camping stove, and burn small wooden objects. But even the purest friendship has an expiration date: the next day, Leo has to move away with his family. It was their last afternoon together.

items.title: The Rare Folk 2
items.overview: Follow up to The Rare Folk

items.title: Remember the Removal
items.overview: Generations after their ancestors were marched through Missouri on the Trail of Tears, Cherokee, Mvskoke, and Pawnee storytellers discover a small rural town in the Missouri Ozarks.

items.title: Miss Adventure
items.overview: ​​Mikah Meyer grew up a middle-America pastor's son, trapped in a religion-sealed closet until his twenties. After his 70,000 social media followers crown Mississippi "The Most Homophobic State in America", Mikah endeavours to run across the entire state in flamboyant colours. Alongside his college mentor, Larry, they confront traumas from their collective time in America’s Bible Belt and beyond.

items.title: Swoletarian
items.overview: Swoletarian is a gay anthem for queer and trans people to blast while working out. Salute the pride flag and get swole to this queer, Marxist weight lifting song.

items.title: Larry's Movie
items.overview: 77 year old local North Carolina rockstar Larry Butterton retires from his beloved Peak City Band and live music while also moving to Canada during an especially turbulent year in the United States of America.

items.title: GOAL: Striking Congo
items.overview: Goal: Striking Congo follows former professional Ugo Kasuku, who has run a football academy for years in war-torn Goma and now launches the Future Pro League, bringing international scouts to offer youth opportunity, dignity, and hope for a wounded nation.

items.title: Planet Health Stories - Breathe Her In
items.overview: For the women and non-binary runners of 10Ironwomen - a collective addressing the gender imbalance in endurance sports - Bristol's green trails offer what city streets can't: space to breathe.

items.title: Path of Titans 4 - DUCK DYNASTY
items.overview: As a member of the last Deinocheirus family on Gondwa, Duckling is tired of feeling like a complete outcast. Following a lead that could prove there are more out there, she sets out on a transoceanic adventure to prove she's not alone. At the same time, an old threat reemerges to take down the Guardians of Gondwa once and for all, and Duckling's discovery may be exactly what they need.

items.title: Nausicaá, l'aquarium de tous les défis
She Measures the Earth
items.overview: Follows four women scientists in Canada - Alison Criscitiello, Jocelyn Hirose, Isobel Phoebus, and Chimira Andres - as they reshape who belongs to science.

items.title: Remnants
items.overview: When a quiet young teen introduces a new mentor to his favourite pastime, she finds that breaking the rules comes with serious consequences.

items.title: We Are Here
items.overview: A powerful documentary following seven Black British women as they step onto the world’s most prestigious trail running stage: The 2025 UTMB World Series Finals in Chamonix.

items.title: Another Sky
items.overview: Adult students are practicing French in a classroom in Brussels. Their assignment: describe what you used to see when you looked out of the window as a child. With newly acquired words, they describe the world they left behind.

items.title: Grade A Bullsh*t
items.overview: A witty and thought-provoking documentary that asks a deceptively simple question: Who decides climbing grades? After adaptive climber Maureen Beck finally achieves her long-sought first 5.12 route, the celebration is short lived when the climb is downgraded. The experience leaves her wondering whether grades are objective measures of difficulty, or reflections of ego, bias, and the culture surrounding climbing. Determined to find answers, Maureen sets her sights on Far From God, a notoriously difficult Kentucky testpiece.

items.title: Pretty Boy
items.overview: It's easy to be a pretty boy, but it's not easy to love one

items.title: We Are Cyclists
items.overview: The film traces the origin and growth of All Bodies on Bikes, challenging narrow, performance-driven definitions of cycling and expanding who gets to call themselves a cyclist. Rooted in joy, inclusion, and collective care, All Bodies on Bikes proves that these values aren’t radical: they’re essential.

items.title: Teleplasm
items.overview: In 1920s Winnipeg, filmmaker Kate Solar's great-great-grandfather took thousands of spirit photographs during seances he held. In order to make sense of this family legacy shrouded in mystery and grief, Solar tries to uncover what the photos meant to the women who helped create and archive them.

items.title: America's Parade: 100 Years of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
items.overview: The 2026 Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parademarks a milestone for the iconic holiday event: It's the Parade's 100th iteration.   The Parade first kicked off all the way back in 1924, but because of World War II, no Parades were held from 1942 to 1944. That means 2026 marks a full century of Parade magic, which is fitting, seeing as how NBC celebrates its 100th anniversary this November, too.   Such an occasion needs to be honored properly, which is why NBC is airing a special documentary about the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade as it approaches this exciting birthday

items.title: For No One
items.overview: After his father’s death, a son finds himself still caught in the hold of their complicated relationship. Through offerings, rituals, and encounters that blur the boundary between the living and the dead, he confronts what remains between them–and the possibility of reconciliation after death.

items.title: A Very Mythical Holiday Special
items.overview: Kick off the season with Rhett & Link’s first-ever live holiday special Nov 20! This festive variety show brings you a magical wintery night full of songs, sketches, special guests & more.

items.title: Into the Light
items.overview: Follow two young South African surfers whose lives could not be more precarious and whose dreams, against all odds, carry them across an ocean they were never meant to touch. Born from struggle, but fuelled by possibility, the story illuminates the belief that sport and education can bridge divides and shows how two young athletes challenge the weight of history.

items.title: Pailin Gems
items.overview: Khmer movie

items.title: Pit Of Bones 3: The Return
items.overview: When a collage professor, 3 students and 2 security guards go to a archeology digsite and dig up human bones a new killer with new tactics comes out to add them to his collection

items.title: Dreamrime
items.overview: Sit back and marvel at this cinematic wonder as we see the famous Cerro Torre towers of Patagonia like never before. Filmed by local drone expert Ty Lekki and produced by multi-award winner Alastair Lee, this film is a glorious marriage of sound and vision as we enter a new phase of mountain film making. A team of three Argentinian and one German Alpinists attempt the Punta Hernon/Torre Egger traverse, encountering the unique rime and mushroom formations found only in this special part of the world.

items.title: SURFRUN
items.overview: Jonny lives in Cornwall, beside 300 miles of coast path he has barely seen. He runs, and he surfs. Neither is about being good at it. Then he loses someone close. What stays with him is not just the grief, it is how suddenly it can all stop. So he sets out to run and surf the entire path, at his own pace, for no reason other than wanting to. The miles are not the hard part. The noise is. The pull to go faster, suffer more, make it look bigger than it is. He spends 300 miles ignoring it, with his partner Katie and their dog Oreo meeting him along the way.

items.title: A Mystical Ornithology
items.overview: Immersed in the songs of blue jays, yellow-throated warblers, and red-shouldered hawks on his forty-six-acre farm in rural South Carolina, acclaimed poet and ornithologist J. Drew Lanham exchanges calls with the birds that stop over at his home during their seasonal migrations. For Drew, these creatures are gods, transcendent beings who summon a response of reverence. Reverberating with sound, music, light, and ethereal cinematic expression, A Mystical Ornithology weaves a kinetic texture for the senses and invites you into a poetic evocation of the paradox of love and grief within the changing nature of the seasons.

items.title: Alto
items.overview: In spring 2026, four skiers travelled to Bolivia with their sights set on skiing new lines in the Cordillera Real's 6,000m peaks. Accessing the mountains, however, quickly becomes more complicated than they had imagined. As political unrest sweeps through the country, roadblocks and uncertainty become as much a part of the journey as the skiing itself. Battling altitude, logistics, and an ever-changing landscape, the team navigates a complex situation in pursuit of first descents.

items.title: Wild Ice
items.overview: As winter slowly reveals itself across the Canadian Rockies, artist and skater Elladj Baldé and photographer Paul Zizka chase the season’s first wild ice - a journey that becomes a reflection on freedom, connection, and the human desire to move through life with intention.

items.title: Inferis Ostium
items.overview: Three teenagers go in search of a wishing well, a junkie flees from the police, and a filmmaker is kidnapped by the mafia. They all discover this magical well—but what they don’t realize is that their wishes will turn into nightmares. Rock music, suspense, and humor blend perfectly in this stop-motion animated film, shot entirely using a mobile phone and modeling clay.

items.title: Sam Hodgson - The Story of a Freerider
items.overview: There was never a plan B. Not out of stubbornness, but because Sam Hodgson never needed one. Growing up on a farm, somewhere between dirt, shovels and bikes, it was clear early on: if there’s nothing to ride, you build it yourself.

items.title: Sahil's Words
items.overview: Sahil’s Words is a poetic documentary that explores migration, the learning of French, and solidarity through the story of an 18-year-old Afghan refugee living in a camp in Switzerland. As he learns French, he tries to rebuild his life. Alongside him, a retired man accompanies him. What begins as simple learning encounters gradually becomes a quiet relationship, woven between two generations and two worlds.

items.title: Recuerdo tu nombre
items.overview: Archaeologist Laura Muñoz investigates mass graves from the Spanish Civil War. Beneath the soil she searches for the women who were murdered or disappeared, and for the violence that silence still hides.

items.title: Roots
items.overview: More than 200 days of the year, you can find local Vermonter and ski patroller Ethan Parrish skiing some of the most extreme terrain in the Vermont backcountry. Ethan is aware of the impact of outsiders on local life, from the strain on community to reckless practices in the backcountry. While clearing the land surrounding his great-uncle’s farmhouse, he dreams of his own future, living off the land and skiing Vermont’s Green Mountains. Roots explores his deep connection to the mountains, the people in his life, and his home.

items.title: Two Feet Down And Falling
items.overview: An overworked person returns home only to spent his free time watching questionable content on cable TV.

items.title: Redemption
items.overview: Redemption is told through the perspectives of fentanyl addiction survivors in recovery, tribal leaders, and healthcare professionals who combat the devastating impact of fentanyl on the Mandan, Hidatsa, and Arikara Nation.

items.title: Sublimazione
items.overview: After a car accident that left deep scars—both visible and invisible—the director reflects on the experience of pain and memory through an intimate voice-over. The scars are transformed into abstract landscapes, while the drawings created during her hospital stay accompany a transformation that involves her body and her relationship with herself. *Sublimation* explores how trauma alters perception and transforms what it leaves behind, as body, memory, matter, and pain continually take on new forms.

items.title: Framed
items.overview: Siebe Vanhee sets out to onsight Voie Petit, a brutal 12-pitch 8a+ line at 3,500m on the Grand Capucin, completely alone - no partner, no static ropes, just lead rope-solo technique and a drone circling above. But even a solo mission as a professional climber has a crew: a manager on the phone, a sponsor waiting for footage, a director on the glacier, and Vanhee himself playing climber, cameraman and storyteller all at once, selfie-interviewing his own exhaustion pitch by pitch.

items.title: Ridgeline
items.overview: Professional musician and composer Liz Derstine heads into the wilderness to chase a very different goal: attempting a self-supported Fastest Known Time on the Pacific Crest Trail.

items.title: Finding Flow
items.overview: A short film about Christopher Blevins' obsession with short-track mountain bike racing, from his roots in racing local short-track races in Durango, Colorado, to becoming short track world champion.

items.title: The Art of Hold Shaping
items.overview: An intimate documentary exploring the world of Dan Yagmin as the creative force behind Decoy Holds. Moving between wild landscapes, workshop processes and climbing walls, the film is a portrait of an artist shaping not just holds, but the way we experience climbing itself.

items.title: Buone vacanze Heidelberg
items.overview: Introduced in 1957, Contergan, a drug containing thalidomide, promised relief from illness. Prescribed to ease nausea in pregnant women, it caused severe congenital malformations, including phocomelia. At Heidelberg’s Orthopedic Hospital, where Ernst Marquardt works, surgeries, rehabilitation sessions and prosthesis fittings mark the childhood of its young patients. In Buone vacanze Heidelberg, Rebecca Picci reflects on this period.

items.title: David & Jonathan
items.overview: Jonathan returns to his childhood village for his grandmother’s funeral. While he reunites with his childhood lover there, a meteor manipulated by a pop star unleashes strange creatures.

items.title: Casey
items.overview: Casey is a young woman on a journey of self-empowerment, shaped by community and a fierce love for skateboarding. This short film is a tribute to trans+ joy and the spaces that allow people to be unapologetically themselves. Made in collaboration with Transkaters and Not A Phase charity.

items.title: I Follow Rivers
items.overview: Mariann Sæther is one of the best whitewater kayakers in the world. Since she was a teenager, she has challenged expectations within sport and society. When she becomes a mother, she is determined she can both be an extreme sports athlete and have a family. But is life on the river really worth the risk?

items.title: Forward
items.overview: Celebrate the power of adaptive adventure through the inspiring journey of Clay March — a young man with cerebral palsy whose passion for skiing, surfing, and exploring the outdoors knows no bounds. Set against the awe-inspiring landscapes of British Columbia, Clay, his triplet brother Tanner, and a vibrant cast of renowned adaptive athletes set out to defy expectations and redefine what inclusion in the outdoors truly means.

items.title: Kindred
items.overview: A film exploring the bond between a mother and daughter, a story of home, devotion and a shared love of trad climbing in North Wales.

items.title: Wild Camps
items.overview: ​​This short film was co-created with young people, all of whom live in Hull, a city in Northern England which is the least wooded in the whole of the UK. Through poetry and participatory action research, the youth delve into the impact of nature immersion on a five-day Wild Camp with Rewilding Youth has on them.

items.title: Resurfacing
items.overview: Deena Lynch, aka Jaguar Jonze, is a touring artist and songwriter. In 2024 she experienced a sudden and unexplained paralysis while swimming and began to drown. She was diagnosed with functional neurological disorder and lupus. The ocean became her sanctuary and place of rehabilitation as she learned about her new body. A year later, despite her debilitating health condition, she qualified for the Australian national team at the 35th AIDA Freediving World Championships in Cyprus and shocked the world.

items.title: Ripple
items.overview: Two women sit by the lake that raised them and have a conversation about what it means to be a freeride skier. After dedicating their lives to the sport, they question the meaning of it all. More than anything, this is a story about surrendering to the present moment. A story about being water.

items.title: Rev
items.overview: They come from Iraq or Afghanistan. Some have rebuilt their lives in Europe. Others have never left their country, making the journey to Mallorca all the more extraordinary. The film follows eight women lining up at the start of Mallorca by UTMB for the very first trail race of their lives.

items.title: Bas Van Steenbergen - Interlude
items.overview: Bas Van Steenbergen heads up Mt. Seymour on Vancouver's North Shore — the birthplace of freeride —riding with a rhythm all his own.

items.title: Marcus & Me
items.overview: As a participant in the Outdoor Inclusion Coalition, 'little' Marcus explores the less-known corners of his Pittsburgh back yard to seek out opportunities for climbing and connection with nature.

items.title: Lust has no logic
items.overview: Cinema has rules. Stories need structure. Art needs logic. At least, that's what they say.  Gaaji, a filmmaker with an unfinished piece of art and an imagination of questionable consequences, finds himself caught between his creative impulses and a world that insists on making sense of everything.  An absurd encounter with art, authority, divinity and the people who think they know better!

items.title: The Unabsorbed Past
items.overview: “The French and the Vietnamese came here [...] but they soon grew tired of it. There wasn’t much to do but hunt. This city is quite boring.” This observation without context from an unidentified narrator offers little more than a hint of a colonial past. Black-and-white photographs show men in pith helmets posing with a tiger they had just shot. It is unclear how these hunters are connected to the plantations where dragonfruit is now cultivated at night under artificial light, watched over by drones. The connection with a nearby laboratory, where a wind turbine blade is undergoing a fatigue test, remains equally mysterious.

items.title: Maarige Daari
items.overview: Maarige Daari is not just revenge, it's the cost of walking the wrong path for the right reason. Every action carries emotional weight, Maarige Daari is a cinematic masterpiece, a cult classic built on raw emotion, intense action, and a relentless journey.

items.title: 3 Peaks Cyclocross
items.overview: First run in 1961 by the Bradford Cycling Club, the classic race crosses Pen-y-Ghent, Whernside and Ingleborough, three fells above the River Ribble in the Yorkshire Dales. The course is now 61km in length, with 33km on unsurfaced ground, 28km on road, and six to eight km that the organisers deem unrideable. Join Lachlan Morton for a cyclocross race like no other.

items.title: It's What You Make It
items.overview: Lars has figured out what he loves - snowboarding. This film explores his approach to surfstyle carving and what keeps him coming back after 35 years. For him, carving becomes a form of expression, feeling and freedom.

items.title: Hotpipe Hillbillies
items.overview: A documentary about community, resilience, and finding joy in the most unlikely of places. Against the backdrop of Shoreham’s industrial shoreline, a diverse crew of surfers gather at an industrial outflow pipe to ride waves that are often messy, fickle, and short-lived. This ain’t Cornwall. It sure ain’t California. But for this crew, it’s home

items.title: Rodeo On Ice
items.overview: With skijoring poised to become a potential addition to the 2030 Winter Olympics, lifelong equestrian Britta Nancarrow assembles a team to push her skijoring to the next level. The film follows Nancarrow as she trains with skier Mike King and snowboarder Sandra Hillen, taking their on-snow skills to their very first competition.

items.title: The Tree Keepers
items.overview: The Isle of Arran is home to three tree species found nowhere else in the world, including the Catacol Whitebeam, of which only a single recognised wild specimen exists. For decades, amateur gardeners Henry Murdo and Margo McLellan have dedicated their spare time to cultivating and protecting these rare trees, ensuring their survival against the odds.

items.title: Tiba
items.overview: This isn't quite a climbing story. It's a pause on the mountain, seen through the eyes of Tiba, a young Colombian climber whose voice already seems to know a path his feet have only begun to walk. The film follows the quiet bond between the boy and the walls he climbs, a place where he finds calm, discipline, and a freedom rare for someone his age. Up there, the height turns out to be the least of it.

items.title: Come What May
items.overview: Assynt Mountain Rescue safeguard the northernmost reaches of the Scottish Highlands. Winter here brings treacherous conditions and dangerous callouts. This short film follows a season in this dark, weather-beaten world, telling a story of duty, fragility, and sacrifice through the eyes of selfless individuals who stand ready, at a moment’s notice, to face the physical and metaphorical storms life brings.

items.title: Nasty
items.overview: Beauty and lifestyle influencer, Sienna, receives an unexpected visitor while filming her weekly vlog.

items.title: On Flying
items.overview: Moving between family life, alpine pursuits, and memories of a lifetime spent chasing human flight, the film follows a father, designer, and master flyer confronting what it means to age inside a discipline built on precision, instinct, and consequence. More than a film about risk, this is a quiet portrait of craft, family, and the strange humility of coming home after touching flight.

items.title: 75 Seconds
items.overview: On a foggy March evening in Norway, freeskier Jacob Wester triggers an avalanche and is swept off a cliff. For 75 seconds, he fights for his life inside a roaring mass of snow, while his wife Sofia waits in silence below. This is an account of chaos, fear, and hope inside an avalanche.

items.title: More Than Art: RRR.RAID
items.overview: More Than Art: RRR.RAID is a conversation of the creative and expressive O'odham people.

items.title: The Long Way Home
items.overview: Kelly Halpin has long dreamed of completing a full traverse of the beautiful and seldom travelled Gros Ventre mountain range right in her backyard in Wyoming. The route is 50 miles off-trail over technical terrain and hits every major summit in the range. After years of scouting and two failed attempts the film shows the power of perseverance and dreaming big while staying close to home.

items.title: In Another Life
items.overview: While waiting in the same hospital ICU for their respective partners—Laura's husband, Carl, and Jack's wife, Brenda—to wake up or pass away, Laura and Jack find comfort in each other. Shared grief and understanding gradually turn into an emotional affair, forcing them to confront guilt, loyalty, and longing as the reality of recovery or loss approaches

items.title: Coluche, Le Luron, Desproges : quand on pouvait rire de tout
BODEGA London Tour Diary
items.overview: A day on the road with Brooklyn-based art rock band BODEGA, signed to Chrysalis Records, as they bring their tour to London in support of their new album 'All Inside Aquarium'.  The short documentary follows the band throughout the day, capturing the behind-the-scenes preparations of soundcheck, an in-store signing and meet-and-greet at Sister Ray, before rocking out in their live performance at the iconic 100 Club.

items.title: G.I.S.M. 「GASBURNER PANIC」
items.overview: The footage captures G.I.S.M.’s guest appearance at the "Final Wars" concert—headlined by Psychic TV—on Jan. 16, 1986. During the set, G.I.S.M. frontman Sakevi Yokoyama ignited a gas burner and stormed into the audience. The organizers, deeming this a dangerous act, cut the sound; the band responded with fierce protest. The entire sequence of events—including a subsequent confrontation with a reporter from a weekly magazine who was filming the incident—is included here, completely uncut.  The performance and the surrounding events were captured in their entirety using a single Sony Betamovie camera. At the time, per Sakevi Yokoyama’s wishes, the footage was released as an unedited, uncut work.  Additionally, the package includes a bonus disc featuring a live DVD of the "Apocalypse 666" show, held at Shinjuku Antiknock in 1992.

items.title: La Sombra Alemana
items.overview: A strange shadow possesses a young person in a movie theater.

items.title: Pas De Deux (la muerte del cisne)
items.overview: Ana and Julián begin a new chapter after moving in together into an apartment, but this will also bring problems to their relationship.

items.title: Learning to Fly
items.overview: As surfing grows in popularity, an unlikely new craft challenges a community of lifelong surfers to become beginners again. Forced to question what they think they know about surfing, they rediscover the joy, freedom and shared spirit that first drew them to the ocean.

items.title: Dare to Dream
items.overview: Georgia Carmichael was a two-time gold medallist for Great Britain when a series of freak events and terminal illness left her paralysed for years. At her lowest, she only had two ways to go, and she chose to fight. She decided she would do more than just survive, she would rediscover her purpose.

items.title: S.O.L.
items.overview: S.O.L. (Statute of Limitations / Shit Outta Luck) is a short film that looks at the limits of justice and the uncertain journey of healing. Through poetic visuals, it explores how survivors deal with trauma. S.O.L. is both personal and political. It breaks the silence, shows where systems fall short, and reclaims power through storytelling.

items.title: Harm Reduction
items.overview: Convinced of his own remarkability, student Piotr Kotara dreams of a life filled with spectacular achievements, praise, and love. When repeated failures challenge his self-image, he turns to drugs - first as a means to success, and eventually as an escape from the disintegration of his identity.

items.title: Not Just Running
items.overview: An intimate portrait of an athlete who finds in movement a way to understand herself, grow, and continue shaping her own path. Through her preparation, training sessions, and the quiet moments that come before competition, the film approaches Joyce Njeru not only as an elite runner, but as a person shaped by her culture, determination, discipline, and a deep connection with the terrain.

items.title: Building Apollo 13
items.overview: What begins as a challenge on the rock becomes a profound process of dedication and commitment. Caro North, Fay Manners, Rocio Rodriguez Guiñazú and Belén Prados devote their time, bodies, and hearts to opening a new route in a remote place, Turbio IV in Patagonia, Argentina, building not only a challenge but also a way of inhabiting and sharing the mountain. What makes it unique is their willingness to dedicate the necessary time and care to leave the route immaculate and safe for other climbers to enjoy; not simply to climb a wall, but to create something that can be shared with others.

items.title: Flashing Divided Years
items.overview: The film follows climbers Robbie Phillips and Jamie Lowther as they take on Ireland’s most legendary rock climb, Divided Years E9 6c. Robbie has spent six months preparing for a flash ascent; from bottom to top on the very first attempt, where one mistake ends the effort for good. Jamie is there for all of it, supporting Robbie’s bid just as Robbie supports Jamie’s own headpoint attempt on the same route.

items.title: Scission
items.overview: After finding the “cure to loneliness”, Damien must choose his reality

items.title: Grigoriy's Chimgan
items.overview: In the mountains around Chimgan, Uzbekistan, lies a ski culture largely unknown to the outside world. Paul and Loïc travel there to meet Grigoriy, a local ski legend who pioneered freeride skiing in the region. Through his stories, they discover an unexpected side of Uzbekistan, its mountains and a unique ski culture now finding new momentum, while hoping to repeat a first descent Grigoriy made on Greater Chimgan many years ago.

items.title: Pain Game
items.overview: Set in the Lake District, Jack Jarvis - ex-Royal Marine, two-time Atlantic record breaker and survivor of a near-fatal parachute accident - takes on his first backyard ultra. Through failed recovery, mounting pain and shared suffering, the race becomes an exploration of the role pain and camaraderie plays in achievement.

items.title: Terror on Bondi Beach
items.overview: Eyewitnesses share their stories of survival and heroism in the face of hate when, in December 2025, Jewish families were attacked, purely for their faith, on Australia’s famous beach.

items.title: Studie i mänskligt beteende
items.overview: A study of human behaviour, puts different archetypes of people in common and uncommon situations to see how they act. We'll meet the know-it-all, the rule stickler, the neurotic, the lone wolf, and many more.

items.title: 52 Blomet Street
items.overview: In 1920s Paris, a jazz club became the meeting ground for colonial soldiers and artists, revealing a forgotten alliance that redrew the borders of identity and belonging.

items.title: The Dawn: Reborn
items.overview: Set against Lebanon's fight for independence, The Dawn follows Nadia, a fearless journalist whose articles against the French mandate ignite a nation's rage — and Rami, a fellow journalist forced into hiding who finds her in a remote village. As tensions escalate — culminating in the arrest of the President, Prime Minister and ministers — the two become co-heroes of a movement that ends in Lebanon's independence on November 22nd. Twenty-six years on, the film has been fully reborn in 4K and reimagined for a new generation.

items.title: Extinction
items.overview: For over five years, Save Windermere has campaigned to end sewage pollution in Windermere, exposing the scale of the problem, challenging those responsible and bringing the plight of the lake to national attention. This work culminated in the publication of the landmark Only Rainwater into Windermere feasibility study, demonstrating how sewage pollution could be eliminated from Windermere and its surrounding catchment. Released at a pivotal moment for Windermere’s future, this film features extraordinary cinematography and the voices of those whose lives are deeply connected to the lake.

items.title: Šárka - National Theatre Brno
items.overview: Who has the right to rule? Does it belong to men or women? In mythical Bohemia, Princess Libuše ruled together with Přemysl, but after her death, women are ignominiously banished from the council, and the right to rule is claimed exclusively by men. The women of Bohemia, led by Vlasta, do not intend to put up with this and decide to claim their rights by force. They set a trap for the men and their leader Ctirad. Could love trouble a well-laid plan…?

items.title: Then I Saw a Beautiful Horse
items.overview: Then I Saw a Beautiful Horse begins with a legal contradiction. Until as recently as 2013, German law permitted bestiality—sex with animals—under a framework that treated the act as seperate from intent and invoked the possibility of “animal consent”. Meanwhile, the killing of animals for consumption remained socially unquestioned.

items.title: The Last Season
items.overview: Igoudou and her friend Koumba, both 20, play rugby for a club in Bobigny, a suburb of Paris. For both of them, rugby is much more than just a sport: it made them strong—physically and mentally—and it taught them how to deal with problems at school, at home, at work, or anywhere. The outside world’s stereotype of the sport as being for men is annoying, but ultimately provides extra motivation.

items.title: The Sacred Circle
items.overview: Atena is a young woman in present-day Iran, with a will as strong as her body. She works in construction, wrestles, goes to the gym, and is determined to set up a women’s club where they can learn and practice the centuries-old Iranian sport of zurkhaneh. Women are barred from the sport in Iran because menstruation is considered to make them impure.

items.title: Man of Seed
items.overview: After the return of democracy in Spain, it remained taboo to talk about the more than a hundred thousand people who disappeared under the Franco regime. That changed in 1994, when, on La Palma, for the first time a mass grave was opened. In Man of Seed, María Abenia shows how residents of the Canary Island are trying to keep the memory of the missing alive not only by continuing to carry out excavations, but also through music and poetry, and by passing on their stories to future generations.

items.title: Eye Sun
items.overview: A finger traces lines in the sand that on a larger scale form a solar observatory in the Peruvian landscape. This short film explores the human fascination with observing the sun, and also reflects on the sense of sight. Eye Sun connects three sites of solar observation in Peru and three temporalities: Chankillo, considered the oldest solar observatory in the Americas; the Huancayo Observatory, active since 1922; and CIEASEST in Ica, where specific chemical elements present in the spectrum of sunlight are observed and analyzed.

items.title: Stage Fright
items.overview: An amateur magician learns the difference between an optimistic attitude and what is within reach.

items.title: CeCe's Way
items.overview: As a young woman with additional needs, CeCe understands how it can feel to find things difficult, and she brings that compassion and understanding to her role as a ride leader with the New Forest Off Road Club.

items.title: The Anti Expedition
items.overview: Bob, a young professor of outdoor education, was searching for an ethos to guide his teaching when he stumbled upon a film made in 1971. The film depicted three mountaineers who chose not to summit a Himalayan mountain out of respect for local beliefs. For Bob, it was this film, and the work of Sigmund Kvaløy (one of the three mountaineers), that spurred a lifelong passion for ‘place responsive’ outdoor adventure. In The Anti Expedition, Bob and a team of seasoned adventure guides return the 1971 film to the Sherpa community of the Rolwaling Valley. In a fascinating look at how five decades has affected both the valley and its people, they rediscover that it's not the destination that makes the journey meaningful.

items.title: SPACES
items.overview: In a world where people are physically shaped by the ones closest to them, a malleable young figure named Gunther struggles to fill the empty spaces left by his closest friends, ultimately learning that healing isn’t about filling in what’s lost, but embracing the spaces they leave behind.

items.title: I Am Helen
items.overview: Helen and Steve (Nicola Coughlan and Joe Cole) seem to have a loving relationship, but as Steve begins to consume misogynistic online porn and the rhetoric of the manosphere, their dynamic shifts

items.title: Making The Intimacy Coordinator
items.overview: A behind the scenes look at director/ actress Louisa Connolly Burnham's short film "The Intimacy Coordinator".

items.title: Bien hecho. La extraordinaria historia de Javier García Pajares
I AM – Investigation Art Mysteries
items.overview: In this exciting five-part series for young audiences, friends Martijn and Finbarr become true detectives and try to unravel famous art mysteries. The first two episodes are being screened at IDFA.

items.title: Mallory Reimagined
items.overview: The Turner Twins climb Mera Peak (6,476m/ 21,217ft) to understand how mountaineering clothing and gear worn by George Mallory and Sandy Irvine on their 1924 Everest expedition has evolved over the past 100 years.

items.title: Canina
items.overview: Filmmaker Néstor López never got along well with his grandfather. He was an unpleasant man, difficult to read. He would have liked to become a singer or actor, but instead spent all 90 years of his life in the same quiet hamlet in rural Spain. Alongside his factory job, he devoted himself to making fishing flies by hand for catching trout and salmon.

items.title: Half Moon, Half Crazy
items.overview: A documentary on Canadian musician Michael Louis Johnson's house concert in Stratford, Ontario.

items.title: Elsewhere: Randi Skaug
items.overview: Randi Skaug was the first Norwegian woman to climb Mount Everest and went on to complete the Seven Summits. She has led expeditions around the world, written books and inspired thousands of people to embrace the outdoors. Now going through cancer treatment and unable to return to her remote island house, Randi welcomes us into her eclectic home in Oslo. As her world grows smaller, her perspective grows clearer. For Randi, a lifetime of extraordinary achievement has led to one simple conclusion: be kind.

items.title: The Kelp Collector
