items.overview: After a career in science, Sandy Webb has found a new passion in retirement: collecting and cataloguing the diverse algae species that inhabit the waters near her Melbourne home. With the precision of a scientist and the eye of an artist, she transforms her discoveries into exquisite pressed-seaweed specimens, The kelp collector reveals how Sandy's dedication to documenting local marine life connects her to the coastal environment she calls home.

items.title: Brooman
items.overview: Paul faces $5,000 of debt due by the end of the week. Unable to keep a job and desperate for any amount of money, Paul embarks on a journey to solicit sweeping jobs for pennies and dimes before his freedom is stripped away for eternity.

items.title: Magnus Live: The Hilltop
items.overview: Performance of The Hilltop recorded at the Clapham Grand Theatre in London on 6th November 2025.

items.title: Thinking About Childhood
items.overview: This Art Experimental Short Film About Showing Low Quality Footage Walk Around School Building As Symbol Of "Every Human Has A Past About Childhood" And You Can't Go Backwards Just Because You Miss About Childhood You Can Think But You Can't Return.

items.title: Rebento
items.overview: Experimental short about the uncertainty of motherhood comprised of private footage and AI-generated images.

items.title: Godfather
items.overview: How does transience manifest itself? The observant, documentary gaze turns toward places where something appears to have been lost—and hints at what is destined to be lost in the future. Amidst it all lie traces of a life, embedded in objects to which time seems to still cling: a marionette, notched wood, an accordion—all blanketed by the settling dust of the years. It is an encounter that compels us to reflect upon the fundamental questions of our own lives.

items.title: The Night
items.overview: On Halloween night, a woman home alone is met with an intruder.

items.title: The Sage
items.overview: Tired of her Hero being utterly incompetent, a struggling Sage heads to the local Sage Tavern to figure out what to do with herself.

items.title: THE TIMES ARE CALLING
items.overview: Named after the standardized daily broadcast radio calisthenics practiced in middle and high schools across China, the film opens on students exercising in strict unison. The camera gradually isolates one female student who breaks away from the rigid choreography to find her own impromptu rhythm before folding back in—illustrating what Shu calls "flexible" or "soft resistance" within everyday collective routines.

items.title: Focker In-Law
items.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

items.title: Love on the Vineyard
items.overview: Jordan Wilson, a D.C. real estate executive who returns to Martha’s Vineyard and reconnects with her former summer love while fighting to save a historic Oak Bluffs inn.

items.title: Christmas in Blue Dog Valley
items.overview: After leaving Hollywood to run a veterinary clinic in Blue Dog Valley, Goldie struggles to win over the townspeople during Christmas while finding unexpected romance with the former owner's son and guidance from a mysterious dog.

items.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE VIEWING
items.overview: The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen. Join the roar of the crowds in Kaohsiung in November and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour. Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

items.title: The Dark Days of Cassidy Krystian
items.overview: An Ojibwe woman is awakened to her past and its bloody aftermath.

items.title: Sufferfest
items.overview: Follows four athletes as they train for the world’s most revered 100 mile race: The Ultra Trail Mont Blanc. Spanning 171km, over 33,000 feet of elevation gain and three countries, the race is nothing short of mythic. And with everything on the line, these elite runners come face to face with the pressure, the risk and the grit it takes to earn a spot on the podium.

items.title: Love Test
items.overview: A woman stages her own disappearance to test her boyfriend's love, only for him to quickly start a passionate relationship with another woman who unknowingly becomes entangled in the original scheme.

items.title: PERFECT STORM : THE MOVIE
items.overview: PERFECT STORM: THE MOVIE depicts the process of five young men with different backstories facing unexpected dangers. Notably, writer Jeon Hyo-jin of the representative Korean mystery variety show 'Crime Scene' series participated in screenwriting also participated in TXT's Hello Strangers. The five members appear as characters with their own stories, confronting incidents that shake their daily lives and dangers akin to a massive storm.

items.title: Olivera & Corman: Hollywood in Argentina
items.overview: In 1983, two filmmakers from opposite ends of the globe, Héctor Olivera and Roger Corman, signed an unlikely agreement: to produce nine films together. Four decades later, the two protagonists recount this improbable alliance.

items.title: Errand Guy
items.overview: Brad, a middle-aged errand runner, gets guilt-tripped by his dead Jewish Grandmother into believing his passive life embarrasses his ancestors, so he steals a Ferrari and tries to buy a minor league baseball team behind his wife's back.

items.title: Etterklang
items.overview: Exposure has a way of nudging you with doubt — and at its most intense, it can reignite past trauma. As Arc’teryx athlete Tonje Kvivik’s career as a big mountain skier took her to greater heights, anxiety from her childhood began to reappear. In her quest to confront old fears, Tonje turns to her community for guidance: her grandfather, Arne, in Norway, and her close friend and teammate, snowboarder Spencer O’Brien. With their wisdom and encouragement as her guide, she steps into unfamiliar terrain and discovers an inner strength she never knew she had.

items.title: Mari, Sweetie
items.overview: Mari masks loneliness with wit until it floods her apartment. Unable to contain it, she is pulled into a memory of being bullied as an eleven-year-old. To survive, Mari must save her inner child by choosing compassion over shame.

items.title: Birth of the Black Underworld
items.overview: Set in the 1930's, Birth of the Black Underworld takes viewers on a fascinating journey into the makings of the black underworld and the evolving mindsets of a pack of young would be gangsters lead by Satterfield Jackson who was an orphan taken in by respected Italian mobster Marco Ricci who has ties in both the Italian and Jewish Mafia. Marco and Satterfield develop a father/son bond and like any father would do, Ricci grooms Satterfield for the real world. The Underworld.

items.title: Cbeebies Panto: Treasure Island
items.overview: A swashbuckling musical reimagining of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic pirate adventure. The story follows a young boy named Jim and his dad, Bertie, as they set off on a treasure hunt across the high seas. Along the way, they encounter sneaky pirates, a chatty seagull, and a very festive holiday surprise! The lively retelling is packed with original songs and laughs, celebrating the importance of family and listening to the ones you love most.

items.title: Soap
items.overview: Caught in the grim atmosphere of industrial decline, a reluctant official visits the remaining factories that are about to close. To clear his conscience, he begins a search for his missing relative, with the help of a 17-year-old girl obsessed with soap.

items.title: Made for Her: A Native American Fashion Film
items.overview: Two souls share a forbidden love. They decide to keep their relationship a secret. But when a Warrior claims one as his wife, her family plans a ceremony. In sadness, her lover runs away, becoming mortal. Her love must now save her.

items.title: You Told Us To Talk About the Weather
items.overview: In the past six hours, 94% of Brits have spoken about the weather. In the past five years, 7000 Brits have been arrested for speaking out about the climate crisis. This short film, starring Michael Sheen, has been developed with young farmers and colleges in rural Norfolk. It questions why it’s so hard for us to have meaningful conversations about climate change. Told through the eyes of a child grappling with climate anxiety, the film explores the cost of British small talk and encourages audiences to elevate their daily habits into tools for meaningful change.

items.title: Head Spaces
items.overview: Two people struggle to get out their heads, so they arrange for someone to deliver them from their perceived prison.

items.title: The Five Treasures of the Snows
items.overview: In 1955, the world’s third-highest mountain, Kangchenjunga, was climbed to within five metres of its summit by an expedition led by Charles Evans. They stopped just short out of respect for local beliefs that a protective deity lived there, providing the mountain communities with good harvests and wellbeing. This short film recounts the story of this landmark ascent and explores its cultural significance in the development of mountaineering, spotlighting the role of the fully integrated Sherpa team and the contribution of working-class climber Joe Brown.

items.title: Sunspots
items.overview: A death, a drug trip and an accident turn Marie's life upside down in a single day. She decides to return to her childhood home, her late grandmother's house in Slovakia. Accompanied by her ex-boyfriend Jerome, she begins hitchhiking. With no rules or clear plans, they travel from place to place, meeting unusual people along the way. As the journey continues, Marie takes greater risks and tests both her own limits and those of others, until things gradually spiral out of control.

items.title: The Altruist
items.overview: Saving the world, one phone call at a time.

items.title: The Spirit of Zorro
items.overview: Cutting back and forth between a dinner and fight to save a prisoner, Don Diego De La Vega battles two worlds, as an aristocrat and the vigilante known as “El Zorro.”

items.title: Remember the Summit
items.overview: Sir Chris Bonington’s return to Torres del Paine, 62 years after the first ascent of the Central Tower.  At 91 years old, and while living with Alzheimer’s disease, the documentary accompanies Bonington in a profoundly human return: an attempt to reconnect with memories that time has erased, but that the Patagonian landscape still seems to guard. During the filming, Chris once again set foot on the territory of Estancia Cerro Guido, closing a circle between past and present, between the epic of mountaineering and the fragility of memory.

items.title: I've Never Met Myself
items.overview: Back home after a night on stage, Kim strips away the remnants of her drag persona. As each layer of performance disappears, painful memories resurface, forcing her to confront what she has been trying to leave behind.

items.title: All Things Come To Night
items.overview: A couple retreats to an isolated property in the woods for a spontaneous weekend away. But when unexpected visitors disturb their solitude, the night descends into a deadly mystery where danger may be closer than they realize.

items.title: Purple Mass
items.overview: A boy wanders through the remnants of a abandoned school, discovering a mysterious purple glow

items.title: Knights of Night
items.overview: When a vigilante crew targeting online predators sparks a war with a rival gang that's a twisted cult, New York City descends into a chaotic fever dream of violence, revenge, and survival.

items.title: Night Fishers
items.overview: Two ambitious content creators trespass on private property in the hopes of making their next viral hit.

items.title: EKEKEKEK
items.overview: A man who is forced to kill his cat after it suddenly transforms into a creature tries to give it a proper farewell by burying the body with his friend.

items.title: Tampons & Taxes: Or How to Play the Ole Boys Club and Win
items.overview: Six female South Carolina state senators unite across party lines to pressure male colleagues into repealing a tax on feminine hygiene products, in this upbeat, empowering tale of sisterhood and strategy.

items.title: Hoxe e o resto do mundo
items.overview: Isaac Díaz Pardo and Mimina Arias de Castro founded the Laboratorio de Formas behind Sargadelos. Built from a wealth of archive material, the film follows their life and work between Galicia and exile, through art, design, architecture, historical memory and avant-garde thought.

items.title: Cassiopeia
items.overview: Beatriz, a young woman fascinated by astronomy, meets Olívia and begins to see her freckles as constellations. Amidst friendship, desire, and discovery, she grapples with feelings that transform her relationship with the world.

items.title: Excalibur, A Pursuit in Process
items.overview: Brooke Raboutou takes on Excalibur (5.15c / 9b+) in Arco, Italy. This film documents the process, hardships, and relentless perseverance—both mental and physical—behind her pursuit of one of the hardest routes in the world. At just 18 moves, Excalibur is a brutally condensed testpiece of pure power endurance on razor-sharp holds. Brooke’s ascent not only marks a leap in her career – becoming the first woman to climb 5.15c / 9b+ – but also represents a meaningful step in closing the long-standing gap between men and women at the absolute cutting edge of sport climbing.

items.title: Nataša
items.overview: In the early morning, far away from home, a filmmaker talks about his mother, Nataša, from a window overlooking the city. As we watch the buildings and the neighborhood slowly waking up, a portrait of a woman emerges beyond what we see, and the story eventually leads him to something he has never said out loud before.

items.title: Reflections
items.overview: Isa gets ready for a date, trying to style herself to suit Rodrigo's tastes. When he arrives to pick her up, she is happy that he likes her look, but during the drive, she begins to realize that Rodrigo has no interest in getting to know her; as he gradually moves closer to her, she feels increasingly uncomfortable and trapped.

items.title: Ice Women
items.overview: Why does the Arctic continue to captivate? And why have its stories been told the way they have? For centuries, it was framed as a stage for male heroism, where explorers risked everything in pursuit of glory and discovery. But beyond this familiar narrative lies another reality. Women played decisive roles in organising, financing, and even leading expeditions, often ensuring survival in extreme conditions. The film uncovers this hidden history, revealing how their contributions shaped Arctic exploration – and why they were forgotten.

items.title: Feeling Blue
items.overview: HAVE YOU EVER HAD A HOMOEROTIC FRIENDSHIP? Two roommates begin an intense friendship until feelings jeopardize their relationship.

items.title: The Offer
items.overview: Oswaldo, an ordinary man having an ordinary morning... until he tries to order a coffee. That confronts him with the most uncomfortable question of his life: do I accept a coffee based on a misunderstanding, or is this my moment to come out of the closet?

items.title: I HAD A... (DREAM)
items.overview: I HAD A... (DREAM) unfolds as a trip where dance, stop-motion animation, sound, and imagery interplay, far from established dimensions and expectations. Mushrooms immerse the viewer in a dreamlike space, where the film becomes a site for deviation and disruption.

items.title: Softcore
items.overview: Taste in music can be painfully revealing.

items.title: Comment devenir connu
items.overview: Why does fame hold such an allure for us? To find out, Phil Lacroix gives himself six months to become famous. Through his gonzo-style approach, he paints a portrait of a Quebec culture in the midst of a major upheaval.

items.title: Touch Some Soil
items.overview: In the centre of a rapidly moving city, an urban farmer teaches us what it means to slow down. Set within a community farm, the film explores how South Asian growing, cultural memory, and collective care create a space of belonging, while also speaking to the deeper questions of food justice in the city.

items.title: Willem Dafoe
items.overview: A short film about.. what's his name again? That actor? Kristoffer Borgli tries hard to remember.

items.title: The Lost Cache
items.overview: History, science and exploration converged in a quest to find the lost camera of one of climbing’s most iconic photographers and cartographers, Bradford Washburn. Set against the backdrop of the pioneering lensmen’s storied 1937 Mount Lucania expedition, this film blurs the lines between adventure documentary, treasure hunt and meditation on why we risk everything to chase the improbable.

items.title: Herminia
items.overview: A tale of a mother's struggle with depression, while a daughter discovers something about herself that she did not know.

items.title: Therapy
items.overview: A child psychologist becomes entangled in a supernatural mystery when a troubled girl claims to be visited by an Apache deity, warning her of a monstrous evil hiding in plain sight.

items.title: The Boom
items.overview: An Indigenous man investigates a mysterious sound echoing through the city that reverberates through space and time.

items.title: A Mulher da Polar
items.overview: After a piranha attack at Polar Beach, a young woman finds herself face-to-face with a mysterious woman in black. Alongside a friend, the figure reappears and reveals herself as a protective river entity, warning her about environmental imbalances. The young woman then realizes her deep connection with nature and with herself.

items.title: Children of the Ring
items.overview: Through a memory connected to Titanes en el Ring, the television show that shaped Matías’s childhood, Children of the Ring reconstructs the relationship between a father and son shaped by profoundly different childhoods.

items.title: Slower Steps
items.overview: Following spinal cord damage that left her paralysed on her left side, Alice Sainsbury sets out to walk the Cornish Celtic Way. Through 125 miles of endurance, she surrenders to nature and learns to trust her body again. Shot on a combination of digital and hand-processed 16mm using Cornish seawater.

items.title: I Can Do It
items.overview: Heidi Walsh paddles some of the world’s steepest descents.

items.title: Tape Jerky
items.overview: A short film about Chicago's Media Burn Archive and the challenge of preserving video stored on magnetic tape.

items.title: A Short Ride
items.overview: In post-revolutionary Cairo in 2011, amid unrest and lawlessness, Kamal, a privileged college student, is dragged into a long chaotic journey by his father's newly hired driver, in what was meant to be just a short ride.

items.title: banano, banano
items.overview: Death arrives in a small town in the south of Guatemala City, with the mission of taking three people with her: a boy lost in a hill, a young woman adrift, and an old writer who always dreamed of being a filmmaker.  An essay that presents three short stories about Death and how living in this world makes her more human.

items.title: Ties
items.overview: During a Halloween party, Olivia and her group of friends become embroiled in a deadly incident that will test their loyalty, their secrets, and the strength of their friendship.

items.title: Disharmony
items.overview: During one night in an alternative bar, young Alex starts his trial shift. He is a punk who always felt different, but now he wants to prove himself. However, making mistakes puts him under huge pressure and Alex must face his fear of not being accepted. Disharmony is a story about finding kindness and understanding in a loud world.

items.title: Chromas
items.overview: The blank and colourless canvas of life is painted vibrantly by a person's mere existence.

items.title: The Stay
items.overview: During a stay at a secluded lake house to kickstart his sobriety, a young man is confronted by mysterious phone calls, accidental murder and, worst of all, himself.

items.title: Chasing Sub 2
items.overview: A shared dream. A common belief.  Chasing Sub 2 is the journey towards realizing the impossible: running the world's first sub-two-hour marathon. A decade-long pursuit sparked by Haile Gebrselassie at the 2008 Berlin Marathon, which became a reality at the 2026 London Marathon.  Kenyan marathoner, Sabastian Sawe, has won all four of the marathons he has competed in. Adding to his extensive list of accolades is the historic 1:59:30 finish, powered by the latest Adizero innovation: the Adizero Adios Pro Evo 3. The fastest and lightest Adizero super-shoe ever made, weighing less than 100 grams.  Humanity just got faster.

items.title: Ten (10)
items.overview: A man trapped in a recurring 10-second loop must confront the physical manifestations of his past choices before time runs out for good.

items.title: Where the Pine Cones Lie
items.overview: East Texans reflect upon how their communities and personal lives have been shaped by the pine forests that surround them.

items.title: The Nobles
items.overview: The Khawaja Saras of Pakistan have a distinct gender identity and a long cultural presence, having once served as advisors in the courts of Mughal kings. With queer life in the country suppressed by colonialism, the community has been driven to the social margins. Set in Rawalpindi, the film follows three exuberant Khawaja Saras, who defiantly forge their lives with dignity as they run a café that becomes a community mainstay and sanctuary.

items.title: Treatise of Alumina on Cristobalite
items.overview: Alumina Cystobalite is sunbathing one morning at home, walking through the house, when she realizes she's being filmed.

items.title: Official
items.overview: My cousin who went to Taiwan, and my nephew who visited my home.

items.title: la vida de las piedras
items.overview: all living things have a life cycle. what is the life cycle of rocks?

items.title: The Whistling
items.overview: When an unlikely crew of Native filmmakers gather to make a film, they become trapped inside the set and, one by one, begin to disappear.

items.title: Água que Passarinho Também Bebe
items.overview: A young zombie emerges from a cemetery and roams the streets in search of water in a city undergoing the early stages of urban verticalization. At a gothic party, he tries to reconnect with life, but the thirst persists as a memory of his condition. Yet, he still retains a spark of afterlife capable of offering a simple gesture of solidarity that restores him, if only for a moment, to his humanity.

items.title: Virtus - The Four P's
items.overview: Join Ed Jackson’s climb of the Matterhorn as he explores the values that have shaped his life after spinal cord injury: Purpose, Perspective, Progress and Perseverance.

items.title: Bard Bar
items.overview: At Bart’s Bard Bar, a battle of the bands gets brutally personal when a lineup of wounded musicians turn performances into public humiliations. The truth behind their former tormentors now becomes the afternoon's entertainment.

items.title: Trial and Error
items.overview: As Feline is struggling to let go, a confrontation with a girl from her past forces her to face reality.

items.title: Goat Song
items.overview: A young Indigenous man who was adopted out of his family as a child undergoes a spiritual transformation as he searches to reconnect with his community.

items.title: After Dark
items.overview: A park ranger investigating mysterious disappearances encounters a dangerous predator after a jogger vanishes in the woods after dark.

items.title: Grief
items.overview: A grieving teenager, guided by mysterious texts and a friend’s support, learns to face the loss of his grandfather and discovers he’s already made him proud.

items.title: Sisakawihay
items.overview: The film centers on Sisakawihay Marang Panay, following him as he navigates tribal ceremonies, university lecture halls, and daily family life. Through his native language, prayers, and rituals, he responds to the entrustments and needs of his people. Through these repeated acts, he fulfills his responsibilities as a Sisakawihay while reflecting on how traditional beliefs can continue to be practiced in the modern world.

items.title: One Look
items.overview: In the last carriage of the Mexico City Metro, a young man exchanges glances with various men, hoping to find a connection. Amidst tunnels, stations, and fleeting encounters, a sustained gaze can be enough to establish a sense of complicity.

items.title: Ils font un bébé tout seuls
万妖图录传之云州异客
Hunter's Moon
items.overview: Ski mountaineers Christina ‘Lusti’ Lustenberger and Guillaume ‘Gee’ Pierrel carve a first ski descent on New Zealand's Aoraki / Mt. Cook.

items.title: The Dawn Wall By Your Side
items.overview: The Dawn Wall is the hardest big wall in the world. After his failure in 2021, Seb Berthe sets sail again for a second attempt. Strongly supported by Soline Kentzel, Seb will have to give his all to, maybe, achieve his lifetime dream. But he is not the only one with a dream, and Soline also embarks on an extremely ambitious ascent. More than a story of performance, this documentary intimately and deeply questions, through Soline’s perspective, the meaning of the climbing partnership.

items.title: Frost Scraping
items.overview: Driven by her family roots to make sure no hide goes to waste, Kanina Terry not only masters tanning but also refines a winter frost-scraping method that transforms her process and deepens her love for the craft.

items.title: Surviving the London Nail Bombings
items.overview: Surviving the London Nail Bombings is a feature-length documentary about the three far-right terrorist attacks that devastated London in April 1999, told primarily through the memories of those who were there. Using intimate interviews, archive news reports, CCTV and extraordinary images captured by a photographer who happened to be nearby, the film reconstructs the attacks while exploring the communities they were intended to terrorise — and the resilience of those who survived.

items.title: Alaska
items.overview: Join us for glacier camping and skiing big lines in remote Alaska.

items.title: Small People, Big Adventures - Currents of Curiosity
items.overview: Renowned explorer Leo Houlding embarks on a remarkable family expedition to the Calvados Island chain - one of the most remote inhabited regions on Earth, located 300km off the coast of Papua New Guinea. Here, money is meaningless and life is sustained through subsistence living, deep connection to nature and community exchange.

items.title: El capo
items.overview: A cartel boss escapes from prison to steal an identity, which he uses to rise in Mexican politics.

items.title: Axes and Orchids
items.overview: In a limestone quarry near Matlock, two worlds meet - the sharp clang of ice tools on rock, and the delicate bloom of wild orchids clinging to the same walls. A beautiful outdoor sport climbing, dry tooling and caving venue run by climbers, for climbers - isn't that the dream? ⁠When father and son team Nick and Sam Lister discovered that Masson Lees Quarry above Matlock in Derbyshire was up for sale, they decided to make that dream a reality.⁠

items.title: Under adjustment. We’re very sorry. Please wait!
items.overview: Sumida City, March 8, 2026.

items.title: bone apple tooth

items.title: The Darkest Ocean
items.overview: Feature length documentary about Tom Waddington’s epic 2000 mile solo row across the North Atlantic. Journey with Tom as he aims to row himself from St John’s, Newfoundland, Canada to Penzance in the UK. Though wind, rain and big seas, battling the currents, tides and himself at times, Tom’s journey is far from a straight line.

items.title: Chulita
items.overview: In 1994, Lucía tries to protect her cousin from the grief of knowing they are about to lose someone.

items.title: Tȟáčȟa Škaŋ: Deer Movement
items.overview: After a racially charged and traumatic audition, an Indigenous dancer spirals into a supernatural transformation in her NYC apartment.

items.title: Roots of a Cedar Tree
items.overview: Three generations of a Tlingit family struggle with identity, trauma, and strained relationships until a journey to find a missing child offers hope for healing and cultural reconnection, bridging the divide between past and present.

items.title: Sarah et les gargouillis du coeur
items.overview: In a gift-wrapping factory, one of the employees, Sarah, has a crush on her coworker, Elli. When a giant plant grows in the break room and the universe goes haywire, Sarah takes the plunge and does everything she can to win Elli over.

items.title: Niqipiaq: To Eat Real Food
items.overview: Explore the importance of traditional subsistence practices, food sovereignty, and the preservation of Indigenous foodways in Arctic Alaska Native communities.

items.title: Legends of Evergreen Hills: The Time Engine
items.overview: When a spark-armored scavenger leader steals the blueprints and a key component for a powerful world-hopping machine known as the Time Engine, the Timekeeper and his apprentice, Zach, must race to stop him. Facing a strict Christmas deadline to prove his abilities—or be forced to leave Evergreen Hills forever—Zach teams up with Sam and his friends to uncover the truth behind the Tensium Temporus and protect their world before time runs out.

items.title: Kulpash
items.overview: Set in the Kazakh steppe during the famine of the early 20th century, the film follows Kulpash, a poor woman struggling to survive alongside her husband and young son. Hunger, cold, and poverty tear their lives apart, while her husband, unable to provide for his family, loses all hope and his sense of purpose. Desperate to save her husband and son from starvation, Kulpash makes a painful and desperate choice: she leaves to live with a wealthy old man, secretly bringing food back to the people she loves more than life itself.

items.title: Can You Find Any Color in this Picture?
items.overview: Told through a first-person perspective and gamified elements, the film follows someone whose world suddenly turns monochrome amid a sweltering, polluted metropolis dominated by concrete, prompting him to search for the colors that might restore his peace of mind.

items.title: Sound of Snow
items.overview: Guided by the resonant sound of singing bowls, we enter the inner world of professional freeskier Arianna Tricomi and find a place where snow transforms into a sanctuary and home.

items.title: Firza The Rabbit
items.overview: Instead of finding a job in the city, Firza the Rabbit falls victim to a form of exploitation he never wanted.

items.title: The Burden
items.overview: Follows trail runners as they take on a 42.1km trail run across the West Pennine Moors, carrying a 20kg sandbag between them — a physical representation of the weight of poor mental health, and the importance of sharing it. The film explores grief, male mental health, community and what can happen when people are willing to carry some of the weight for each other.

items.title: KHAO Anarchie 2026
items.overview: Featuring the very best of French independent wrestling, Anarchie promises hard-hitting action, unforgettable encounters, and intense confrontations. With rivalries reaching their boiling point and everything on the line, the wrestlers step into the ring to settle their scores. Every wrestler has something to prove, every match has a story, and anything can happen when the rules of order give way to chaos. And the card : 1.KHAO Championship Match : Lashka (c) vs Leedz Lewis. 2. Singles Match : TLB vs TLB. 3.  Anarchy Match : Kuro vs SMS vs Zackaria vs MBM vs Lio Jayce vs Jadon Carter. 4. 3-Way match : Cory Zero vs Rhio vs JGU. 5. Singles Match : El Maestro vs Griff. 6. Singles Match : Agathe vs Ophelie. 7. Trios championship 3-way tornado : La Dictature vs Idolatry vs Balkan Brothers.

items.title: Ahora sobran las cucharas
items.overview: A mother delves into memories with her daughter to cope with the loneliness brought on by her sudden disappearance.

items.title: The Impossible Journey
items.overview: In 2013 Danish adventurer, Thor Pedersen, left his loved ones behind and set off in an attempt to become the first person to visit every country in the world without flying. He wanted adventure, a title, and to show that the world is a much better place than is portrayed in the news. He got an experience that tested every layer of him as a human being.

items.title: Saltwater Breath
items.overview: A poetic, experimental documentary set along the Cornish coast, where a collective of women gather at the edge of the Atlantic to rehearse an unlikely act, a synchronized swim in cold open water.

items.title: searching for sara
items.overview: As voices and images move across deserts, mountains, and sea, searching for sara becomes a reflection on the gravitations we carry, are bound to, and remember within us.

items.title: The Sea Crimson Like Fire And The Glorious Sunsets
items.overview: “Inspired by the final chapter of Ulysses ‘Penelope’, I made this film to try to recreate how it feels like to prepare to go to sleep, the two or so minutes one can remember in bed from the night before.”

items.title: En este día tampoco se encontró nada
Little Humans Living In The Walls
items.overview: The Littles are back!

items.title: Cry Me a River So I Come Back
items.overview: Based on true events. A director (Mahdi Rakhsha) goes missing during the filming of his project titled "Sunday".

items.title: Jamás Será Vencido
items.overview: A documentary covering the Hall County community’s response to a proposed data center project and a planned ICE detention facility. Filmed over the course of a year while doing video for The Rainbow Collective, the film follows the group and its chairman Matéo Penado as they lead the opposition to the developments.

items.title: Nobody Notices When a Rat Goes Missing
items.overview: From Rat Cults, to society's social decline and internal war, follow the rabbit hole of a documentary that is "NOBODY NOTICES WHEN A RAT GOES MISSING," to start a new conversation about humanity.

items.title: Blink and You'll Miss It
items.overview: A extraterrestrial-obsessed girl tries to convince her skeptical, tea-obsessed friend that a UFO is outside her window.

items.title: Your Little Kaiju
items.overview: A little green lizard named Ollie wishes to become a Kaiju like the giant lizard monsters he sees at the cinema.

items.title: After the Silence
items.overview: Living on the edge of the Amazon, Maria’s life has always been tied to the forest. It was her playground as a child, later it became a resource she cut down to grow coca as Colombia fell into conflict. Now, she is helping bring the forest back to life. This intimate portrait of an ex-coca farmer offers a nuanced look at why people deforest, and how they can return to nature. The film follows Maria as she works with scientists using sound to explore how the landscape has recovered after the silence left by conflict and destruction. Through immersive sound design, we hear this transformation ourselves, carried into the forests and grasslands of Guaviare by the returning bird songs and the sounds of life renewed.

items.title: Etincelo & Graviflux
items.overview: Meeting up after their breakup, Etincelo and Graviflux try to have a talk. But their incapacity to communicate transports them into another world. There, lost in time and space, between rocks and plants, they sink back into their toxic habits. But this expedition could also help them to accept one another besides the loss.

items.title: Horše Hiyis
items.overview: Horše Hiyis is a short film about intergenerational relationships to fire and to each other that are nurtured on rematriated land.

items.title: Our Lady, Star of the Sea
items.overview: In the threshold between the digital and the holy, Star tries to find the words to comprehend her reflection in the mirror.

items.title: Booth For Two
items.overview: To save their dying relationship, Charlie sets up restaurant booths in his garage to recreate his first date with Rooney at a now-closed diner.

items.title: The Sebastian Files 4
items.overview: When Little Troy Z is kidnapped, Troy must work together with Breadman, The Ice Cream Man, Dick Trout and TG Boston to bring him back.

items.title: The first stone
items.overview: During an excursion at the mountains of Huesca, a boy comes to realize the significance of the videos that his father is filming. He then decides to become part of them in a special way.

items.title: A Dull Knife
items.overview: What was meant to be a normal day for Claire and Morgan turns dark. But burnout is something anyone can fall victim to, even killers...

items.title: Shadowsur
items.overview: An experimental short film

items.title: Xover
items.overview: Xover (third and final part of  ‘Senukai trilogy’) is an abbreviation of crossover, a term referring to the merging of two or more fictional universes. As a format, fanfiction offers a space where vivid, conflicting, and ambiguous emotions can be fully expressed without concern for their alignment with ‘real’ reality – if such a thing exists at all.

items.title: O homem no pelourinho
items.overview: In 1978, Franco Basaglia, the Italian psychiatrist who had recently brought about the closure of psychiatric institutions in Italy through Law 180, traveled across Brazil giving lectures and taking questions from students.

items.title: Sleep work
items.overview: Sleep Work stems from the observation of a practice that emerged during the pandemic: sleep streaming. It involves people filming themselves in their bedrooms while they sleep and live-streaming the footage to a multitude of anonymous viewers. What would once have been considered content devoid of activity becomes a form of online presence capable of generating attention and income.

items.title: The Convoluted Ridding of the Innocent Bum in the Sandpit and the Disaster that Follows
items.overview: During the 50th Anniversary staff party for D. Diamond industries, 5 co workers must figure out a plan to remove an old bum who they realise has been working in their building unemployed, before CEO Dia Diamond arrives to the party and FIRES THEM ALL.

items.title: We Belong
items.overview: Featuring On para athlete Zach Friedley and 2x paralympian Dani Aravich, this film tracks the rise of para-athletes in the mountains as trail running races update their policies. The story focuses on Jahir, an Ecuadorian runner born with one leg, as he targets the UTMB OCC race. Through his eyes and with insights from UTMB race organizer, we witness the evolution of trail running and the vital importance of representation on the course.

items.title: Epiphany
items.overview: After a dark, life-altering night, a teenager wakes up believing it was all a nightmare—only to discover that reality isn't what he left behind.

items.title: OnlyFans Managers, les nouveaux agents du X
ROSAURA A LAS DIEZ (corto completo)
items.overview: This video is a short film adaptation of the acclaimed 1955 crime novel Rosaura a las diez by Argentine writer Marco Denevi.  Overview of the narrative:  The Protagonist: The story revolves around Camilo Canegato, a man who arrives at a boarding house and eventually finds himself embroiled in a complex mystery involving a woman named Rosaura.  The Plot: Following his marriage to Rosaura, a tragic event occurs at a hotel on their wedding night, leading to an investigation.  The Investigation: Detective David Regel investigates the murder, suspecting Camilo of the crime .  The Climax: The film explores themes of memory, reality, and deception, culminating in a reveal that the truth behind the events—and whether Rosaura actually died—remains shrouded in mystery .  The short film uses stylistic elements, including a "ping pong" interview style interrogation, to piece together the events surrounding the case. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gm3oYy1a7mM&t=18s

items.title: Double Booked for the Holidays
items.overview: Identical twins Abigail and Charlie spend their first Christmas without their mother running a bookshop in Wales, where mistaken identities lead to unexpected romance and festive mix-ups.

items.title: La Malavita - Cortometraje
items.overview: On the streets of Santiago, Chile, two hitmen find themselves caught in a job that doesn't go as planned. What seemed like just another assignment quickly turns into a problem that will test their nerves, their loyalty, and their ability to keep things under control.  In this business, one mistake can cost everything.

items.title: Fallen From Olympus
items.overview: Following the Trojan War, a soldier facing death encounters Thanatos and is drawn into a mythological confrontation about life, fate, and the meaninglessness of war.

items.title: Calls of Desire
items.overview: Wireless signals, like a digital fog, blanket the concrete jungle. Each phone connects a sleepless, loveless soul. In this chain of late-night calls, relationships and conflicts twist and spread, linking people by their desires and ultimately separating them by the same force. Perhaps some relations are never meant to last, only to touch us, once, like morning light.

items.title: Love Loaded
items.overview: In 1958 Los Angeles, Love Loaded follows Club Figaro singer Didi Scanlon as her lost love April Davis returns to awaken old passions and secrets. The night April returns someone takes a shot at husband Jack Scanlon as our mystery unfolds.

items.title: M.I.N.D
items.overview: A surreal, abstract and colorful journey into the human mind.

items.title: Nothing arrives, Nothing departs
items.overview: In a train station forgotten by the world, a bizarre meeting takes place.

items.title: Nice to Meet You, Amigo
items.overview: TTFC-exclusive movie of Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity that takes place in a parallel universe, featuring the main cast in different roles: a mysterious alien named Amigo appears before an elementary school student named Taiyo! Amigo, who came to Earth for a certain investigation, asks Taiyo for his cooperation, but Taiyo is completely bewildered by the strange request. Amigo says "On my planet, it's so much easier to become friends", and Taiyo gets dragged into the situation. Will friendship blossom between the boy and the alien?

items.title: Neska bat desagertu da
items.overview: People, objects, and places have changed the way they relate—or at least, that’s how Oihana perceives it. Now the emptiness takes up space. A path, a window, a bed, a wardrobe, a mirror. With these, and what fits into a hiking backpack, she has all she needs to reset her coordinates and rest.

items.title: LVX
items.overview: In times of the Belle Époque. Amidst a thriving society a young woman no longer recognizes herself. She has lost her inner light. In her desperation, the woman seeks out a peculiar place where someone has supposedly developed a new method for treating such deep inner darkness.

items.title: Operation Playground: Zero
items.overview: After the death of his mother, Ricky, a twelve-year-old non-verbal boy, is left to care for his infant sister on his own while struggling to survive in a collapsing Western Europe overrun by the living dead

items.title: Zombie Bloodlines
items.overview: The dead shall inherit the Earth in this trilogy of twisted tales that will strip the flesh from your bones and put you in an early grave. In "Unborn on the Bayou", the heir to a Louisiana plantation uncovers his father's macabre legacy of debauchery and Voodoo magic in a local bordello of bird-worshipping beauties. Then, in "Ghouls Night Out", the dead walk among us, and just as in life, they return to the places they love. In this case, it's the local nude bar. Finally, in "Family Plot", the world recovers from a zombie plague, and a hunt for the Mortense family fortune digs up more than buried treasure.

items.title: Cairo Shadows
items.overview: Cairo, 2009. Salem, 25, is a Copt working as a pig farmer in the rag-pickers district of Manshyet Nasser. When the swine flu virus appears abroad, psychosis takes hold of Egypt and puts Salem and his community to the test.

items.title: Oly's Dean
items.overview: Set along British Columbia’s remote Dean River, the film follows 9-year-old Oly Hickman as he moves through his family’s fishing lodge in the heart of steelhead country.

items.title: American Theater
items.overview: A “canceled” theater director summons a troupe of conservative actors to an abandoned cabin in rural Georgia to plot revenge on the Atlanta theater community with a musical retelling of the 1692 Salem witch trials.

items.title: Not Only Dogs Lick
items.overview: In a quiet house, Leonor spends her days in near-constant solitude, while her mother, Diana, works tirelessly around the clock to support them. One night, after a terrifying experience in her room, Diana tries to comfort her by giving her a puppy, hoping its companionship will help her sleep peacefully. At first, the dog becomes her refuge and inseparable companion. But when the shadows begin to move again and the strange noises return, Leonor will discover that not everything that licks her hand in the dark is her pet.

items.title: This Land
items.overview: Laura Orson, a disabled elderly woman, has nightmares of a startling creature that begin to haunt her daily life. As she grapples with her guilt over her deceased father, the creature closes in until she has no choice but to ask for help.

items.title: Kill the Robot to Escape
items.overview: Five strangers are trapped in a room with a deadly artificial intelligence and must find a way to destroy it in order to escape.

items.title: Heretical Girls
items.overview: A montage of unconnected scenes and vignettes showcasing all kinds of folk depravity and foul ecstasy.

items.title: A Song from Beyond
items.overview: One day, when photographer Momoko is eating lunch at a cafe, a university student studying film production asks her to appear in their graduation film. On the day of the shoot, the man cast to play her father turns out to be her real father, who she hasn't seen for years.

items.title: Turtle Island Rap
items.overview: Follows three aspiring Indigenous hip-hop artists on their challenging journey to success.

items.title: Guretako eztia
items.overview: Through a series of encounters between a researcher, a beekeeper, and a group of children, the film explores the intertwined relationships between bees, beeswax, and mourning in the Basque Country.

items.title: A Country Christmas Wish
items.overview: Milly's life is in shambles - she loses her job and her boyfriend all in one day. And if she can't come up with £96,000 pounds in 6 weeks, she'll also lose her lovely London home to her cheating ex. Lucky for her, an idle wish over a carved wooden elf changes everything. With a little Christmas magic, Milly is amazed to discover she is the sole beneficiary of her old neighbour's will. She has inherited a farm in the countryside. But to her dismay, all is not as rosy as it seems. The farm is falling apart and city girl Milly is out of her depth. But she refuses to give up and that determination earns her the respect of the locals, including a handsome horse trainer, Jack. Milly battles bad weather, the chaos of the farm and dodgy developers in an attempt to save the farm and get her flat back. And maybe, just maybe, find a little love along the way.

items.title: Rota de Fuga
items.overview: In a neighbourhood doomed to disappear following decades of mineral extraction, Sal resists leaving the home he shares with his father, Durval—who has been diagnosed with advanced Alzheimer’s. As residents are forced to abandon their homes and local businesses shut down, he watches the memories that sustain him crumble along with the place where he grew up.

items.title: claire's debut
items.overview: On her 18th birthday, Claire is pulled between two distinct worlds: a vibrant garden party with her family and friends and a quiet, vulnerable sanctuary shared only with her partner contrasting a public celebration with an intimate space to prove that love deserves to be accepted, nurtured, and unapologetically radiant in any and every space.

items.title: Revolution for Beginners
items.overview: Romania, 1989. December 21st, the day the anti-communist revolution fully erupted. Everything is turned upside down. In a provincial town, "neither big nor small, neither nice nor ugly" - as the ever-present narrator describes it, a small, motley group of people tries to seize power "in the name of the people.”

items.title: Boy Creek
items.overview: The true story of what happened in the dastardly summer of 88 in Eden Heights USA. The boys of boy creek finally come out and tell what really happened all those summers ago.

items.title: Encounters with Lupin
items.overview: Scenes from the life of a pickpocket in Sofia.

items.title: Para kay Santa,
items.overview: Growing up, Niko believes that being good will earn him the one thing he longs for most. Every Christmas, he turns to Santa Claus with the same wish, holding on to the hope that one day, it will finally come true.

items.title: The Christmas Rewrite
items.overview: Elle is guided by the magical Mary Clause and a mischievous helper named Rudy, Ellie learns she is trapped inside her own story and can only return home if she finds true love before midnight on Christmas Day.

items.title: Rain...
items.overview: A beautiful abandoned old building in Melbourne gets wet from the rain.

items.title: Golden Rivals: Canada vs USA
items.overview: When it comes to men's ice hockey supremacy, for nearly a century the story of USA vs Canada has been told under the Olympic rings. And at the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympic Games, that rivalry continued as NHL players returned to the Games for the first time in 12 years. Go behind the scenes with both Team USA and Team Canada as the USA won its first gold medal since 1980.

items.title: Forgotten Founder: The Untold Story of Samson Occom and Dartmouth
items.overview: Despite his central role in the founding of Dartmouth College, Samson Occom, a Mohegan minister, educator and Indigenous intellectual, was erased from the historical record along with the promises made to Native communities.

items.title: Make it More Human
items.overview: Alex, a man obsessed with the 'potential' of artificial intelligence faces his biggest challenge yet: replying to an email.

items.title: Die Kunst, Olli Dittrich zu sein
Le Sabot Montagnard
items.overview: In 2024, Ashley Parsons and Quentin Boëhm set themselves the mission of bringing their three Kyrgyz horses back home to the French Alps. From Poland to France, they travel 3000km on horseback through the mountains of Europe.

items.title: In Kimolos
items.overview: 4 people of different generations who either live or went on vacation to the greek island Kimolos narrate a brief reminiscence of their summer childhood years, describing what the island was like before the years of mass tourism.

items.title: FOOSED
items.overview: Johnny Johnson wants to be a foosball legend, like his dad. There’s just one problem- he’s really, REALLY bad at foosball. Also, his mother wants him to continue working at her diner instead of playing a silly game. So when Johnny runs into his dad’s former coach, he is determined to train in secret in order to play in the upcoming tournament - because when you foose, you never lose. Inspired by the 2022 unfinished MG&J Studios short film of the same name, FOOSED has everything you want in an underdog story - and more!

items.title: Tennessee Ride Along
items.overview: When a ride-along puts Hollywood actress Sadie Paige and Nashville detective Corey Gable in the path of a dangerous Tennessee crime family, this unlikely duo finds themselves in over their heads. Captured and trapped together with nothing in common but matching handcuffs, Sadie and Corey must learn to trust each other to survive.

items.title: Mother, There’s a Star in Me
items.overview: This 65 min documentary feature an all-female drumming troop, Medha, from Siem Reap, Cambodia who symbolizes resilience and empowerment. Through powerful performances and intimate glimpses into their daily lives, the film sheds light on their courage to pursue their passion for the arts while navigating societal challenges, advocating for women’s rights, and raising their children as single mothers. This documentary not only celebrates the strength of remarkable women but also highlights the transformative power of music, exploring its deep, hereditary roots.

items.title: The holoRazutis of Saturna
items.overview: This film features an unusual encounter with Al Razutis, a multimedia artist, author, historian, educator and archivist. He welcomes us to Saturna Island, literally inviting us to experience Visual Alchemy, a mysterious place home to a unique collection of holograms. A truly psychedelic journey occasionally accompanied by well-chosen New Age music, this work unfolds as a cohesive exploration enriched by anaglyph technology and glitch effects. By freely expanding the possibilities of an image projected onto a 2D surface, this captivating cinematic poem examines and embodies a reflection on the creation and reception of images, the perception of reality and the experience of time and space

items.title: Escape the Indoors: A 5pm-9am Cargo Bike Adventure
items.overview: School's out and the cargo bike is loaded. One night, one tent, one bag of marshmallows. World-class cyclist Tracy Moseley and family swap four walls for moonlight, time outside, s'mores by the campfire and a spot of rain.

items.title: Old Ladies Against Underwater Garbage
items.overview: Follow Susan Baur, the 85-year-old leader, and her crew of fearless women as they defy limits, protect the environment, and rediscover wonder and joy through water and community.

items.title: In the Sweet Arms
items.overview: When night falls, director Julian Flavin hosts a radio show, pondering the meaning and scope, both latent and overt, of music. Guided by an enthralling voice and a camera that captures time suspended in the city at night, In The Sweet Arms shows music in its most unusual forms: a choir singing to those on their deathbeds, a U.S. Army rock group rehearsal, a superstar moved by the crowd during a concert, a teenager setting Call of Duty clips to music, an AI-generated song mimicking the band that the filmmaker once belonged to. These encounters probe the ideological, social and political dimensions of music and what it reveals about how we see the world.

items.title: Kindred Roots
items.overview: Kindred Roots (La Sangre Llama) follows the journey of Zapotec migrants from a small town in San Bartolomé Zoogocho, Oaxaca, Mexico. With a collective dream to improve and modernize their hometown, they assembled a community in a land far from home. In their efforts to realize this goal, they established the hometown association within the Union Social Zoogochense (USZ), which connected their cultural roots through community and replicated a sense of belonging in Los Angeles.

items.title: AEW Full Gear 2026 : The Buy-In
items.overview: 2026 edition of AEW Full Gear.

items.title: Soy Boy: The Soyfather
items.overview: An absurdist neo-noir comedy about two rival Soy Sauce distributors. Using student politics, manipulation and violence to get their revenge.

items.title: Kill You!
items.overview: Tim is an ordinary student who enjoys spending his free time playing video games. When his mother tells him that she won't be home in the mornings for the next two weeks, Tim sees an opportunity to immerse himself even further in his virtual world, unaware of the consequences his decision might bring.

items.title: Deadline
items.overview: Mitchell Wallace is tasked with a project that's only due in a few days. Unfortunately for him, things aren't going as planned.

items.title: Shrimp Movie
items.overview: ilchay interviews Millionaire Shrimp to ask about the way to success in life.

items.title: Closer and Closer
items.overview: A Short Experimental Film.

items.title: Undercurrents
items.overview: Nazaré is the most intense and unpredictable surfing arena on earth. Undercurrents follows 16-year-old Brit Imari Hearn as she joins forces with big wave charger Laura Crane to face down the Portuguese behemoth for the very first time. More than just a surfing spectacle, it’s an intimate exploration of mentorship, resilience, and the bond forged between two women taking on a formidable lineup and a male-dominated industry together.

items.title: บรรยากาศฝนตก
Lotería
items.overview: East Side High seniors discover a haunted Lotería deck where every card they’re dealt exposes who they truly are and the horrifying way they’ll die.

items.title: Tahira
items.overview: After surviving an abusive past, Yorkshire mother Tahira discovers strength through trail running. Supported by a running community, she rebuilds her confidence and begins helping others find healing and freedom in the outdoors.

items.title: Ear of Missing Out
items.overview: The ear of FOMO-driven twenty-something Joyce has had enough. Overstimulated by noise, crowds, and relentless haste, it decides to break free from Joyce and sets off in search of a new owner, someone who values silence, pays attention, and truly listens. But does such a person still exist in this noisy, FOMO-driven world?

items.title: Twin Flames Part 4 : The Finale
items.overview: Discover the final piece of this captivating tale of Naina and Aman in this mesmerizing short film about twin flames. As fate intertwines their paths, they soon realize that their encounter was no mere coincidence. Unveiling the profound connection between their souls, this heartwarming story will leave you believing in the power of destiny. Join Naina and Aman on their extraordinary journey towards discovering their twin flame, and prepare to be moved by the magic of true love

items.title: Acibar
items.overview: A girl who constantly suffers abuse. As the story unfolds, she begins to realize that she has murdered people—and that she is, in fact, a cannibal. Following a traumatic event, she maspakes a decision that will bring an end to her cycle of torment.

items.title: After Taiwan Daily News - The Obscured Path (in progress)
The Land Still Speaks
items.overview: This short documentary highlights the voices of Indigenous peoples in Marin county, California and their relationships with land, language, and cultural preservation.

items.title: Surf. Eat. Repeat
items.overview: Take a mouthwatering local adventure around New York City’s surf and ethnic food scene through a diverse crew of women who share waves, meals and personal narratives that express the rich flavor of NYC's surf community and diverse immigrant heritage... reflecting just how yummy it is. The film presents a rare view of New York City where the concrete jungle/city of dreams intersects with the vast richness of nature at its doorstep. The film also blasts the status quo representation of surf culture.

items.title: Slowly Through the Red Mountains
items.overview: What happens when we slow down and let the landscape set the pace? The film follows a six-day journey through the Cairngorms National Park. Two humans, two dogs and one pony, travelling through ancient Caledonian pine forests, across wild rivers and beneath the vast mountains of the Scottish Highlands. Moving slowly, carrying what they need and allowing the landscape and animals to dictate the journey.

items.title: No Trees, No Seas
items.overview: A people-led climate documentary rooted in Cornwall, where stories, science and surfing come together to reveal how restoring the connections between land, sea and community could change everything.

items.title: Nio Ko Bokk (This Belongs to All of Us)
items.overview: Pape and Seydi are two young men who find purpose and community in the ocean, choosing a different path than the perilous journeys many peers take in search of opportunity abroad. Through their story, the film explores how belonging at home can be as powerful as the promise of elsewhere.

items.title: Kirsten Van Horne - Rising Tide
items.overview: From a shy, small-town kid to competing on the biggest stage in freeride mountain biking, Kristen’s journey shows what can happen when you give yourself permission to try.

items.title: Love that Remains
items.overview: After the sudden death of her husband, Serena seeks out the man who received his donated heart. As an unexpected intimacy grows between them, she’s soon forced to confront the truth about her grief and whether she can let go of the past.

items.title: Cold Plunge
items.overview: After her best friend moves away, Edith confronts her loneliness by embarking on a sensory pilgrimage through Manhattan.

items.title: 650 Lawrence Ave
items.overview: In the midst of her transfer to a nursing home, Alzheimer's patient Emel disappears. Her caregiver, Nimet's search for her reveals that the "home" Emel longs for is as lost as Emel and her fading memories.

items.title: Masquerade
items.overview: Trouble ensues when a filmmaker and an actor rush to complete reshoots of their upcoming film.

items.title: The Closure
items.overview: When fate brings two former lovers back together years after their breakup, one last walk through Cardiff becomes a tender meditation on love, timing, and the quiet courage it takes to let someone become a beautiful memory.

items.title: Vladimír Valenta – The Edmonton Connection
items.overview: Acclaimed Edmonton filmmaker Tom Radford met Vladimír Valenta, a star of the Academy Award-winning film Closely Watched Trains, shortly after Valenta fled to Edmonton following the Soviet invasion of Czechoslovakia in 1968. Radford’s documentary explores Valenta’s artistic and political struggles under communist rule, drawing compelling parallels with issues facing Alberta and Canada today.

items.title: Guihua
items.overview: “Guihua” is the story of an AMAB drag queen who grew up in a conservative city in central China. His education allows him to move to Shanghai and become a drag star, but when his parents order him to enlist in the army, he must choose between obedience and self-discovery.

items.title: Son of Killa Gorilla
items.overview: Killa Gorilla has now canonically had sex.

items.title: Face to Face
items.overview: Alpiniste Benjamin Védrines turns inward, confronting doubt, fear and the pursuit of meaning beyond records and recognition. His challenge: a solo winter ascent of the legendary Dru face in the Mont Blanc massif.

items.title: Concrete Nature
items.overview: Fay Ebert is currently Canada's youngest Olympic athlete. Before that, she was a student at Impact Skateboard Club, led by Yash Presswalla. Through their ever-growing relationship, we see how the culture has evolved throughout the years, and how Impact is able to teach more than just skateboarding.

items.title: My Dear Ex
items.overview: Moving on is one thing, but becoming part of your Ex family is a whole different story.

items.title: DEADWEIGHT
items.overview: After days of agonizing insomnia, a desperate young man named Jet calls his friend Ricky, who tells him to take melatonin so he can get some rest. Jet takes the supplement and falls into a deep sleep, only to wake up moments after to a terrifying realization: something sinister has taken control of his left hand, and it has a violent mind of its own.

items.title: 劇場版 アイドルマスター SideM F＠NTASTIC BATTLE FES ～Who goes first～
ラブル＆クルー IN シアター 2026
items.overview: Rubble, the construction pup from PAW Patrol, takes center stage in this special theatrical event, the second in the series. It presents episodes of the spin-off series Rubble & Crew never before shown on TV or streaming in Japan — "Chase and the Rubble Crew Police!", "The Christmas Ice Dance Show" and "Search for the Rainbow Treasure!" — along with interactive audience-participation segments such as a quiz, rock-paper-scissors and a PAW Patrol dance. Designed as a first cinema experience for young children, the house lights stay brighter and the volume lower, and talking or stepping out during the screening is perfectly fine.

items.title: Wonderland
items.overview: A young model’s lethal curiosity and allure to fame leads her to Wonderland — a dream chaser’s purgatory, where party favors and the VIP night life circuit rot the nameless and hopeful from the inside out.

items.title: Seen
items.overview: Calgary rock band born from injury, insecurity, and fear of being seen. After a career-altering injury and years of rejection within classical music institutions, a shy musician found freedom in hiding behind a mask. What began as a solo project fuelled by fear of being perceived slowly evolved into SHY FRiEND, a band that embraces imperfections. Through intimate rehearsal moments, stylized live performances, and honest reflection, this documentary reflects SHY FRiEND's transformation from shyness into spectacle, showing that sometimes the mask is what allows the truth to be told.

items.title: Tree of Life
items.overview: The Tree of Life is a poetic experimental short film that explores the relationship between memory, existence, and time. Narrated by a spectral voice drifting through the misty landscapes of a swamp, the film blends voice-over, rhythmic music, and cinematic imagery of nature to visualize inner emotions and transformation.  Through its reflective storytelling, the film blurs the boundaries between past, present, and future while contemplating human transience and our connection to the natural world.

items.title: Monitor
items.overview: A young actress prepares for a scene and realises nothing is as it seems.

items.title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
items.overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

items.title: Clashing Through the Snow
items.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

items.title: Axolodyssey
items.overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.

items.title: Enzo: The Mafias Boxer
items.overview: Enzo Provino (Played by Alex Javo) is an up-and-coming boxer who is instructed by the local mafia boss Bruno Rossi (Eric Roberts) and his consigliere Giorgio Cantini (Frank Stallone) to throw a very crucial boxing match. He is rewarded for his loyalty and is given an offer, he cannot refuse. A chance to become a made member of the family with a shot at the title. As he grows and climbs the ladder of the ranks, Enzo begins to unfold secrets linking his family to the original mafia from Sicily.

items.title: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing
items.overview: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.

items.title: Mustang
items.overview: At the age of twenty, Sophie Taricone sets out to tell a story that began before she was born. Through archival footage shot by her parents, Kasia Smutniak and Pietro Taricone, she retraces their 2003 journey to Mustang—a remote Himalayan kingdom known as "the last Tibet"—and she follows Kasia’s return there after Pietro’s death. Spanning more than two decades, the film weaves together past and present as Kasia forges a lasting bond with a local community in Mustang and helps to establish a school dedicated to preserving its culture. Through Sophie’s journey, the film explores memory, identity, and the fragile balance between Western progress and an ancient, spiritual way of life.

items.title: Waves of Silence
items.overview: Hassan struggles to make a living as a fisherman in a small coastal town, where the sea provides less each year. Isolated by his faith, his only moments of tenderness are with single mother Latifah and her young daughter. When an old friend offers a dangerous alternative, Hassan becomes trapped between judgement and action.

items.title: Whackers
items.overview: Thad, an unarmed grocery store security guard, becomes a tyrant obsessed with absolute authority to the dismay of Rose, a regular customer and Thad’s only ally. Meanwhile, separated father Wally becomes engrossed in a fringe conspiracy theory and begins a legal battle to regain his freedom and custody of his children. As both men descend into increasingly dangerous behavior, a slow night at work becomes a battleground for life, liberty, and the pursuit of power.

items.title: I'm Right Over Here, Why Can't You See Me?
items.overview: In November 2024, a teenage girl vanished from her home in broad daylight. It was her sixteenth birthday.

items.title: Kingdom of Dust
items.overview: When three disillusioned friends stumble upon a religious commune, one of them embarks on a mission to discover the truth about the group's mysterious leader before it is too late...

items.title: Pure Elegance Tour: Live at History
items.overview: In this live concert film, Ninja Sex Party brings you the most tasteful and opulent experience known to humankind, a show full of genteel music addressing some of life's deepest mysteries: What does it feel like to own a car? To take a date to your parents' house? Or to board a spaceship to save a sexless future? Watch, and the answers shall reveal themselves to you forthwith!

items.title: Chișinău, My Love
items.overview: An elite thief. A legendary piano. A talented pianist. And a heist that was supposed to leave no trace. But love changes the rules of the game. As danger draws near, the plan begins to unravel—and a single choice could change destinies forever.

items.title: A Killer Job
items.overview: Jayden is a serial killer living a double life as a office worker when all of a sudden a new guy joins and Jayden starts to feel threatened

items.title: Soulala
items.overview: follows a man who returns to a family farm inherited from his parents, only to uncover a terrifying truth that threatens his survival there. The film explores how family bonds between parents and children can become a source of both salvation and control.

items.title: The Secret Service Revisited
items.overview: TV historian Matthew Sweet goes in search of the people, places and puppets that brought The Secret Service to life.

items.title: Brown Bread
items.overview: After years in New York, Áine returns to rural Ireland for her godmother’s memorial, confronting buried family tensions and unexpressed grief in her childhood home.

items.title: Holy Wood Dust
items.overview: Every winter, millions of fir trees are chopped down, admired, and thrown away. The film follows their journey above and below ground, from human rituals to the hidden life inside the trees. A story about trees that we celebrate by cutting them down.

items.title: Revenge of Her : Evil Prevails
items.overview: A dark psychological thriller revolving around a mysterious killer, a series of unsettling events, and a story of revenge.

items.title: Jingle Hell
items.overview: A group of strangers coming from different countries accepts a very exciting invite for Christmas. As they arrive at the location, they soon discover what are the real plans of the mastermind behind the whole thing.

items.title: SNCF : Les secrets d'une logistique XXL
Sinahal, The Mayan Midwives
items.overview: Portrait of Mayan midwives who do ultrasounds with their hands, those who respect the nature of the living and that contrast with the modern world.

items.title: Bitartean, gero
items.overview: In the future, emotions and gestures have disappeared. But we are in the present: five researchers arrive on electric scooters in a village in the Basque Country, searching for what their time has forgotten. Through interviews and observation, they enter the intimacy of its inhabitants, until the boundaries between the different times begin to blur.

items.title: DANCE OF THE LOTUS
items.overview: An original piano composition and short film exploring the different stages of human life through the lifecycle of a lotus flower.

items.title: People, I hope you know the world is ending. – A Film by Noga Erez
items.overview: Living with the notion that life as I knew it was not gonna be the same very soon took me on a deep and dark journey. Everything I do, from the simplest, daily activities, to creating art now exists under that light, or shadow, depending on the day. This body of work, this movie, was intended to be an expression of all of that, but instead, it became the one thing that released me from that loop of terror of uncertainty. There’s meaning in making things together, especially if we create out of love and passion. As long as we let our humanity, with all its flaws, take up space in the world, there is a space for humanity.

items.title: If the Birds Sing
items.overview: We retrace the path that was used by the women who walked up to the penitentiary of Fort San Cristóbal to help political prisoners between 1934 and 1945, as Spain went through Republic, Civil War, and Franco’s dictatorship. We search for their footprints, listen to their voices. The earth remembers.

items.title: Dryads
items.overview: Emil, Joana and Vasco are musicians from the extremes of Europe. In their own way, each looks for inspiration for their next song. They explore the vastness of nature and the depth of their culture to find the essence of their work. Joana dives into the secrets of Mallorca’s caves, Emil delves into the Nordic fjords and Vasco navigates among the ancestral voices of Portugal. Their solitary experiences reveal to us the beauty and mystery behind the creative process of composing music.

items.title: Ruta Norte
items.overview: Ruta Norte follows a group of friends and electronic music enthusiasts who spent their weekends in the 1990s hopping from club to club, in a constant pilgrimage from the mining valleys to Oviedo and Gijón. Three decades later, a new generation of Asturian youth is still hungry to party, looking for ways to throw an impromptu rave amid the ruins of the mines and factories where their grandparents once worked. Ruta Norte chronicles the 15 years Asturias spent dancing—an era many wish they had lived through, yet only a few can truly remember.

items.title: Paganos
items.overview: A hunting initiation rite ends in a dark pact of silence when a stray shot awakens a cursed legacy in the deep, secluded heart of the forest.

items.title: The Other You
items.overview: This film exposes the hidden dangers of dating apps driven by the urgent consumption of sex and entertainment. Behind simple profile pictures often hide pathological narcissists and ambiguous characters. Looking for fleeting encounters, they prey on vulnerable users through flattery and deception.  In this virtual world, emotional connection is entirely absent. Everyone becomes a mere object of desire in a perverse, addictive game of dominance and submission that detaches users from reality. Ultimately, the virtual realm takes over, leading to a profound depersonalization where human beings are completely stripped of their humanity.

items.title: Ice Factory Ghost
items.overview: Khmer movie

items.title: Rebelle
items.overview: In a world where 96% of the population are forced into a state of grueling work and deprived of their humanity, two young girls whose parents have been stolen by the government find each other, fall in love, and journey on a quest to liberate the world.

items.title: Calling Card
items.overview: Two detectives race against time to interrogate a local mechanic, suspicious that he might be a notorious serial killer

items.title: The Last Spy-fi Series
items.overview: Exploring the influence of 1960s spy mania on the latter Supermarionation series, from Thunderbirds to The Secret Service.

items.title: BLACK STAR
items.overview: Wilson trapped in a suffocating labyrinth of solipsism and modern burnout. Over one sleepless night he searches for something with no name, until a black star appears: a repeating light, an immovable loss, bright and black at the same time.

items.title: Beyond the beyond
items.overview: Following the loss of his partner, David wanders the city, heartbroken and lost. By chance, he comes across an occult shop and decides to step inside for a tarot reading. After laying out the cards, the tarot reader hands him a piece of paper containing a set of instructions: perform a ritual and visit the cemetery at nightfall. As David arrives at the cemetery, overwhelmed by despair, he encounters a spectral presence that brings him comfort.

items.title: Itilli Gathering
items.overview: Every summer, brothers Jaco and Lasaloosee Ishulutak return to Itilli, their ancestral land in Nunavut, where the whole family gathers. Guided by the winds and tides, their journey can stretch over several days. There, observation and practice lie at the heart of Inuit ways of learning. The Elders teach the children to fish, sew and hunt caribou, so that they may share this knowledge with those who come after them. Gradually, a different sense of time emerges, shaped by the texture of light, the movement of stars, ripening berries, hands darting toward wriggling fish, and stories passed down from one generation to the next. Rooted in these vital, joyful acts of sharing, Itilli Gathering paints an expansive yet intimate portrait of a community deeply connected to the land.

items.title: Wishrings
items.overview: Depressed over a stalled art career and a painful breakup, Ulisses discovers a plastic toy ring inside a cereal box that magically grants wishes. Convinced he can effortlessly fix his life and win back his ex-girlfriend, he begins altering his reality, clashing with his roommates, Héctor and Miguel, and forcing himself to confront a truth he has been ignoring all along.

items.title: Peegel
items.overview: Lembit Peegel is the true grand old man of Estonian sports photography, having devoted his entire life to a single muse. He has been photographing sport and life consistently since 1959. Lembit’s sports photographs have always been dynamic and full of life. These are the photographs that, from the 1960s onwards, defined what a good sports photograph should be.

items.title: NU Theater Live: The Brothers Karamazov
items.overview: What keeps a person from an evil: morality, fear, or faith? And what happens to the human psyche when they cross that line?

items.title: Ayura
