items.overview: An ayu sweetfish mutates into a giant monster, dubbed Ayura, and attacks the Gifu prefecture of Japan. Kaoru, an unassuming government worker, is suddenly tasked to pilot the giant robot "Meka-U" as an emergency effort to stop Ayura.

items.title: Kaadhangal Dhoore - Miles Apart
items.overview: Bharath and Tara who get a chance to set back their lives, which they once lost, only to find themselves caught between circumstances and the uncertainties of life. The journey makes them realize how time and choices they made change their life within themselves.

items.title: Dustin Nickerson: Is That Your Dad?!
items.overview: Dustin Nickerson takes on the hilarious realities of entering middle age, marriage, and raising teenagers. 41 years of life, 22 years of marriage, and 18 years of parenting, Dustin finds humor in the chaos of family life and the never-ending challenge of keeping up with it all.

items.title: Chad Daniels: Nothing to Fix
items.overview: Chad Daniels seventh stand up special

items.title: Hijos
items.overview: After years of infertility, Rocío takes in a street child as if he were her own son. Her obsession with motherhood triggers a domestic thriller that draws León into a world of marginalized children, secrets, and captivity.

items.title: Hoods
items.overview: Mona lives alone in a working-class neighborhood. A sex worker and private party organizer, she leads a discreet life, far from prying eyes. One evening, on returning home after a night of heavy drinking, she finds a young man—not yet twenty—in a balaclava breaking into her apartment, while other hooded youths wreak havoc in the street outside, destroying and setting fire to everything in their path. Who is this young man? What does he want from her? Confronted by this mysterious intruder, Mona must face the secrets of her past as they suddenly resurface.

items.title: Square One
items.overview: "Square One" follows the tense and emotional journey of two friends, Daniel and Leo, as they confront their strained relationship and past conflicts one fateful night. Daniel accuses Leo of taking advantage of their friendship and refusing to take responsibility for his actions, while Leo feels judged and misunderstood by Daniel's perceived privilege. Ultimately, their confrontation reaches a breaking point when Daniel decides to confront Leo about his behavior, refusing to continue enabling his self-destructive tendencies.Daniel realizes that their friendship may be irreparably damaged, but he also acknowledges his own role in perpetuating their cycle of conflict.

items.title: Machine Shadows
items.overview: Sometimes we let the machine take control of our thinking, our creativity and our horizons, to the point that we forget we are the ones who made it!  And we forgot the most important thing... that we did not create it so our minds would be led to it, but we made it to be a tool that helps us, widens our horizons, and supports our creativity. For the machine was made to serve humans, not for humans to become subordinate to it

items.title: giiwe πρό bizhiw / bizhiw πρό giiwe
items.overview: Made as part of the Winnipeg Film Group's "Super 8 Special" film incubator. This picture was captured on super 8 film, drip dyed with a mixture of india ink and water collected from Lake Winnipeg, then digitized and captured on VHS.

items.title: A Day Dreamer
items.overview: A day dreamer imagines his true love story amidst a comical encounter with the police

items.title: Blandine
items.overview: From the World Championships to the Diagonale des Fous and the UTMB, Blandine L’Hirondel takes us on a journey through the legendary races of ultra-trail running. This lively and sincere portrait explores her daily challenges: balancing her career as a gynecologist with the demands of elite-level competition, overcoming setbacks, and pushing herself to the limit.

items.title: Wilting Flowers
items.overview: After the death of their old college roommate who they haven't spoken to in years, Matt and Milo go to his funeral. Things grow intense as they are expected to give the eulogy.

items.title: Sisigan Kariau: Sima
items.overview: Bayu, a popular novelist, is haunted every night by mysterious cries—a sorrowful sound that keeps calling out to him for no apparent reason. Together with his daughter, Ima, he returns to his village in search of peace, but the sound only grows closer and begins to disrupt their lives. The cries turn into a call that leads Bayu to something that has long been hidden.

items.title: Malamar Gawian
items.overview: Highlights the challenge of finding a job after completing higher education. Amid the competition in the job market, college graduates must also face pressure from their families and communities, who expect them to find work immediately.

items.title: Dead Weight
items.overview: A extra in a zombie film refuses to move.

items.title: Jueves en el Broadway
items.overview: Two filmmakers exchange postcards across three countries to tell the story of the only Spanish victim of enforced disappearance in Venezuela in 1967.

items.title: Killers
items.overview: A detective has less than an hour to get a mass murderer to commit to his crimes before he'll be let free, but little does he know of the psychological nightmare that's about to follow.

items.title: Catch Yourself On
items.overview: As her husband's health declines, Eileen fills her days with errands, routines and constant motion — anything to avoid being still. Small tasks multiply, and time passes without being shared. But avoidance has its limits, and Eileen is running out of road.

items.title: The Model Trap: Exposing Jeffrey Epstein’s Network
Concealer
items.overview: While applying makeup to cover a bruise, a woman begins experiencing a series of strange, unsettling events. As tension builds, she finds herself caught in a growing sense of unease.

items.title: CAT'S OUTTA THE BAG
items.overview: A deal goes wrong, resulting in an epic masterpiece of all proportions

items.title: dia: para soñar (00:21:51 - 00:25:38)
items.overview: Dedicated to León

items.title: dia: a través del espejo oscuro (00:10:29 - 00:21:35)
items.overview: about the reflections of a clara bow postcard

items.title: Rasi: Arah Pulang
items.overview: The film follows the journey of three young men from the coast—Rasi, Baco, and Amin—who find themselves stranded at sea after their boat is caught in a storm.  The situation grows even more dire when their compass, their only guide, sinks. The three must rely on traditional navigation skills, reading the constellations to find their way home.

items.title: One Day On Earth
items.overview: When a hapless little alien crash-lands in the Portuguese countryside, getting home becomes a much bigger adventure than he bargained for — especially with two deeply unimpressed farmers watching his every move. One very strange day on Earth follows.

items.title: In the Event of Possible Delays
items.overview: A truck that turns out to have been improperly loaded becomes a crisis for which Özge is held responsible within the company; as she confronts authority, Özge finds herself trapped in a moral dilemma.

items.title: VIDEO RENTAL STORE: Where Cinema Never Ends
items.overview: Amid the transformations in the way people watch films, Paulo Sérgio Batista Pereira keeps Video Connection alive, one of the last video rental stores in São Paulo, located in the iconic Copan Building. For more than four decades, this place has brought together stories, memories, and people united by a shared passion: cinema. Surrounded by VHS tapes, DVDs, and conversations with longtime customers, Paulo reflects on the memory of video rental stores, the disappearance of a culture, and the human connections built over a lifetime devoted to films. More than preserving a collection, he preserves a place of connection, where cinema remains a shared experience.

items.title: THE STRANGER
items.overview: Might, mid twenties, is feeling lost in his career, confused about his purpose and direction. As he confronts tough emotions surrounding leaving his job, he runs into a unique stranger of his own conception who changes his world forever.

items.title: FOR NOW
items.overview: Over the course of a single day, Nizan Kaspers’s  FOR NOW follows the perspectives of individuals struggling with addiction, some of whom are also unhoused or living without permanent shelter, in the vicinity of Hamburg’s main train station. Between sunrise and sunset, the work reveals how their daily lives are structured by essential needs and survival strategies. The rhythms of the individuals portrayed exist alongside the cadences of commuter traffic, periods of waiting, and the flows of consumption that define the station as an urban hub — a space where disparate temporal orders, as well as varying social and economic conditions, converge.

items.title: Glimmer
items.overview: As a myna bird undergoes cataract surgery, GLIMMER captures the fragile bond between the bird and its owner, revealing the depths of love, vulnerability, and the universal hope of preserving a life we cannot bear to lose. Through the tension and uncertainty surrounding the operation, we see the fragile space between fear and hope, and come to understand the profound connection between the deeply intertwined lives of the bird and its owner.

items.title: Dead Flies
items.overview: Experimental narrative documentary on a fly who gets trapped beside an open window.  Dead Flies is a film about... a dead fly.

items.title: Dave Thornton: Trouble
items.overview: In Dave’s fourth Special ‘Trouble’ he talks about ice baths, Australia’s love of gambling ads and his wife’s obsession with True Crime. All in all it’s a show about the digital world we’re in from a guy who had an analogue upbringing (come to think of it where is his Tamagotchi..?)

items.title: Waves
items.overview: Young influencer Agatha has an appointment with "Professionall Cetrified Clarvoyant" W. W. Bobbins, and it doesn't turn out the way she expected it to.

items.title: Connect with the Enemy
items.overview: A paranoid detective named Mr. Butterloaf investigates a psychic phenomenon affecting the City of Ottawa. His journey takes him nowhere and he learns nothing.

items.title: Tse Noutra
items.overview: Follows Jérémie Heitz in his home mountains of Les Marecottes, Switzerland.

items.title: Cliff Dreams
items.overview: Climbers Molly Thompson-Smith and Fay Manners on a search for Ireland's wildest sea cliffs.

items.title: Misi 41
items.overview: The story follows Amat and Ijul as they race against time to collect 41 types of traditional wadai ahead of the Baayun Maulid celebration.  This hunt for traditional Banjar delicacies becomes an adventure in itself for the two of them. However, behind their mission to collect dozens of wadai lies a family issue that they must gradually face and resolve.

items.title: Kids
items.overview: What does it mean to be a kid? A group of young snowboarders - Camille Armand, Enzo Scotto, and Quentin Ladame - set out to explore this question in the heart of the Japanese winter, where deep snow transforms the landscape into a endless playground.

items.title: Habitaré els nostres noms
items.overview: "Habitaré els nostres noms" is an intimate behind-the-scenes journey at MACBA, where art moves in silence. The documentary reveals the invisible process of preparing the new presentation of the MACBA collection, from deinstallation to opening.  A secret journey through the museum that breathes even when no one is watching.

items.title: Cup of Joe - Sandali Sessions | Backyard Live
items.overview: The BACKYARD LIVE official live performance of Cup of Joe

items.title: Janak
items.overview: JANAK is an emotionally charged Marathi courtroom drama about a daughter's fight to restore her father's dignity after social media turns a few seconds of video into a devastating public judgment.

items.title: Delirium
items.overview: The filmmaker reflects on the tale of a man and his struggles with religion.

items.title: Dreamer
items.overview: A boy grows up dreaming of telling stories and making films, but his insecurities and lack of self-confidence hold him back. Now, as an adult, he makes one final attempt to pursue his passion.

items.title: Play the Flying Music
items.overview: As Niles goes to gather the false evidence to cancel someone, he realizes that his flying music is missing. Unable to fly without it, Niles brings along his friends to search far and wide for his beloved flying music.

items.title: The Post Office Job
items.overview: Two idiotic criminals (one a seasoned veteran and the other a bumbling wannabe) devise the perfect heist to raise enough money for a trip to Legoland.

items.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

items.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
items.overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

items.title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider
items.overview: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.

items.title: A Sweet Christmas Anniversary
items.overview: In this enchanting third story in the Home Sweet Christmas franchise, Sophie and Sam embark to celebrate their first anniversary in picturesque Salzburg, a sprawling Christmas postcard town adorned with decorations and lights, a place one can almost smell the scents of mulled wine and gingerbread. What begins as a romantic first-year getaway quickly transforms into a lavish royal mystery when a charismatic hotelier draws the couple into a world of festive surprises. As Sophie uncovers a hidden connection to a beloved Christmas song, she and Sam must navigate the host’s surprising twists to safeguard their love – and to rediscover the true spirit of Christmas.

items.title: Ghuza da Sher
items.overview: The story of Nisar Ahmed Khan, told through his children and the people he served, a spiritual guide whose followers still visit his tomb on his birth and death anniversaries. And alongside how his family spends a few days at the village keeping his traditions alive.

items.title: All for Christmas
items.overview: Podcaster Winona is forced to test love online by a holiday dating-app partnership, connecting with a mystery man who feels like everything she’s been missing. What she doesn’t know is that he’s Luke, the rugged renovator transforming her grandmother’s Christmas Eve venue — and the last guy she’d ever expect to fall for in real life.

items.title: The Buffalo Miracle
items.overview: Follow the unfolding of a catastrophic blizzard that swiftly buried the city of Buffalo in snow and darkness, cutting power, heat, and visibility to residents trapped at home and on roads. A McDonald’s manager breaks protocol to create an impromptu refuge, people instantly mobilize to rescue their neighbors, and a community comes together in the most unexpected Christmas Eve celebration.

items.title: Robert Wilson: The Beauty of the Mysterious
items.overview: We look back at more than half a century of mysterious artistic creation while trying to crack a unique artistic code. Why are people moved to tears when Robert “Bob” Wilson puts minimalistic petrol pumps into a production of Shakespeare’s sonnets? Why does merciless repetition change our understanding of something? Together with Tom Waits, Willem Dafoe or Marina Abramović we trace back our own experience of Bob’s art. Is it true what Philipp Glass the collaborator of the milestone piece “Einstein on the Beach” laughingly and with apparent pleasure exclaims “what does it mean? It doesn’t mean anything!”?

items.title: Nate Bargatze: Good for Nathan
items.overview: Nate Bargatze brings his dry wit and deadpan charm to overzealous parking sensors, the walking politics of marriage and an unhinged family group chat.

items.title: Hope
items.overview: On the last day of college, three lives quietly collide with memories, choices, and unspoken feelings. Hope is a poetic reflection on timing, love, and the moments that could have changed everything.  Hope follows three hearts bound by silence, longing, and what remains unsaid. A gentle story about love, timing, and the fragile beauty of unanswered emotions.

items.title: Leila et la Nuit
items.overview: The French-Moroccan Alaoui family is preparing for a holiday reunion in their Marrakech home, eagerly awaiting the arrival of their daughter and sister, Leila. Their fragile balance is shattered when they learn she has been seriously injured while on assignment as a photographer in Burkina Faso. Cut off from her yet determined to bring her home, they struggle against the void her absence threatens to leave behind.

items.title: Super Dicks
items.overview: Directed by Damian Lee.

items.title: GW:s mord - Mordet på Liselotte
items.overview: One dark October evening, 25-year-old Liselotte gets into a car in Timrå. After that, all signs of life cease. Ten days later, she is found dead next to a cliff ledge.

items.title: Memoirs of a Tiger Killer
items.overview: After being fired from his job, the conformist Aderbal loses all of his unemployment insurance to online betting sites. Devastated by his loss, he embarks on a journey of revenge, vowing to murder every influencer he encounters who promotes gambling websites. Meanwhile, a nuclear conflict between Brazil and the United States threatens all life on Earth.

items.title: Sessions
items.overview: Richie is a man struggling with his inner demons as he faces the effects of substance abuse on both his relationships and mental well-being.

items.title: An Angel Messed Up My Christmas
items.overview: When an angel sends Elliot back to high school during Christmas, changing one thing creates a future without the family he loves. Now he must undo his mistakes to save them, and rediscover what made his life perfect all along.

items.title: Off the Record
items.overview: When an ambitious journalist goes undercover in a seemingly legitimate cannabis company, he uncovers a deadly fentanyl trafficking ring protected by corrupt officials - but as the body count rises and his cover slips, he must choose between exposing the truth or making it out alive for the family he left behind.

items.title: For better or worse you will never die
items.overview: While spending a morning at the river, two little girls embark on an adventure of their own invention, weaving a tale of castles and knights from another age, one that echoes the history of a nation.

items.title: Petit Tom
items.overview: Tom is 6 years old. With his camera, he films his mother, the dog, and the alley. Tom has difficulties with studying; he is hyperactive; he has anger issues at school; moreover, he eats crisps for supper. Tom is the son of Nathalie, a loving drug-addicted bipolar mother; the brother of Caroline, an escort who would like to go back to school; and the grandson of Madeleine, the grandmother tired of taking care of everyone. Petit Tom is a film about life and childhood in the setting of chaos, flowing time, family heritage, and motherly love.

items.title: The Black Sea
items.overview: In a world where a deadly virus has made the night air fatal, a secret platform allows people to hire strangers to fulfill their darkest desires.

items.title: Falling in Lore
items.overview: Nessa (25), a laundry worker who seeks to escape her boredom by wearing her customers' clothes. However, her actions lead her further than she ever imagined

items.title: Tago
items.overview: In a remote Georgian village surrounded by misty mountains, a local man discovers the body of a young stranger on the riverbank and takes him home to his wife and young son. The arrival of this unexpected guest disturbs the family’s already fragile life, forcing each member to make difficult and extreme decisions.

items.title: L’éclat
items.overview: A mother who is a painter, haunted by the violence of her past, sees her reality begin to crumble after her son returns. As distorted memories and reality blur together, she sinks deeper into a psychological struggle against a trauma that refuses to let her go.

items.title: The Wily Ones
items.overview: Fragments of memories from our grandparents take us back to a time when the world smelled of rivers, forests, and freshly fertilized fields. People were resilient, cows and horses were loyal companions, and children were full of curious freedom and inventive solutions, always ready to get up to mischief while working.

items.title: SO ALIVE!
items.overview: A fictional boy aims to become a non-fictional rapper. His label has other plans.

items.title: Lustlings
items.overview: When Maine wakes up in the middle of the night after a first date, his lover’s house is full of unsettling surprises about who he truly is.

items.title: Lorazepam
items.overview: Jax is about to jump off a bridge onto the highway below when he unexpectedly runs into Joy, his childhood friend. Joy tries to calm him down and asks him to stay by his side wherever they go. This unexpected reunion brings them closer again as they spend the entire day together, slowly rekindling their bond.

items.title: La Pointe de mon île
items.overview: On the shore of an island he once imagined, Cassius recalls Sami, his first love and a former tecktonik dancer.

items.title: Rumination
items.overview: A group of strangers accept an invitation from a mutual friend to a desert retreat to witness a passing comet. Reality bends and they begin encountering house guests from the past, present, and future. Tension builds as they begin to realize none of them know their host all that well and this trip might be their last.

items.title: O
items.overview: Lucía, Juana, and Evaristo work in a city that functions like an open-air factory. Meanwhile, Sami and Claudio work aboard an Argentine space capsule. Following the recent arrival of new owners in the country, Lucía confronts this new order by painting counter-advertisements on city walls. At the same time, Sami tries to return to Earth by any means necessary, after being informed that no one will be coming to look for them.

items.title: High River
items.overview: Bilbao, 1983. Torrential rains cause the river to overflow, flooding the city and plunging it into chaos. Meanwhile, the gay club High remains open, operating intermittently through power cuts as some men continue to come, suspended in a limbo of desire. Little by little, the outside world seeps in: rising water and distant sounds reveal an internal reality from which there is no easy escape.

items.title: Iranians Under Siege
items.overview: The dramatic stories of Iranians living through a year of protests, crackdowns and war. Rare footage and firsthand accounts of the regime's campaign to crush dissent, and of life under U.S. and Israeli bombing.

items.title: I Can Stop Anytime I Want
items.overview: A gambling addict hatches a plan to outrun their outstanding debt.

items.title: Portrait of Tin's Family
items.overview: After tin mining in Singkep ended, Lunar imagines its past grandeur through his mother’s stories. When a mysterious Tin Man appears across fragmented time, merely photographing the present, the film interrogates memory, extraction, and the lingering socio-ecological afterlife of a mined city.

items.title: Guy Movie
items.overview: A movie about Guy.

items.title: Percephily
items.overview: This is a tale of an employee, a student, and all the people who gives it all for their respective jobs. Ending this job is just a choice but can it fulfill your willingness to perspire life?

items.title: Thankachante Sherikal
items.overview: Thankachante Sherikal

items.title: Mate The 13th
items.overview: A quiet get-together among friends ends in a bloody massacre when one of them has the audacity to break a sacred rule of Argentine tradition: the yerba in the mate is never stirred. Never. Ever.

items.title: Small World: Making the Borrowers
items.overview: Feature length documentary retrospective of the classic 1991-1992 BBC children's drama series, reuniting cast and crew at the original location.

items.title: Basketball Slam Dunk: The Director's Cut
items.overview: An extensive look at the world of the basketball game before, during, and after the events of Basketball Slam Dunk: Galaxy 11. Dives into the rivalry between Nick and Clay and reveals just how close the results went each way for both players.

items.title: We Are Entitled to Love Autumn
items.overview: Mohamed, a Palestinian asylum seeker in Sweden, uses an ai chatbot to improve his swedish language, but what begins as practice becomes a late-night lifeline, drawing him into grief, memory, and the quiet weight of exile.

items.title: El Ahorcado
items.overview: During a camping trip at Parque Pereyra, Alejandro experienced an event that would shape the rest of his life. While documenting the trip with his camera, he becomes separated from his friends and discovers a person’s body hanging among the trees. Ten years later, Alejandro decides to investigate what happened that night; he hires a production company, interviews local residents, and explores the woods once again.

items.title: El Film
items.overview: In a Moroccan riad, El Mehdi transforms a mint tea ceremony into a ritual of queer self-reclamation. Moving between Arabic, French, and English, EL FILM explores identity, belonging, masculinity, the sacred, and the freedom to exist beyond restrictive binaries.

items.title: Shepherd
items.overview: A film based on the life of Saint Ivan of Rila.

items.title: The Tenant
items.overview: A man's quiet afternoon turns to terror, when a horrific force infiltrates his home.

items.title: Smoker
items.overview: A Muay Thai fighter falls in love with his next opponent. The only way to win his heart is to defeat him in the ring.

items.title: Cadavre exquis
items.overview: Constructed like a cadavre exquis, the film unfolds in fragments, between dream and reality, revealing the many facets of a fractured identity. A posthumous coming-out where a man's death becomes the birth of his truth.

items.title: Into the Unknown
items.overview: Snowboarder Antti Autti links up with outdoor guide Anniina Perätalo to execute a final winter strike mission to Lenangsbreen, Norway.

items.title: Sicarios
items.overview: Marbella isn't just a city. It's a lifestyle synonymous with luxury, aristocracy, and parties. Lots of parties. It’s a place to see and be seen. But on the Costa del Sol, there’s also organized crime, drug trafficking, money laundering, settling of scores, and hitmen. This story comes to a head on the day of a First Communion, but it had been brewing for a long time.

items.title: Mikkelin aikamatka
items.overview: A documentary film that takes the viewer on an impressive journey through the history of the Mikkeli region, from the Stone Age to the present day.

items.title: The Long Way Back
items.overview: Elite ultra runner Gemma Hillier-Moses takes on the brutal 2026 UTMB Arc of Attrition in some of the harshest conditions ever recorded. Battling relentless weather, unforgiving terrain, and the limits of human endurance, Gemma’s journey goes far beyond sport. This is more than a race. It’s a story of survival, determination, and pushing past every obstacle.

items.title: The Exodus
items.overview: A psychological silent horror short film exploring isolation, atmospheric dread, and the haunting journey of a lone survivor in a desolate landscape. Told entirely through visual tension and sound design without dialogue.

items.title: Desaparición inquietante: En el nombre del padre
Master of Shadows - Shoot From The Hip Improvised Play #89
items.overview: Shoot From The Hip's 89th improvised play

items.title: Before We Break: Two Against One
items.overview: In Before We Break: Two Against One, freshman student Christy Cross is determined to lose her virginity to her longtime crush, Phoenix Kingston. As a sports journalism major and new Winchester wolves mascot, her plan is to get closer to Phoenix. Instead, she finds herself trapped in a love triangle with the Kingston brothers: Phoenix, her brother Hudson’s enemy and her longtime crush, and Ace, her brother's best friend and her longtime bully. Ace Kingston is determined to keep Christy away from his playboy stepbrother Phoenix. After all, she's his best friend's little sister, though she's unaware of his deeper feelings for her. When Phoenix refuses to back down, their sibling rivalry explodes, forcing Christy to make the ultimate choice. Who will Christy choose: her crush, Phoenix, or her bull, Ace?

items.title: Adrishyya
items.overview: Prajapati, a struggling cab driver in Guwahati, dreams of owning a home for his family. His life takes an unexpected turn when he begins working for a wealthy man, Amarendra Bhattacharya, living a seemingly comfortable life. An unusual proposition brings the two men into a complicated arrangement, setting off a chain of events filled with secrets, unexpected complications and moral dilemmas. As ambition and desperation begin to shape their choices, Prajapati finds himself caught in a situation where the price of a dream may be far greater than he ever imagined.

items.title: Introspective Frames: A Retrospective
items.overview: An Experimental Retrospective Of A Years Works. Thousands Of Frames From Every Experimental Short I Have Released This Year, Instinctively Sequenced To Create A Rhythmic Montage Of Form And Structure.

items.title: The Absolute Debacle of 'Person of the Century'
items.overview: documentary adapting from Where We Parked, "Episode Two: Person of the Century"

items.title: The Deli
items.overview: On Manhattan’s Lower East Side, Punjabi Deli has served locals, taxi drivers, and visitors for over thirty years—evolving while staying grounded in owner Kulwinder “Jani” Singh’s ethos of community, connection, and homestyle food.
